apps.short_description: Hunt birds in the Farm biome, master your weapon, and climb the online leaderboard. The demo offers a first look at Pluck Em!’s fast-paced arcade action, with additional biomes, weapons, upgrades, and features available to preview in the menus.

apps.name: Pointless Climb Demo
apps.short_description: Escape an impossible abyss as Ilia Movahed in a brutal, parkour climber. Execute precision vaults, wall climbs, and high stakes jumps to reach the summit. There are no checkpoints. one simple mistake will send you tumbling back to the start.

apps.name: Pool Glow Demo
apps.short_description: Pool Glow is an immersive exploration game inspired by Poolcore. Experience the demo version for a small but complete 'Poolcore' experience.

apps.name: Poolrooms Museum Demo
apps.short_description: Explore surreal liminal pool spaces and a strange waterless dungeon.

apps.name: Poolside Memory Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person chase horror set in endless liminal poolrooms. This free demo lets you play the opening part of the game — the pool rebuilds itself into a new nightmare every run.

apps.name: PRIEST Demo
apps.short_description: Lead an army as its healer in PRIEST: a fantasy autobattler with an emphasis on healing. Arrange your army, keep them alive, and grow them in strength and number using four talent trees. Battle across 23 campaign levels then see how far you can get in endless mode.

apps.name: Priority One Demo
apps.short_description: Demo For Priority One

apps.name: Prospice Demo
apps.short_description: Haul cursed cargo across a haunted island, where the terrain can take your life and every road bears the scars of the past.

apps.name: PSYCHO CASKET Demo
apps.short_description: PSYCHO CASKET is the definitive emo RPG. Play as a vampire and make the ultimate decision- the lives of your friends, or those of the entire world? It's been waiting for you. Yes, YOU.

apps.name: PUCKVPUCK Demo
apps.short_description: Arcade sports with pucks. Boost, slam and charge your shots in SOCCER, knock the other team out in DODGEBALL, or grab a gun in SHOOTER. Up to 8 players on one PC, online with friends, or solo against bots.

apps.name: PuPuPoPu Company Demo
apps.short_description: A cute, wacky top-down PvE extraction shooter. The world's fading, so a duckling with flashy feet and flawless blush starts a paint-spraying company. Blast away pollution in a hail of paint and give this black-and-white world its color back. Rescue critters, pack 'em to go—extract. Clock out!

apps.name: Purrfect Beats Demo
apps.short_description: A cat, synthwave music, and a single button to test your sense of rhythm. How hard could it be?

apps.name: Put It Away Please Demo
apps.short_description: “Some Day”: a standalone day made just for the demo. Put the groceries away exactly as the note says, flip the labels to check the dates, and turn around when you hear footsteps behind you. In the full game: five special days of summer break.

apps.name: Puzzle Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: The one-more-piece jigsaw game. Puzzle Simulator is a dangerously cozy puzzle adventure where you unlock shelf after shelf of boxes, satisfyingly sweep and sort pieces, collect rare charms, and puzzle your own photos.

apps.name: Quilt Demo
apps.short_description: Create a beautiful quilt one patch at a time. Solve handcrafted puzzles inspired by picross, minesweeper, and jigsaw puzzles, and uncover the hidden rules of the world through logic and experimentation.

apps.name: Race Jam Demo
apps.short_description:
Experience the thrill of the 1990s with Race Jam - an action packed arcade-style racing game! Featuring retro-inspired tracks, high speed gameplay and an authentic throwback vibe.
Race Jam: Exhilarating 90's Arcade Racing like you remember, But BETTER

apps.name: RADZIMA Demo
apps.short_description: RADZIMA is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror set in an underground research facility. Find radioactive items, avoid the mutants, and power the elevator reactor to descend deeper - all in service of the Party’s will.

apps.name: Raid Sky Demo
apps.short_description: Fly your island, fish, craft, build cannons and unleash debuffs on bot rivals in 15-minute matches. Offline singleplayer only, Easy / Normal / Hard AI. Three ways to score: crystal charge, bonus zone and missions.

apps.name: Rebirth: Denied Protocol Demo
apps.short_description: Trapped inside a failed resurrection experiment, a cop must survive grotesque creatures and uncover the truth behind a mad doctor’s obsession in this PS1-style survival horror with fixed cameras and tank controls.

apps.name: Red Echoes: Berlin Demo
apps.short_description: Berlin 1918. Amidst the turmoil of the Great War, the fires of revolution burn. With the German Kaiser's reign rapidly coming to an end, lead a group of socialist revolutionaries and attempt to change the course of history. Will you succeed and bring about a better tomorrow?

apps.name: Regions of Ruin: Runegate Demo
apps.short_description: Embark on an explorative RPG hack-and-slash adventure where you attempt to re-establish a haven for the lost dwarven civilization. Journey across varied lands, help those in need, gather resources and fight off goblins and monsters as you slowly rebuild a home for your people.

apps.name: Rex Summons a Meteor Demo
apps.short_description: A short demo about a large rock. Help Rex accidentally summon a meteor. Oops. Now you have to save the first island! Barter with stubborn dinosaurs who only talk in emoji, play some absurd mini-games, and solve puzzles in the first island of Rex Summons a Meteor.

apps.name: Rifles & Runes Demo
apps.short_description: A real-time strategy game blending extraction, cards, and fantasy exploration. Lead a modern army through a portal, scout unknown lands, build mines and radar, repel counterattacks, hold your outposts, and extract before the world’s attention overwhelms you.

apps.name: Ritual Break Demo
apps.short_description: Ritual Break is a co-op boss rush bullet hell where two heroes combine their abilities, manipulate enemy attacks, and face colossal demonic bosses within an ancient ritual arena.

apps.name: Road to Hollow Hills Demo
apps.short_description: Road To Hollow Hills is an adventure horror game. Explore the environment, collect useful resources, and customize the abilities of your character in order to survive the Road to Hollow Hills.

apps.name: Robo Dream Party Demo
apps.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party brawler set inside a robot's dream, where physics goes haywire. Punch, grab, and throw anything you find, ride robot vehicles, and knock your friends off the map to be the last robot standing!

apps.name: RoboFarm Demo
apps.short_description: Build, automate, and decorate your dream farm! Deploy robot workers, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch your crops thrive while you relax, raising profits to your satisfaction. Save and share your creations, tune in with the music, and experience the world of RoboFarm.

apps.name: Rules: Motel Horizon Demo
apps.short_description: Start your job as a night administrator at the mysterious Horizon Motel, where visitors from another world try to pass as ordinary people, and the rules have the highest priority — breaking them leads to… undesirable consequences.

apps.name: RuneEra Demo
apps.short_description: RuneEra is a fantasy colony-management RPG where you build a guild settlement, automate work and production, equip powerful runes, and lead parties through a procedurally generated world of quests, factions, dangerous biomes, and dungeons.

apps.name: Salmon City Preview
apps.short_description: Shady deals, intense shootouts and trying to make an honest living. Welcome to Salmon City - a chaotic multiplayer roleplaying experience where every round is a fresh start, every stranger has private agendas and every decision has consequences. Play your role in the twisted theatre of it all.

apps.name: Satelital Demo
apps.short_description: A rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

apps.name: Save the Forest Demo
apps.short_description: Save the Forest is a tactics roguelite where you lead your squad of villagers in a quest to defeat the admittedly pretty silly evil that has corrupted the forest. Choose and create combos with over 25 units and 150+ skills!

apps.name: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive! Demo
apps.short_description: Bring order to a perfume archive of 3,240 bottles, solo or with a friend, in this relaxing first-person organizing game. Read labels, place bottles on the right shelves, develop helpful skills, and watch completed collections light up the archive.

apps.name: SchoolBoy Runaway Demo
apps.short_description: “You little rascal! Go do your homework!” said your parents and put you under house arrest. Try the demo version of the game, outsmart your parents, and find a way to have fun with your friends!

apps.name: Scratch The Cat Demo
apps.short_description: Grab your headphones and step up to the turntable in Scratch The Cat - a vibrant action-adventure 3D platformer. Play as DJ Scratch, explore a sprawling musical world, fight bosses, and reclaim your stolen records. Turn up the volume and set the stage for the purr-fect comeback.

apps.name: Scream Operator: Haunted House Manager Demo
apps.short_description: Run a haunted dark ride from the control booth in this spooky horror management sim. Load guests, trigger scares, route carts, and keep the power alive as the queue surges. Earn cash and prestige to rebuild the mansion, automate the ride, and survive every shift.

apps.name: Sekigahara 1600: Must Attack Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of Sekigahara 1600. The demo includes six battlefields: Nancy, Bowang, Okehazama, Sekigahara, Gettysburg and Waterloo, plus the interactive tutorial. Any unit left in an enemy zone of control must attack: no quiet flanks, nothing held back. Pushing the line is the game.

apps.name: Shadow of the Road Demo
apps.short_description: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

apps.name: Shallow Pond Demo
apps.short_description: Explore a cozy slice of Shallow Pond as you swim, jump, and uncover secrets in this playful 3D platformer.

apps.name: shatAAAAp! Demo
apps.short_description:
Exponentially bigger waves of cute animals require increasingly absurd means of destruction.
Shoot, burn, electrocute, explode... and make sure no one ever helps you.

apps.name: Sheepscape Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of Sheepscape, a cozy sim about one shepherd, one dog and a field full of sheep. Take a Welsh smallholding from five muddy sheep to a flock worth something: herd them, shear each fleece at its best, sell the wool, breed a better flock and earn the deed to your next farm.

apps.name: SHROOMY ISLAND Demo
apps.short_description: Shroomy Island is a desktop tower defense idle game. Critters automatically gather, craft, build, and patrol, help them run their village and fend off the evil mushroom monsters. Slowly expand and decorate your village, and collect different critters to keep you company while you work or study!

apps.name: Simple Football League Manager Demo
apps.short_description: A football management game for people who love football but don't want to spend hours on every detail. Choose from 5,909 clubs, build your team, play in leagues and cups, and get insights from your assistant Rob. Includes 2 difficulty modes, local multiplayer and a customizable database.

apps.name: Sinesperia Demo
apps.short_description: Someone lived a life here. You just can't remember it yet. Explore the dreams buried deep inside your mind to find out who you were.

apps.name: Skateboard Knight Demo
apps.short_description: Hop on a skateboard and casually save the world! Simple controls—just move up or down. Horizontal movement and attacks are all automatic!

apps.name: Skuffle Demo
apps.short_description: A split-screen and online party first person shooter. Mutator cards change how every round plays and theres a wide range of weapons to shoot your friends with. Maps are varied and range from small arenas to gimmicks and long distance battles. I think I gave you some of each of those. How generous.

apps.name: Slimestronauts: Burst Strike Demo
apps.short_description: Feature subset of Slimestronauts : Burst Strike!  A classic 'drop and match 4 color' game set in space with a variety of new ways to play!

apps.name: Sludgineers Demo
apps.short_description: Clean, mine and refine pollution in this active incremental game. Cruise through the countryside earning cash and resources, build a refinery, process materials, upgrade equipment, unlock new areas and complete quests.

apps.name: Smawverse Demo
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy bullet heaven built in Unreal Engine 5. You are a stray cat reforged in iron: kneel to four prophets, stack their blessings until one cat clears the screen, survive streets laid out differently every run, and summon the different bosses to upgrade your spells and gear.

apps.name: Snake: Gridbreaker Demo
apps.short_description: Play the first loop of Snake: Gridbreaker. Defeat the Gatekeeper, unlock Ghost Snake, progress Anomaly Signal, and carry your save into the full game.

apps.name: Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs Demo
apps.short_description: Sobakistan — the land of dogs, is a darkly satirical narrative immersion in a closed-off totalitarian dog state — where any step could send you to prison. Rich story, choices with consequences, bureaucratic card battles, text-based soulslike.

apps.name: SoleRuler Demo
apps.short_description: You are a deity from the Heavenly Realm, and you will descend to the mortal world to fight across the three realms.

apps.name: Soul Tides Demo
apps.short_description: Command dark armies in this tug-of-war auto-battler. Build your base, summon units, customize abilities, and push the battlefield toward your enemy’s stronghold. Adapt your strategy each match and dominate in PvP, co-op, or Trials mode.

apps.name: Souls of Bombarika Demo
apps.short_description:
Dead? Check. Superpowers? Check. Absolutely no idea what you're doing? Also check.

Possess everyday objects, outsmart an evil witch, and solve explosive puzzles in this quirky supernatural adventure.

apps.name: Soulstonia - Demo
apps.short_description: Recruit Summoners with minds of their own in this cozy idle RPG. Set idle goals and let your party gather, craft, and fight for you, or take control anytime. Train 20+ skills, summon creatures, and explore a living fantasy world. Free-to-play at launch.

apps.name: SoundBoard Demo
apps.short_description: Community-built library: heart the sounds you love or add your own. Organize your way, customize categories, and set shortcuts as you like. The demo gives full SoundBoard access until launch—perfect for testing in calls, streams, and games.

apps.name: Sovereign Tower Demo
apps.short_description: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

apps.name: SOVIET SPOOKY TALES: Green Eyes Demo
apps.short_description: A nonlinear pixel art visual novel set in the 1980s Soviet Union, inspired by Soviet children's spooky stories.

apps.name: Space Simulation Toolkit - DEMO
apps.short_description:
A particle simulator that uses a graphics card as a supercomputer to calculate physics.

The more powerful the graphics card, the greater the gameplay!

apps.name: SpecterMancer Demo
apps.short_description: A multiplayer horror game for 1 to 6 players set in a dark Victorian era. As a ghost, you must terrify the others and prevent them from escaping alive; as a survivor, explore, solve puzzles, survive, and find a way to escape.

apps.name: Speed Rivals - Model Trains Demo
apps.short_description: A miniature train delivery game where you drive across the map, pick up wagons generated in different locations, and deliver them to the right destination points as efficiently as possible.

apps.name: SpellChain Demo
apps.short_description: Create and combine your own spells through a dynamic spellcrafting system. Fight through a hostile kingdom, disrupt its events and grow your magical powers on a quest to slay the king.

apps.name: Spheromania Demo
apps.short_description: Bounce, blast, and outlast in Spheromania. A fast-paced arena shooter where drones duel with blasters, mines, and mid-air hops. Manage your energy, dodge the shrinking arena, and be the last sphere hovering. Solo mode or online multiplayer.

apps.name: Spin Tactics Demo
apps.short_description: The full loop of Spin Tactics in one run: three encounters, then a boss. Everything on the board is yours to change, and what you build with what drops is the whole game.

apps.name: Spooky Market Demo
apps.short_description: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

apps.name: Spy Carnival Demo
apps.short_description: Spy Carnival is a 2-10 player social deception game set in a vibrant, chaotic funfair. Spies hide among the crowd, sabotaging rides and eliminating visitors while blending in with NPCs. Officers must stay sharp, read the crowd and take down the spies before the carnival turns into complete chaos.

apps.name: Stack & Brew Demo
apps.short_description: Garden Gingdom is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

apps.name: Star Purr Demo
apps.short_description: A cute neon bullet-heaven roguelite. One cat, one catnip trip, ten thousand mice. Auto-fire weapons that mutate at Lv10 and Lv20, two bosses from the cat's dream, and a SSS combo to chase. Play the first chapter free — your wishlist unlocks the rest.

apps.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown Demo
apps.short_description: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown is a story-driven survival strategy game in which the fate of the iconic starship is in your hands. Take the helm, manage the ship and resources, and make difficult decisions. Will you be able to bring home the ship and its crew?

apps.name: Starfinder: Afterlight Demo
apps.short_description: Starfinder: Afterlight is a party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well, save the galaxy while you're at it!

apps.name: Starlit World Demo
apps.short_description: Help Bo & Kikki save the Starlits from Oli’s evil spell in a cute and chaotic 3D platforming adventure! Discover special suits, fight bosses, and explore magical worlds as you rebuild Starlit Island and complete your sticker album!

apps.name: STILLTRACE Demo
apps.short_description: The first two days of the quarantine and eight waves of co-op. Repair the radio, scavenge supplies and hold the beacon under attack: alone, with a friend or with a bot partner. Your progress carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Stip Demo
apps.short_description: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets.  Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

apps.name: StowStow Demo
apps.short_description: StowStow puts you in a physics-driven warehouse where every box has weight and consequence. Scan cargo, dodge explosions, draft upgrade cards, and build conveyor lines until the chaos runs itself.

apps.name: Strange Antiquities Demo
apps.short_description: Become the custodian of a store dealing in occult antiquities. Explore the quaint and gloomy town of Undermere, where strange goings-on and dark mysteries abound. Find and identify arcane artefacts, use your collection to aid the townsfolk with their unusual problems — and remember to pet your cat!

apps.name: Streets of Miami VR Demo
apps.short_description: Streets of Miami VR is a gritty 1980s crime-action VR game where you fight, drive, spray paint, shoot, hustle for money, and survive the streets of Miami in a open world sand box experience built for physical VR gameplay.

apps.name: Strike Wings Demo
apps.short_description: A free demo of Strike Wings, inspired by the space shooters of the DOS era. Choose from seven ships, fly 17 battles and begin a voiced story campaign. Learn the ropes in Flight School, take on a 1v1 duel or team up in local split-screen co-op.

apps.name: Studio Zero Demo
apps.short_description: 《Studio Zero》is a first-person cyberpunk FMV thriller. In a future ruled by megacorporations, every choice you make dictates your fate. Will you shatter the system, become a corporate puppet, or vanish into the neon night? Step in—your choices shape the ending.

apps.name: Sudoku Studio Demo
apps.short_description: Try all 36 Sudoku variants in Sudoku Studio Demo: two puzzles per difficulty (Easy–Hard), Daily and Weekly challenges, tutorials, Practice Mode, and the full assist tools, including custom colors and PDF printing. Progress carries over to the full version.

apps.name: Sugar-Mommied by a Fox Babe Demo
apps.short_description: Sugar-Mommied by a Fox Babe is a Live2D, interaction-focused romance simulation game. You find yourself working as a fox spirit's "assistant," living together and taking care of all aspects of her daily life.

apps.name: SULFUR Demo
apps.short_description: This is the Demo of SULFUR - a modern old-school action-adventure: Outsmart enemies, find treasure, improve weapons, harness powers. Delve deeper, find answers, make it end.

apps.name: SUPER DEBT Demo
apps.short_description: Money is your life in SUPER DEBT! Fight to survive with an arsenal of wildly different weapons and upgrades. In this intense and challenging Twin-Stick Bullet-Hell Roguelike everything costs money, and we mean everything!

apps.name: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Run your own TCG Card Shop! Open surprise eggs, collect cards and toy parts, raise birds, stock shelves, and serve customers. Discover shop management and collecting in this demo, with limited content compared to the full game.

apps.name: Super Interactive Cats - Desktop Pets Demo
apps.short_description: Let adorable cats make your desktop their home! Adopt different breeds, care for them, play with toys, prepare meals, and send them on adventures. Whether you’re working or relaxing, enjoy their lively company throughout the day.

apps.name: Supercar Collection Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Build your own diecast store! Unbox surprise car packs, expand your collection, and join thrilling races on racing tracks. A world of speed and excitement awaits in your store!

apps.name: Survindust Demo
apps.short_description: Play the free demo! Stranded on a tiny island in an endless ocean, you craft new land tile by tile, automate production and grow a bare camp into a self-sustaining industrial base.

apps.name: Swarmbreaker Demo
apps.short_description: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!

apps.name: Sword of Ace Demo
apps.short_description: A punishing 3rd-person soulslike action RPG set in a blood-soaked Gothic Horror Victorian world. Step into the armor of a final knight from the Sword of Ace Order, wield your iron sword against terrifying demonic hordes, and fight to survive the grim, mysterious remnants of a fallen civilization.

apps.name: Tabletop Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Tabletop Survivors is a turn-based roguelike card RPG driven by random events, where every playthrough tells a new story. You will survive and fight in a zombie apocalypse, making difficult choices and writing your own survival journey.

apps.name: Tactical Annihilation Demo
apps.short_description: Experience turn-based strategy with free-form base building, multi-unit control, colossal units, and powerful battle skills. It captures the depth of an RTS in turn-based form, like Advanced Wars with massive super units!

apps.name: TALLREAPER DEMO VERSION
apps.short_description: A seemingly simple task given to you by the Baron, turns into living hell, revealing a dark, surreal and introspective story, as you - a prisoner - are tasked with obtaining a fallen knights sword inside an underground crypt.

apps.name: Tamer Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Team up with adorable animal companions and combine their abilities to defeat hordes of trash monsters! Evolve a variety of weapons, create a new build with every run, and cleanse a polluted world in this casual roguelite survival action game.

apps.name: Tandem Together Demo
apps.short_description: Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

apps.name: Tango District Demo
apps.short_description: Tango District is a casual, puzzle-based city builder set in a neon-drenched dystopia. Balance spatial placement, manage corporate influence, and navigate corrupt events. Will you build a free paradise, or sell your skyline to the highest corporate bidder?

apps.name: Tavernia Demo
apps.short_description: Try Tavernia free. A strategy board game for 2–8 players. Answer trivia to claim empty tiles, then beat your opponents in minigame duels to take theirs. Play cards to challenge them to typing races, word puzzles, reaction tests, and more.

apps.name: Telma-H:Act One Scene One Demo
apps.short_description: This demo takes place around the turn of the millennium. The protagonist, a student at a private secondary school, is unexpectedly helped by a mysterious adult woman on his way home one day. He later discovers that she is about to become a new member of his family.

apps.name: Terminal Drift Demo
apps.short_description: Hold down the cargo bay! In Terminal Drift, automated defense systems handle the trigger, but survival is entirely in your hands. Adapt your load-out and survive 20 relentless waves, because when the Matriarch breaches the hull, firepower alone won’t save you.

apps.name: Terraclysm Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Terraclysm Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike sidescroller. Earth is in peril, jump and attack through treacherous stages packed with enemy hordes while building the ultimate loadout. With up to 4 players online, defeat the invaders and survive in this apocalyptic and chaotic challenge!

apps.name: The Artisan of Glimmith Demo
apps.short_description: The Artisan of Glimmith is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds. Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises.

apps.name: The Atrium Demo
apps.short_description: Mine your way through a vast cave system that watches as you dig deeper each day. Explore diverse biomes, collect valuable resources and craft increasingly powerful tools and upgrades until you are strong enough to reach the end of the tunnel before it collapses on you.

apps.name: The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire Demo
apps.short_description: Start from nothing and build a criminal empire in a seamless open-world sandbox. Run businesses, manage production chains, recruit your crew, fight rival families, and outsmart the police as every system pushes you closer to becoming the boss.

apps.name: The Dark Delivers Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to Postal Sector 7. As the Night Shift Package Inspector, your job is simple: assess parcels and reject anything not up to code. Stay alert for anomalous dangers and survive long enough to meet your quota by 6AM.

apps.name: The Dark West Demo
apps.short_description: The Dark West is a western occult ARPG set across a dying frontier that is consumed by corruption. Fight to survive with era-specific weapons and dark magic as you face deadly encounters and uncover distinctive items.

apps.name: The Devil's Due Demo
apps.short_description: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

apps.name: The Echoes Demo
apps.short_description: The Echoes is a 1-4 player co-op horror game. To escape a loop, you must observe your surroundings, memorize details, solve puzzles, and survive.

apps.name: The First Pixel Demo
apps.short_description: A single pixel wakes in the dark. Feed it, shape it, follow the patterns it leaves behind. Somewhere inside the noise are forgotten worlds, lost relics, and a question the pixel was never meant to ask.

apps.name: The Floor Above Demo
apps.short_description: A claustrophobic anomaly-horror game where you can only turn, blink, and decide: is it real or not? Survive five endings and uncover Mike’s story.

apps.name: The Gallery: VR Secrets Demo
apps.short_description: Step Into The Gallery: VR Secrets! Immerse yourself in a VR art gallery where every painting holds a hidden puzzle.

apps.name: The Goblin Path Demo
apps.short_description: A single-player action RPG about a goblin serving the Demon King. Scout the next party at night, steal their gear, and prepare poisons and traps. By day, defend your lair and loot the heroes you defeat.

apps.name: The Golden Horde: Survival Demo
apps.short_description: Enter the world of the Golden Horde and experience its harsh medieval steppe. Gather resources, hunt, craft weapons, armor, and healing items, fight different enemies, and protect your yurt on wheels as you begin your journey.

apps.name: The Hearth and Harbour Demo
apps.short_description: This short experience introduces you to the world of The Hearth & Harbour by laying the groundwork for its story, establishing the setting of Lewthport, and acquainting you with some of its lively townspeople.

apps.name: The Hollow Grounds Demo
apps.short_description: Survive relentless waves of the Hollowed, upgrade your armor and home, unlock and level up powerups, and invest Soulstones into permanent upgrades. Rebirth to grow stronger, fight deadly bosses, complete 50 achievements, explore the Enemy Index, and climb the leaderboards!

apps.name: The Inconvenience Store Demo
apps.short_description: Explore an endless, procedurally generated furniture store where daylight gives you time to scavenge and build—but after dark, hostile employees begin to hunt. Gather supplies, craft tools, manage your needs, and survive each night.

apps.name: The King Got Too Much Gold Demo
apps.short_description: Your royal fountain spits out more gold than anyone could ever spend, and cleaning it up is somehow your job. Sweep coins, sell them, draft upgrades, hire goblins, trolls and a cat, unlock a big web of skills, then feed your whole fortune to the Glutton King. You can never lose. The gold never stops

apps.name: The Magic Garden 魔法花园 Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to a new fantasy world, where you start a new life in this realm. Explore the  mysterious places of this world. Here, you can build farm, meet various   farming, collecting items, and using  items and skills, venture into dungeons to defeat monsters and collect rare items.

apps.name: The Melty Way Demo
apps.short_description: You move, you melt. You are a liquid-simulated slime where every move costs you a piece of yourself. Spend your mass to slide, shrink, and dash through pixel-perfect hazards in this challenging precision platformer where size management is critical and your only resource is your own body.

apps.name: The Milgram Experiment Demo
apps.short_description: A single-player moral dilemma simulator where you are judge, jury, and executioner. Investigate subjects through their personal items such as phones, diaries, and voice logs and uncover their darkest secrets. Judge if they fit a mysterious figure's new secret society. Terminate the unworthy.

apps.name: The Missing Threads Demo
apps.short_description:
Who am I, without my memories?
Armed with nothing but the knowledge that I was once a detective,
I face the cases before me, piecing together fragments of truth—
deciding which leads to follow, which voices to trust,
and how quickly I can reach the answer.

apps.name: The Questness - Light of Ra Demo
The RPG Demo
apps.short_description: Minimalistic Skyrim + West of Loathing + Supraland. An RPG-lite adventure with intentionally twisted traditional role-playing games aspects, where your choices do matter. Play up to an hour with the demo, and explore the world of The RPG.

apps.name: The Seance of Blake Manor Demo
apps.short_description: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery where you play as private investigator Declan Ward and investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane. The demo features the first two playable in-game hours on the Manor grounds.

apps.name: The Soul of Cosmos（灵魂乾坤） Demo
The Swamp Daughter Demo
apps.short_description: Embark on Julia’s journey in this 2.5D eco-apocalyptic adventure of choices, exploration, and puzzles. Explore a dangerous swamp and face tough choices while you uncover her past in this intriguing tale of identity and survival.

apps.name: The Telwynium: Book One
apps.short_description: Book One - Winter's Dawn. The first chapter in a 90s fantasy adventure epic from the creator of The Drifter. It's your first night away from Willows Dene, and you have first watch.

apps.name: The Tower Must Fall Demo
apps.short_description: Build an impossible tower. Defend it against endless sieges. Watch it crumble, then rebuild stronger.

apps.name: The Undead Lawyer Demo
apps.short_description: The demo of the hyper-movement action puzzle game where you speed through half of half the game - saving the souls of the damned, reviving them and executing them in specific ways decreed by the gods as fast as you can!

apps.name: THE VIG Demo
apps.short_description:
You'll be "Xie En", infiltrating the traitor's money empire. This urban hunt is a revenge saga where wit is your spear.
Return as "Wu Wei," using rules as your shield in a world of grey. Will you choose love or vengeance?
This lethal game of cash, betrayal and redemption awaits your move.

apps.name: The Wake (Demo)
apps.short_description: Set sail on the dark waters of a forgotten archipelago. Catch mutated monsters with customizable gear, master eldritch magic, and fight for survival. Take up arms to fend off sea beasts in an unforgiving Lovecraftian world.

apps.name: The Wake Event Demo
apps.short_description: Awaken aboard ARGUS Station and uncover the first signs of the Wake Event. This demo includes Modules 01-03, introducing exploration, environmental clues, terminal puzzles, subnet isolation, routing, and the station’s unsettling observation systems.

apps.name: The Way Home Demo
apps.short_description: Drive safely to your destination in a country where even the tiniest tap with your car can put you on death row.

apps.name: THORNSPELL Demo
apps.short_description: Embody a magical florist by placing plants strategically in your garden, and watering them to score points. THORNSPELL is a garden-building roguelike where you will create and unleash chains of magical effects, dispelling the corruption spreading through your home.

apps.name: THREADMILL Demo
apps.short_description: Write one program for every worker. Grow a robot workforce, share jobs and keep it working through changing supply and power outages. This Demo includes the opening Campaign, The Pipeline and replayable Challenges.

apps.name: Tia：weird hunter Demo
apps.short_description: This demo of Tia:weird hunter features Chapter One of the full experience. Dive into a hand-drawn 2D world, unleash fast, fluid combos, and take on fierce boss battles that will test your skills. Explore the mysterious "Faceless City" and get a taste of the story, combat, and chaos still to come.

apps.name: Timberworks Demo
apps.short_description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

apps.name: Time Jump Demo
apps.short_description: This is the Pre-Demo for TIME JUMP. Can you catch your other self? Want to know a little history of what happens before the actual story? Run run and run again in 3 short levels to catch the evil William Roger and put an end to his destruction.

apps.name: Time O'clock: The Mask of Crime Demo
apps.short_description:
The mask of a legendary thief has been stolen. Follow Detective Time in a point-and-click investigation using her watch to witness key moments and uncover who is behind this new wave of robberies. 
Observe the past. Investigate the present. Uncover the truth.

apps.name: Time Survivor Demo
apps.short_description: Time drains your life away. Dodge, dash, and blast through enemies and brutal bosses. Collect resources to stay alive and grow stronger through a massive skill tree, unlocking a lot of new mechanics to master. Fight Time and its Time Keepers. How long can you last?

apps.name: Tiny Harbor Demo
apps.short_description: Tiny Harbor is a cozy desktop fishing management game where you grow your fleet, discover new species, expand production and automate your harbor, all while your little world keeps running alongside whatever else you’re doing.

apps.name: To Kill a God Demo
apps.short_description: Craft your skill tree in this action roguelike where you must utilize skill and creativity to unleash devastating builds, all for one purpose. Break the Cycle. Kill a god.

apps.name: Too Many Orbs! Demo
apps.short_description: Restore a magical collection, one orb at a time. Explore an ornate hall, return scattered orbs to their shelves, reveal artwork, and unlock magical abilities. Choose what to restore in this relaxing first-person demo, with no timer and no rush.

apps.name: Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria Demo
apps.short_description: Tower defense meets alchemy: Brew flasks, throw them at your enemies to counter their special abilities, or empower your towers with them. Defend Khaldoria in a fully voiced campaign built around your magical board game. Wishlist the full game now!

apps.name: Towers of Babble Demo
apps.short_description: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.

apps.name: Toy Worlds Atlas Demo
apps.short_description: Toy Worlds Atlas is a sandbox game where you play with colours to solve riddles and discover secrets. Each level explores a philosophical topic and subverts  expectations with new colouring mechanics. Made to inspire thought, this game offers a relaxing cognitive reset.

apps.name: Traceroute Demo
apps.short_description: A network-building simulation across the cities of a nation. Lay routers and cables to design your network, balancing bandwidth and latency on a limited budget. Survive sudden traffic surges and DDoS attacks as you connect city after city, learning real networking concepts as you play.

apps.name: Trash to Trees:  Tidy up the forest! Demo
apps.short_description: Clean up, sort, recycle, and restore the forest in this cozy tidy-up simulator with over 10,000 trash items. Unlock abilities to improve your efficiency. Enjoy the satisfying experience of bringing the forest back to life at your own pace, alone or with friends.

apps.name: Travelling to Woolokii Demo
apps.short_description: Solve cases, investigate mysteries, and explore the Island of Woolok in this chapter-based Point & Click / Visual Novel.

apps.name: Tremen Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to the TREMEN demo, an immersive and hyperviolent old-school shooter with modern graphics. Fight your way through two brutalist levels while you butcher every mutant that stands in your way with a wide variety of powerful, upgradable weapons.

apps.name: Trouble in Potion High Demo
apps.short_description: Something went terribly wrong at Potion High. The school fell into the "Non-Dimension" and was placed under quarantine. If you don't break this lockdown, you'll be stuck here forever.

apps.name: Trucker Joe 2 Demo
apps.short_description: As Trucker Joe, you take control of your own freight company, buying trucks and a wide range of trailers to keep the companies’ supply chains running smoothly! Place the companies strategically on your map to avoid long hauls!

apps.name: True Nightmare - Diner Loop Demo
apps.short_description:
Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a new FBI agent, you become trapped in a looping anomaly inside a secluded roadside cafe. With every room you explore, the nightmare grows, and something relentlessly follows you.
Can you escape?

apps.name: Turbo Turkey: Feathered Frenzy! Demo
apps.short_description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this platformer inspired by Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

apps.name: Twisted Childhood Demo
apps.short_description: Remember the fairy tales you grew up with? Start corrupting them. This demo opens five tales, five different games, and Wishes to bend their rules. Criquet is already waiting for you...

apps.name: Two Dollar Suits Demo
apps.short_description: Two Dollar Suits combines the very best of the Action-Strategy genre into a fast-moving criminal playground, where players thrive in creativity and exploration. Complete intricate levels and create your own paths using skill, ingenuity, and raw power.

apps.name: UKNON Jones & Guynelk 2 Demo
apps.short_description: After Jones' friends are rescued, Jones discovers that his grandfather has mysteriously disappeared. He was looking for a mythical treasure called: "Crystal Cereal". Jones, Guynelk, Elsa and Princess Saphir decide to search for the crystal cereals to find Jones' grandfather.

apps.name: Umbra Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Umbra Survivors is a dark 3D gothic survivors-like: fight through thousands of creatures, draft rare card upgrades, and forge devastating synergies before the next wave swallows you. Multiple heroes, brutal bosses, and every level-up can twist the run.

apps.name: Unburied Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of Unburied, a dark-fantasy tower-defense roguelite for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. Raise palisades by day, hold your keep by night, turn the fight with your captain's Space counter, and survive until dawn turns the dead to ash.

apps.name: UNDEFEATED: Genesis Demo
apps.short_description: Experience the signature flight and superhero action of UNDEFEATED: Genesis. Fly freely across a section of Voltissia, wield a variety of superpowers, and face ferocious mutants. Your first step toward becoming the hero who will save this shattered world begins here.

apps.name: Under the Heavens: Warring States Saga Demo
Undermoon Demo
apps.short_description: UnderMoon is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelike RPG. Awaken in a strange moonlit town, build your hero, and climb a shifting tower. Read enemy intent, combine weapons, magic, summons, and elemental reactions, defeat deadly bosses, and uncover why everyone was brought to this world.

apps.name: Underway: Tales Of A Killer
apps.short_description:
Some might say that "Underway" is basically a boss-rush fetch-quest. And while they might be right (if ALL of the story is ignored), what if there was a version that fit that inaccurate description a bit more?

Well... Now there is. But not in the way you think...

apps.name: Undying Flame Demo
apps.short_description: Survive a minimalist wave-survival rogue-lite. Keep the fire alive. Read its flame. Defend your fire against creatures that crawl from the dark across endless waves. Every wave survived, the fire grows. Over time, it consumes everything.

apps.name: Unfanged: All fight, no bite Demo
apps.short_description: Unfanged is a 2D action-platformer where you help Dracula's  disappointing son fight back against the injustices he had to face. Jump, suck and stomp your way to the highscores! Stand against fierce boss battles, old acquaintances and new faces alike. Prove to all that dying is easy, living is hard!

apps.name: Unhappening Demo
apps.short_description: Navigate a collapsing world where light is your only protection. Solve physics-based environmental puzzles with the help of temporary companions, and survive the darkness consuming fractured memories of humanity’s final survivor. For fans of Inside, Limbo, and Little Nightmares.

apps.name: Unregistered Scene Demo
apps.short_description: Unregistered Scene is a Minesweeper-style anomaly deduction game. As Agent 03, an insurance company agent, investigate scenes where records no longer match reality. Work with a mysterious assistant to identify anomalies and uncover hidden rules.

apps.name: Unseen - Someone Demo
apps.short_description: Michael, is a 14-year-old teenager living the ordinary life of a game developer. He usually preferred to work at night because he felt the calm and special atmosphere there. At one point, he needed to leave the room at night but it seems that was a mistake...

apps.name: Unstable Nuclear Reactor Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental hex-puzzle roguelite game where you merge atoms into higher elements, trigger massive chain combos, earn radioactive coins, and manage your ring capacity to survive as long as possible.

apps.name: URIEL OS Demo
apps.short_description: URIEL OS is an audio horror game where the perspective never leaves your screen. Traverse the apocalypse while sealed inside a mechanical vehicle that barely protects you from whatever is outside. Hack devices to manipulate the environment and piece together what happened to a very different Earth.

apps.name: Vagabones Demo
apps.short_description: Vagabones is a class-based roguelike action-adventure game for 1-4 players! Battle fierce foes, play minigames, solve puzzles, and collect treasures as you venture through the Shadowmoon Kingdom to defeat the Calico King!

apps.name: Venison County Demo
apps.short_description: Grab your sawed-off, cast some sigils, and face the never ending nightmare head on in Venison County. Blast your old neighbors into undead venison giblets, master weapon specific active reloads, and limitlessly combine slain cultists' sigils for their sinful buffs (if you can withstand God's wrath).

apps.name: Verho - Curse of Faces Demo
apps.short_description:
Verho, a Dark RPG following the tradition of the King’s Field series, takes place after the catastrophic Era of Solitude. Travel to the land of Yariv, find the source of this scourge and face its dangers.
The Demo takes around 4-5h to beat.

apps.name: VERISMO Demo
apps.short_description: A ghost and a carnival clown plot revenge on the man who ruined their lives. An operatic tragedy set in 1920s Sicily. This is the 15 minute prologue demo, with a longer demo in the works.

apps.name: VIGNETTE Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person point-and-click psychological horror game. Only the areas illuminated by your flashlight change in appearance. The game progresses through quiet unease and puzzle-solving, without relying on jump scares. A demo is now available (approx. 20 minutes).

apps.name: Villa Anzuelo: El Biógrafo de Difuntos Demo
apps.short_description: Try the opening of this illustrated gothic mystery adventure. Explore, examine clues and accompany Francisco to Villa Anzuelo. This free demo ends as you enter the mansion; continue the investigation in the full game.

apps.name: VIRUS_31.EXE Demo
apps.short_description: Minimalist survivors-like built for short, snack-sized sessions. Pop enemies, earn bits, get stronger.

apps.name: Vital Decisions Demo
apps.short_description:
Take charge of a emergency room up to 8 players.
Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. 
Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

apps.name: VRocker Demo
apps.short_description: Use your body to move in any SteamVR game that uses trackpad/joystick 'free locomotion'. VRock to increase immersion, get fit, free up your hands or just to fulfil that desire to look (even more) silly in VR!

apps.name: Abyssal Merge
apps.short_description:
Abyssal Merge is a chaotic bullet heaven roguelite where multitasking is your only hope of survival.
As a lone captain in a monster-infested ocean, you must fight off waves of enemies while simultaneously catching and merging the fish in your net to unlock game-breaking weapon synergies.

apps.name: Ace Academy Tennis Manager 26
apps.short_description: Run a tennis academy: scout 13-year-old prospects whose ceiling you can't see, plan their season week by week across a 52-week tour and take them all the way to a Grand Slam title. The full game, no ads and no microtransactions.

apps.name: Achievement Fly Clicker
apps.short_description: Click flies, unlock achievements, and complete your collection. A simple and satisfying clicker designed for achievement hunters.

apps.name: Acre of Aces
apps.short_description: Click a patch, harvest a patch. Build patterns and chains and watch the numbers roll from hundreds to hundreds of millions. Power up your seed cards each night, pick relics that amplify your strategy, and grow one small field into an ever-faster harvest machine. A farming deckbuilder roguelite.

apps.name: Action & Automation
apps.short_description: Fight on the front line as a Commander in a side-scrolling action-RTS where every Nut is physical. Build self-running machines as Flux or Forge—or infiltrate and turn enemy systems against them as Shade.

apps.name: Ad Iterum
apps.short_description: Ad Iterum is a turn-based top-down 2D roguelike set in a decaying, ever-shifting world. Flesh is fragile, but you can hack it. Enhance your body, embrace mutations, or form ancient blood pacts. Descend into the depths, scavenge what’s left of humanity, and crawl back...if you can. Kill. Die. Repeat.

apps.name: AdorableCat
apps.short_description:
A cozy and relaxing desktop companion game filled with adorable cats.
Welcome a variety of cats into your family, care for them, and enjoy everyday life together.

apps.name: Adrift: Survival
apps.short_description: Adrift is a survival adventure set in a flooded world, where storms, scarcity, and the open ocean shape every choice you make while building a life afloat.

apps.name: Advancing Fronts
apps.short_description: Advancing Fronts is a real-time grand strategy game featuring procedurally generated maps and control over massive armies. Maximize your war industry and produce hundreds of units to overcome opponents in a bid for global domination.

apps.name: Aegis Defense
apps.short_description: Aegis Defense is a cyber-themed tower-defense roguelike. Draw cards to place towers and upgrades, then guide a corrupting swarm through the maze you create. Defend your core alone or team up with a friend in co-op mode.

apps.name: Aegis Vanguard
apps.short_description: Lead humanity's last hope, a squad of desperate heroes, through a grim, corrupted realm in this dark fantasy strategy roguelite. Master squad combos and grid inventory management tactics. Create builds & synergies to outsmart dangerous threats in a bleak world where our fate rests on your survival.

apps.name: After Troy
apps.short_description: After Troy is a turn-based deckbuilding game set in Greek mythology. Explore a hex map, fight enemies, recruit companions and capture cities. Each card has multiple uses. Build your deck with new actions, spells and relics, and combine their effects.

apps.name: Aftergarden
apps.short_description: Don’t just dodge—blast through the barrage. Build your firepower and push back enemy hordes in a progression-focused 2D shooter. Collect weapons and allies, rethink your formation, then sortie again. Upgrade in town and push farther next run. Quick reflexes help, but smart builds keep you advancing.

apps.name: Agama versus Bugs
apps.short_description: Meet the ever-hungry bearded dragon. However, in pursuit of her next meal, she must watch out for various traps and obstacles lurking in the terrarium. Who will win in this adventure? an ever-hungry lizard or crunchy bugs?

apps.name: Agastache Rugosa
apps.short_description: A classic Western-fantasy otome VN. Your closest friend is murdered before a curse can turn them into a monster. Hunt the killer while meeting a devoted younger man, a self-doubting baron, a beautiful apothecary, and a domineering villain.

apps.name: Age of Amelorn
apps.short_description: Recruit unique units, cast powerful spells, and conquer your enemies in a 2D fantasy strategy adventure. Tackle a challenging campaign or dive into Skirmish Mode to create and customize your own battles.

apps.name: Airstrike Protocol
apps.short_description: Fast-paced 2D roguelite shooter. Pick from 4 classes, aim with precision, and survive endless waves of enemies. Take down colossal war machines and forge devastating builds as the last line of defense.

apps.name: AL-Mafia
apps.short_description: AL-Mafia is an online social deduction game where players lie, investigate, save, silence, and vote each other out. Move through the map at night, use voice and text chat to deceive or defend yourself, and survive across maps with unique elimination systems.

apps.name: Alchemist's Aisle
apps.short_description: Scale your local alchemy shop in this cozy shop simulation game. Optimise your store layout, manage your stock, grow your space, and protect your investments from those pesky thieves.

apps.name: alda
apps.short_description: Tragedy strikes Makris, a nation built on the arts industry. Follow Alda, a high school girl, as she confronts a world in flux and the subtleties of the human heart. A new kind of linear visual novel portraying art, religion, society, ideology, and humanity with uncompromising realism.

apps.name: Algorithmage
apps.short_description: A roguelike where you fight through algorithms. This game is meant to teach the basics of algorithms while still having challenging gameplay through deck building and item optimisation. Find new items and spells to use in your algorithms and fight monsters in your way to complete your quest!

apps.name: Alien Idolz: Rhythmic Idler
apps.short_description: Alien Idolz is a 4-lane rhythm game with an incremental twist. Hit the notes, harvest love from your alien stans, and exploit the skill tree to break the stats and clear increasingly difficult tracks.

apps.name: Alien or Duck!
apps.short_description: A fast-paced alien sports arcade game! Take control of cosmic saucers, dodge dangerous obstacles, and kick a giant beach ball into your opponent's zone. Fire chaotic magic balls—fire, lightning, and fog—to sabotage your friends in multiplayer or conquer the Single Player Championship!

apps.name: Alienshire
apps.short_description: Alienshire is a tactical RTS built around short, replayable scenarios. Command your units, manage limited resources, and outsmart the enemy.

apps.name: All Will Rise
apps.short_description: The river is a god, and they killed her. It’s time for ordinary people to hold them to account. Manage your team. Mix with ecoterrorists and godmen. Build your deck, follow leads and find allies. Make your case, and win the battle for the future.

apps.name: Altered Alma
apps.short_description: Altered Alma combines the beloved classic Metroidvania formula with RPG elements, dating sim features, a slick pixel-art presentation, and a gripping story. Whether you want to beat up bad guys, find love, or just explore the beautiful cyberpunk cityscape, Neo Barcelona awaits!

apps.name: AmaTisMo
apps.short_description: A visual novel about mental health, depression, and self-love. Play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in isolation, as she begins a journey she never asked for. Every choice shapes the story. Fully accessible for blind and visually impaired players.

apps.name: Amiko Legends
apps.short_description: A creature-collecting extraction RPG where every expedition is a risk. Charm wild Amiko and fight alongside them across an untamed world shaped by your actions. Push deeper or pull out, but only what you extract is yours to keep.

apps.name: Amiss
apps.short_description: Amiss is a first-person anomaly-hunting horror set in an endless Soviet apartment block. Spot something wrong? Return to your elevator. All normal? Move on to the next. Make no mistakes, and you only go up. How long can you trust your eyes?

apps.name: Anathema Requiem
apps.short_description: Anathema Requiem is an atmospheric third-person psychological horror game where you must uncover the mystery of an abandoned cemetery where people vanish without a trace.

apps.name: Andrew Labreck's Eden Within
apps.short_description: Eden Within has fast paced, reaction based combat with a unique fighting style in a hedge maze that the player must navigate through. The embodiment of Greed has taken over the area, and he will not leave easily. Explore to find enhancements, learn to use your portals in unique ways and face Greed.

apps.name: Androfoco
apps.short_description: An FPS with SHOOTING COMBAT! Shooting your enemies a few times will not do! You must hit them with everything you've got so that they can never make it back to the stage. That is where the big money is!

apps.name: Animal Bookshop: Tidy & Sell
apps.short_description: An animal themed book organizing game with customers, shop customization, and a whole lot of tidying!

apps.name: Animal Farm
apps.short_description: A colorful online farm game about growing up and protecting others. Hatch from an egg or be born as a kitten or puppy, grow with players around the world, and become a guardian who protects the little ones on the farm.

apps.name: Animal Game
apps.short_description: A 2–4 player rogue-lite party brawler where dying makes you evolve. Pick a cute animal. Grab a weapon. Wreck your friends. The catch? Last place gets the wildest upgrades. No lead is ever safe.

apps.name: Animal Legends
apps.short_description: In this Action RPG, catch up to 45 unique pets that fight at your side! Raid dungeons, defeat bosses, build your base and defend it from enemy attacks, and face off in online 3 player Capture the Flag PvP!

apps.name: Animals Hate You
apps.short_description: This game is a 1-4 player troll game. You have to control the character to escape with friends while every animal in sight tries to snipe you. Top-down chaos, cruel traps, and places that really do not want you to leave.

apps.name: Anime Mosaic Puzzle
apps.short_description: Relax and restore 230 anime-style illustrations in this casual puzzle game. Drag square pieces into place on boards from 3x3 to 8x8, connect matching neighbors, improve your best times, and unlock Steam achievements—without time limits or fail states.

apps.name: Annie's DineInn
apps.short_description: A cooking game with cozy themed days and horror themed nights. You and your daughter are now owners of an abandoned motel and diner. Start cooking, renting rooms, and do other work to pay off the loan. But beware of the choices you make as they might come back to haunt you. (Solo developer project)

apps.name: Anomaly Center
apps.short_description: After a wave of layoffs following a murder at the mall, you step in as the night security guard. The job is simple: catch shoplifters and stop anomalies from reaching safe limits. Just remember - DAC has its eye on you.

apps.name: Anomaly Core: Hospital
apps.short_description: You are a patient. You should avoid treatment at the old hospital. The crazy doctor's strange methods raise doubts. The treatment may not go as you imagine.

apps.name: Ant Mill Inc
apps.short_description: Feed the nest. Grow the swarm. Devour the world. A dark incremental ant colony game where one ant becomes thousands. Gather food, upgrade the nest, uncover strange offerings, and fight for survival. Face the HUNGER - or become it...

apps.name: Antichrist
apps.short_description: As a journalist, you made headlines back in 2006 with a groundbreaking story. Years later, an anonymous call tied to that very event leads you to an horror house. But this house may belong to the Antichrist believed to appear at the end of days. You’re chasing a story… but it might be your last.

apps.name: Ants TD
apps.short_description: Thousands of ants race for your nest. Dig the paths they follow, block shortcuts with barricades and lure the swarm with fruit, then shoot, burn and blow it all up in a chaotic tower defense.

apps.name: Apex Armada
apps.short_description: A spaceship auto battler where you build a fleet and take on real players. Choose from 16 alien captains to lead your fleet into battle. Spend your gold on ships, guns, shields and other parts. Then watch the battles play out as you climb the ranks to become a Galactic Conqueror.

apps.name: Aphasia
apps.short_description:
Have you ever wondered what happens when we fall into a coma? Why do only some make it back?
Aphasia is a first-person horror where you’re trapped inside your own mind, with no memory of who you are.
As you explore your fractured memories, your sense of guilt won’t let you escape...

apps.name: Apparatus Inspector
apps.short_description: Apparatus Inspector is a retro OS horror simulation where you are locked underground evaluating synthetic AI robots for anomalies. Chat with infected bots, execute commands, deliver judgement, and hide from physical threats to survive your 5-day shift.

apps.name: AquaDucked!
apps.short_description: A physics puzzle game about firing a rubber duck out of a cannon and getting it home in one piece. Place hoses, trampolines and fans, aim, fire, see what happens. 270 levels across 10 worlds, golf, a climbing mode, a level editor, and a pond full of levels other people made.

apps.name: Aquarium Days
apps.short_description: Aquarium Days is a cozy fish-collecting game with 60 adorable species, 117 appearances, and 18 aquarium scenes. Keep your aquarium in a small window on your desktop, or set it as an animated wallpaper.

apps.name: Arborist
apps.short_description: Build a garden, survive the forecast, and follow a trail of birds through wild habitats in this cozy roguelike card game. Discover new cards, tools, and enchantments as you shape unique builds that keep every run feeling fresh.

apps.name: Arcade Cafe Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and run your own arcade cafe. Buy and arrange machines, welcome customers, maintain your equipment, serve food and drinks in your restaurant, expand your business, and transform a small arcade into a lively entertainment destination.

apps.name: Arcany
apps.short_description: Arcany is a cozy persistent online world set in the mysterious Realm of Gravenmoor. Train skills, explore a magical land, craft powerful items, and uncover the story behind the forgotten cataclysme.

apps.name: Ardhan
apps.short_description: Ardhan is a roguelike deckbuilder where every fight happens on a real board: minions trade, taunts hold the line, weapons break, and the deck you walk out with is never the deck you walked in with. 12 factions, 421 cards, 6 acts, Ascension 1–15 and a Daily Game shared by everyone.

apps.name: Arena of Realms
apps.short_description: Arena of Realms blends auto-battling, team building, and tournament management. Recruit fighters, train your roster, and combine equipment and relics to win a 16-team double-elimination tournament. Scout rivals, place wagers, and compete solo or in multiplayer.

apps.name: Arid Frontiers
apps.short_description: Build a frontier colony in this single-player survival sim. Assign settler duties, grow food, craft gear, manage weather and wildlife, research new skills, and explore a dangerous wilderness through expeditions, quests, and emergent stories.

apps.name: Arks of Twilight
apps.short_description: Build a warband of fairy-tale creatures in a single-player auto battler. Choose your Guide, recruit and merge cards, then arrange your formation to face seven rivals. Discover 20 factions and 300 creatures, with automatic battles and decisions between every duel.

apps.name: Armory Keeper
apps.short_description: Restore order to a massive armory solo or with friends in co-op! Find and sort over 3,000 weapons, ammunition, grenades, and military equipment scattered throughout the armory. Place every item on its correct rack and unlock abilities to organize faster and more efficiently.

apps.name: Arms & Arts
apps.short_description: A dice-rolling RPG auto-battler roguelike. Pick up a random weapon, chain your own unique skill combos, and fight your way through every enemy and adventure on the road — and above all, keep an eye on your past self.

apps.name: Army of the Potomac
apps.short_description: A digital version of the grand tactical wargame published by GMT Games and designed by Mark Herman. Second in the Civil War Heritage Series, this game includes scenarios for five individual battles covering the period of 1862 to 1864, and two campaign scenarios using eight maps from the boardgame.

apps.name: Art Shop: Tidy Up!
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person organizing game set in an art shop of rare and beautiful things. Sort 2,942 fine art supplies and artisan pieces in dozens of distinct forms, shelf by shelf, color by color, and unlock skills as the shop becomes a gallery of perfect order.

apps.name: Artificial Ambition
apps.short_description: Build an AI company from a 2017 startup into an industry leader. Hire specialists, train models, launch products, and expand your headquarters. Balance compute costs, customer demand, and investor control in a real-time management strategy game.

apps.name: Artificially Stupid
apps.short_description: Blend into a crowd of glitchy office AIs — or hunt the bugs hiding among them. A slapstick social-deduction party game for 2–16 players: copy the crowd, fake your quirks, sabotage the coffee machine, and survive the QA tester's bat.

apps.name: As Long As She Forgot
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. Play as Marlene, an 86-year-old woman preparing for her family's visit. They're coming. They always do.

apps.name: As The Leaves Fall
apps.short_description: Point-and-click adventure game with a thrilling, Native American-inspired narrative. Use your wit to solve fun and challenging puzzles as you explore and interact with the townsfolk of Birchwood Hollow and the Native reservation. Secrets will be uncovered, and truths revealed, as the leaves fall.

apps.name: Ashen Dungeon
apps.short_description:
In a world where hope has vanished, lead your expedition and survive to the very end.
Recruit your team, explore the dungeons, and secure resources to build the foundation for survival.
[Expedition Management | Dungeon Exploration | Resource Gathering&Management | Turn-Based Combat | Dice System]

apps.name: Ashen Knight
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy survivor roguelike with automatic combat, where every run starts from nothing. Unlock unique heroes, experiment with powerful skill builds, and survive relentless enemy waves.

apps.name: Ashes Of The Fallen
apps.short_description:
Ashes of the Fallen is a 2D action hack and slash RPG. Play as Arthur, a fallen warrior fighting his way out of the deepest dungeon. 
Battle deadly enemies, grow stronger, and rise to challenge the God of Time. Claim her crown and make one wish.

apps.name: Ashley AI
apps.short_description: No te pide tu atención, se la queda. Una compañera de escritorio con IA para Windows que habla contigo, te recuerda y controla tu PC de verdad ❤️.

apps.name: Ashram Online
apps.short_description: The world broke a thousand years ago and no one is coming to fix it. Ashram is a classic MMORPG with a survivalist soul: hunt, dismantle and craft every piece you wear. Gather your guild, choose your path... and claim your eternity.

apps.name: Assault Commander RTS
apps.short_description: Assault Commander RTS is a fast-paced real-time military strategy game. Fight a 30+ mission story campaign with two distinct factions, build and defend your base, command land, air and naval forces, unleash super weapons and climb the online leaderboards.

apps.name: Astra Bestiary
apps.short_description: Raise Beasts from eggs into powerful Champions in this 2D monster-raising/taming RPG. Feed, train and evolve your partners to explore a perilous, non-linear world. Master fast-paced, tactical battles, uncover the secrets of a fading world and pass on the Beasts' legacy across generations.

apps.name: Astral Echelons
apps.short_description: Shoot holes through enemy ships from your seat at the controls of a multi-gunned turret mounted on the bow of a dimension hopping spaceship in this seated VR on-rails spaceship turret shooter!

apps.name: Astral Industrial Complex
apps.short_description: A space automation game with rogue lite elements. Take the role of a rogue defense drone building up a mining and defense industry in the far reaches of space.

apps.name: Atana
apps.short_description: Atana is a female-led romance visual novel set in late 20th-century America, where you grow alongside your creator, Atana, as an AI.

apps.name: Athena and the Erotic Trap Dungeon Beyond the Forest
apps.short_description: Amorous anomalies, treacherous temptations, and a dungeon overflowing with desire threaten your and the town’s chastity! Explore, dodge, and quests your way to uncovering its secrets, or raise your Lewdness Level and surrender to sensual ruin in this Erotic Trap Dungeon RPG!

apps.name: ATOM RPG 2
apps.short_description: A New Open-World Era of ATOM Begins! 1,225 km² of the Caspian Wastes! Open-world survival game with a story-rich CRPG soul, co-op or alone, vehicles, sandbox, crafting, and strange encounters.

apps.name: Atomic Delivery
apps.short_description: The General Staff has one objective for you: build an atomic weapon aboard a nuclear bomber. Pilot through hostile skies, refine uranium, run industrial machines, assemble the bomb, keep the aircraft airborne and survive everything standing between you and the Atomic Delivery.

apps.name: Auto Battle Buddies
apps.short_description: A cozy puppet-show auto battler where you accessorize your heroes with unique gear, build powerful teams, and battle other performers on the grand stage. Customize your puppets, climb the ranks, and create the ultimate Battle Buddies squad.

apps.name: AutoArena
apps.short_description: AutoArena is a lineup-building auto-chess game. As a fortune-teller, use foresight to acquire divination cards and build your lineup. Engage in multiple rounds of battles against the traces of other fortune-tellers in the Stream of Memories, ultimately guiding yourself toward the right destiny!

apps.name: Aventureiro 95
apps.short_description: A roguelite RPG inside a retro desktop. Choose your route, build your hero with skills, loot and relics, and face bosses in automatic combat. Unlock four classes, invest in permanent upgrades and return for a new run with tougher challenges.

apps.name: Avlo the Imp Wizard
apps.short_description: Do the sickest tricks while reaching the finish line the fastest you can!

apps.name: Away From Home VN
apps.short_description: The game is an adult visual novel focusing on MILFs, cheating wives and adultery themes. Play as a college student who travels to a new city for a secret investigation. Meet women and end up getting involved in their lives.

apps.name: AXE DESCENT
apps.short_description: Over 600 skills, countless strategies. Build your own unique setup from ever-changing possibilities and venture to the deepest reaches of the Rift in this roguelite turn-based command RPG.

apps.name: Babylonian Twins
apps.short_description: The lost puzzle-platformer of ancient Babylon — made in Baghdad in 1993, back as the Definitive Edition in 2026. Freeze one twin to stone while the other dashes, drills and battles through five worlds. Includes the original 1993 Amiga game, fully playable — only on Steam.

apps.name: Backpack Dungeon Delver
apps.short_description: A challenging dungeon crawler with backpack management and turn-based combat. Fuse components to build powerful combos. From rats to demon lords, how deep can you go? Still in graybox, but already great fun!

apps.name: Backpack Seeker`s
apps.short_description: Backpack Seeker’s — a tactical RPG where your backpack decides everything! Collect, combine, and use items in unique ways to win. A living world, a nonlinear story, and hundreds of hidden mechanics await! Ready for an adventure where every item is a step to victory? 🎒⚔️

apps.name: Backrooms
apps.short_description: Escape the backrooms levels as reality warps with every step; listen, for the whispers behind the walls may guide you out. Enjoy an unbelievable co-op Backrooms experience.

apps.name: Backrooms : The Threshold
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op investigation horror game where you enter the Backrooms through an experimental gateway. Explore procedurally generated environments, document anomalies, recover valuable artifacts, and survive the unknown.

apps.name: Backrooms Anomaly Project
apps.short_description: An anomaly-spotting horror game set in the Backrooms. Explore eerie corridors, study every detail, and spot anything that shouldn't be there. Move forward when everything is normal, or turn back when something is wrong. Avoid the darkness and run when something starts chasing you.

apps.name: Backrooms Open World
apps.short_description: Welcome to the first Massively Multiplayer Open World Backrooms experience on Steam. Explore the Backrooms, fight Entities and other Players, join Factions to increase chances of survival and escape.

apps.name: Backrooms: Misstep
apps.short_description: Backrooms: Misstep is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore unsettling liminal levels, complete unique objectives, survive deadly entities, and uncover a path through environments where every wrong turn could be your last.

apps.name: BACKROOMS: PRIMAL
apps.short_description: The infinite yellow complex was created to secretly contain prehistoric specimens whose existence must never reach the public. Trapped in this glitching yellow maze with no confirmed boundary, you must evade uncontained prehistoric predators and find a way out before reality collapses around you.

apps.name: Bad Pig House
apps.short_description: A CRAZY HORROR GAME INSPIRED BY “THE THREE LITTLE PIGS”! GATHER RESOURCES, BUILD BEFORE SUNSET, AND SURVIVE THE NIGHT WITH THE WOLF!

apps.name: Bad Tides
apps.short_description: BAD TIDES is a chaotic 4 player co-op pirate adventure! Explore the seven seas, dive for treasure, upgrade your trustworthy vessel, and fight creatures of myth.

apps.name: BAKA TAO
apps.short_description: What begins as an ordinary road trip slowly takes an unsettling turn when an unexpected encounter leaves you searching for answers in the surrounding wilderness.

apps.name: Balance Due
apps.short_description: Balance Due is a solo and online co-op fantasy action game where you hunt monsters, gather loot, upgrade weapons, and return to Base Camp before time runs out. Meet each day’s gold quota, manage the shifting Due, and survive long enough to determine your ending.

apps.name: Ball Bugz
apps.short_description: Ball Bugs is an incremental defense game where you start with a single persistent ball and build up an arsenal of ball firing turrets, artillery and special ball types. Bounce, splat, upgrade and come back stronger until the bugs stop getting through.

apps.name: Ballerspiel
apps.short_description: A chaotic comic-style first- and third-person shooter full of clowns. Battle Royale, Ballerball and Clown-Off, 13 weapons including an atomic bomb, vehicles, power-ups and a world where everything breaks. Play online, on LAN without internet, or offline against bots.

apps.name: Ballzy: PvP Block Puzzle
apps.short_description: Build the longest route, solve handcrafted and community puzzles, then outthink rivals in hidden-block PvP. Ballzy is a premium pixel-art strategy puzzler with Classic, Story, Puzzle, and asynchronous Battle modes.

apps.name: Banana Life Sim
apps.short_description: Banana Life Sim is a game in which you can become a banana.

apps.name: Bananageddon
apps.short_description: Bananageddon is a roguelite in which you will have to create and adapt your equipment to defeat the hordes of animals, who will try to prevent you from getting out with the bananas harvested for your tribute!

apps.name: Bandits are Coming
apps.short_description: A low-pressure tower defense where losing costs nothing but time. Place Cowboys, Dynamite, Flamers, Snipers, and Cannons across 10 levels and 20 waves each — gold and towers always carry through a retry, so you're guaranteed to win eventually. Just build, watch, and rebuild.

apps.name: Baseline Basketball Manager 27
apps.short_description: Take control of a professional basketball organization in Baseline Basketball Manager. Build your roster, scout prospects, make trades, manage contracts, set tactics and shape your team’s future in a deep, long-term management simulation.

apps.name: Baskets and Blooms
apps.short_description: Grow what you sell and sell what you grow in this cozy, pressure-free third-person farmer's market simulator. Choose your agricultural identity, nurture your farm at your own pace, play road-trip minigames, and serve customers face-to-face as your small business blooms!

apps.name: Bastion Rivals
apps.short_description: Build your stronghold and unleash automatic armies across two lanes. Master four fantasy factions, spells and counters. Ranked and unranked 1v1/2v2 multiplayer, leaderboards and community esports tournaments are planned for launch. Practice solo against AI.

apps.name: Battle Bot Tactics
apps.short_description: An asynchronous PvP bot-building inventory management auto-battler. Build the perfect bot squad and send them to the arena to battle it out!

apps.name: Battle Brewers
apps.short_description: Battle Brewers is a 1-4 player couch party game where you are in charge of brewing potions to defend a castle in multiple chaotic levels. Brew potions that apply buffs, deal damage or spawn units, all to prevent the castle from falling to the incoming waves of different enemies!

apps.name: Battle Gaze
