apps.short_description: Battle Gaze is a fast-paced 2D retro action-adventure hack-and-slash. Master 5 unique weapons—sword, bow, deadly claws, light sword, and hay fork—unleash fluid combos, and defeat ruthless bosses across dangerous lands to reclaim your ancestral heritage!

apps.name: BattleSide
apps.short_description: BattleSide is a 5,000 player MMOFPS persistent Land, Sea, Air, and Space war game where you and your buddies defend and capture control points to gather resources for your faction in battles of endless fun.

apps.name: BazaarBorn
apps.short_description: BazaarBorn is a second-hand trading simulation. Start with a small junk cart, buy and sell used items, bargain with customers, and grow your business step by step. Make smart deals and turn small profits into bigger opportunities.

apps.name: BBBB: Block Block Boom Boom
apps.short_description: BBBB: Block Block Boom Boom is a chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek game where hiders become part of the environment while seekers blast suspicious blocks! But watch closely, hider blocks have slightly more beveled edges than ordinary blocks. Can you spot the difference?

apps.name: BEAR HORROR
apps.short_description: Real-time strategy meets dark SCP survival. Play as the self-replicating SCP-1048, also known as the Builder Bear, gather grotesque resources, mass-produce a horrifying army of teddy clones and survive against Foundation personnel.

apps.name: Beast Bastion
apps.short_description: A Roguelite auto-chess tower defense game. Recruit unique units, combine them with towers, and build synergies and builds. Defeat bosses to recruit them into your legion, and craft your ultimate roster through randomly generated runs.

apps.name: Beat Weaver
apps.short_description: 3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

apps.name: Beautiful Subordinates Kneeling Beside Hero
apps.short_description: The night shrouds a villa on the outskirts of New York. Jasper Gray returns, and beautiful subordinates such as Yasmin kneel to greet him. In daily life, they report intelligence and execute instructions, while a rift crisis is quietly approaching.

apps.name: Become Blackhole
apps.short_description: A space incremental game about getting bigger. You are a mote of dust, and every target you shatter makes you heavier. Grow from a chunk of rubble into a meteor, a moon, a planet, a star — and finally a black hole that devours everything!

apps.name: BECOME LIFE
apps.short_description:
A single-player narrative survival experience set in the abandoned landscapes of Gargano, Italy. 
Explore, endure, and uncover what happened after the disappearance where every choice leaves a mark.

apps.name: BECROWNED
apps.short_description: A non-linear survival horror drawing inspiration from the surrealist dark satire of VHS-era Horror and lurid atmosphere of classic Grindhouse cinema. Step into Richard Torrance's shoes and survive a complex web of relationships as you phase between industrial ruins and a tragic fantasy kingdom.

apps.name: Bee Shrimp Aquarium
apps.short_description: A 3D aquarium game for watching bee shrimp. Zoom in to see them graze, groom and swim, or feed them and watch them gather. Choose from 12+ aquascapes, change the lighting, and customize the shrimp's patterns, colors and sizes.

apps.name: Beeline
apps.short_description: Slash and dash through tens of thousands of enemies per run in this action roguelite. Call in the hive for support, wield up to five weapons, evolve devastating builds, and combine powerful abilities. Rescue unique bees, build your Hive, and restore your bee kingdom to survive the forces of nature.

apps.name: Beellionaire Idle
apps.short_description: In Bee-lionaire Idle, harvest your hives, process the honey, sell your products, and reinvest your profits in your farm. Unlock new equipment, boost your production, and build a honey empire starting from a single hive.

apps.name: Before it Falls
apps.short_description: Enter the long-closed St. Elora Hospital for a final technical inspection before demolition. Restore power, explore the building, and examine the records left behind. Before it Falls is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

apps.name: Bento Story
apps.short_description: Bento Story is a bento-arranging simulator with a warm story about a girl deciding her future while serving customers and sending them off with a lunch box that says more than words.

apps.name: Bet on Beta
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you run a tech company, but every sprint is decided on a slot machine. Hire coworker cards for your deck, staff them on the machine, and spin for tickets, epics, and OKRs. From garage startup to IPO.

apps.name: Betrayground
apps.short_description:
Run from the Taggers. Betray your friends. Try not to be the slowest one left behind.

Betrayground is a chaotic multiplayer party game where every map plays differently, but one rule never changes: someone has to get caught, and hopefully, it’s not you.

apps.name: Beyond Grief
apps.short_description: An action roguelike set in ancient Egypt where you battle the gods, grow absurdly powerful through build-breaking synergies, kill, die and be reborn. Earning allies, making enemies, and befriending cats along the way.

apps.name: Beyond the Masque of the Red Death
apps.short_description: Explore a gothic, macabre environment and find objects of symbolic significance, in this text-based adventure game inspired by "The Masque of the Red Death" by Edgar Allan Poe. Interact by typing your intentions in text, in an authentically written story that goes Beyond where the original one ends.

apps.name: BeyondTheBorder
apps.short_description: You have wandered into the city of Aberrants, “Helikar.” To return to the human city of “Engine,” escape the city where Aberrants roam. A horror escape game.

apps.name: Biathlon Manager
apps.short_description: Biathlon Manager is a management sim that puts you in charge of a national biathlon team. Take the helm and lead your team to glory: coach your leaders, nurture young talent, manage your staff and sponsors — and above all, follow the success of the athletes in your care.

apps.name: BIER RUSH!
apps.short_description: Carry towers of beer mugs through a packed Oktoberfest hall! Pour, stack, balance and serve: more mugs mean bigger scores and bigger spills. Chase a solo high score or play online with up to 4 players in competitive DUELL and chaotic TEAM SCHICHT co-op.

apps.name: Big Controller VR
apps.short_description: Play flat games using fun oversized controllers. Comes with 2 games included, but also works with all your desktop games that have controller support.

apps.name: Big Top
apps.short_description: Big Top is an active carnival incremental where every shot, throw, and swing earns tickets. Collect game-changing prizes, build powerful combinations, and conquer the carnival on your quest to claim the legendary Super Playbox!

apps.name: Bighorn Ramone
apps.short_description: La final de 1986 que nunca terminó. Atrapado en un traje de mascota del que no puedes escapar. Anima al público y sobrevive a una noche de terror en la cancha mientras luchas por encontrar el camino de vuelta al presente.

apps.name: Bio-Shooter
apps.short_description: Medicine vs Germs, inside the human body. Play as glowing living-gel cells and microbes with guns grown from your own body in a fast, class-based online shooter. Battle across the Eye, the Lungs and the Follicles, where blinking eyelids, breathing lungs and sweat floods reshape every fight.

apps.name: Birdie's Backyard Battle
apps.short_description: Somebody took Birdie's slipper, and she wants it BACK. Build a deck of dog tricks, chuck toys at squirrels, lawn gnomes and one very determined goose, while Cheddar the cat helps... when she feels like it. A cozy, silly roguelike deckbuilder.

apps.name: Bit Footballer: The Career
apps.short_description: You're the player — not the manager. Start on the bench at a fourth-division village ground and play your way up to the title. Every career runs in its own generated world: 74 clubs, four divisions, and a scout who sees everything.

apps.name: Bit It
apps.short_description: A two player couch-coop platformer game: Jump, Fly and Enjoy your time with your beloved one!

apps.name: BitBeasts
apps.short_description: Can you survive humanity's deadliest drones? Build your ship, evolve alien Beasts, unlock powerful talents, and fight through an ultra-hard roguelite space shooter where every run is different.

apps.name: Black Gold: Star KTV Affairs
apps.short_description: Run an adults-only KTV—an Asian-style karaoke club with private rooms—where singing often leads to less clothing! Decorate rooms, recruit beautiful staff, mix drinks, and handle fights and songs that turn into “multiplayer cardio.” Bigger rooms mean more people joining the chorus!

apps.name: Blade Dodger
apps.short_description: A 2D arcade style arena survival game. As Spiff, you will sprint, dodge, and use your special abilities to stay alive long enough to make it through different levels and challenges. Features single player, 2-4 player local co-op, and 2-4 player online multiplayer.

apps.name: Blamcon's Cyber Range
apps.short_description: A day at the range for your Light Gun. Six real range target games on an outdoor range in the woods: paper, a speed plate rack, hanging steel, pop-up targets, a dueling tree, and a Texas star. This can be played with a mouse but it is a light gun game first, best played with Blamcon light guns.

apps.name: Blockfall
apps.short_description: BLOCKFALL is a first-person shooter in a blocky, fully destructible world made to enjoy with friends. Each round, gain an upgrade of your choice from a randomly selected array to boost your odds of victory. no two matches will be the same!

apps.name: Blood Soil
apps.short_description: By day you sow. By night they come for the harvest — so you make them the harvest. Kill monsters ON your crop beds, let the soil drink their blood, and watch it grow at dawn. A brutal farming defense with a shotgun, a scythe and a year of nightmares.

apps.name: BLOODVILLE
apps.short_description: BLOODVILLE is a short first-person shooter where you play as Cane, a retired hitman dragged back into killing - and slowly losing his mind.

apps.name: BLOODY RAVE
apps.short_description: The rave is live. The vampires are real. Survive the night… if you can.

apps.name: Bloomcraft
apps.short_description: Bloomcraft is a Garden Creation Simulator. The player's goal is to create a garden that pleases the Flower Queen. The more the Flower Queen likes the garden, the more money she pays for it every second.

apps.name: Blotch
apps.short_description: Paint yourself to match the scenery and sneak past guards. Explore an island of magical paintings, help its residents save their homes, or bring friends for online hide-and-seek and Prop Hunt. Create your own maps and share them on Steam Workshop.

apps.name: Blue Ridge Hunting
apps.short_description: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game set in the Appalachian Mountains. Solo or with friends, investigate, document, and hunt cryptids based on real sightings, legends, and paranormal phenomena from the region.

apps.name: Blue Water Builders
apps.short_description: Blue Water Builders is a shipyard management and shipbuilding game set during the golden age of industry. Design, build, launch and manage your own fleet as you take a small shipyard from its humble beginnings to a major force in the world of shipbuilding. So, how far will you take your shipyard?

apps.name: Bluy Leaves Home
apps.short_description: A turn-based bullet-hell JRPG game.

apps.name: Board Dynasty
apps.short_description: Target rival buildings with disasters, race with action cards, or pass a bomb before it explodes. Board Dynasty combines property play, time travel and party modes on a 3D board. Play solo against computer rivals or with up to four local players.

apps.name: Board Kingdom
apps.short_description: 24 board games in one kingdom. Play Chess, Go, Xiangqi, Shogi, Reversi, Mancala and more against computer opponents. Learn new rules, pick your challenger and build a record in every game.

apps.name: Bomberrage
apps.short_description: Bomberrage has no classic rules - it's a fast and exciting game where you fight strong opponents or friends in explosive multiplayer battles!

apps.name: Bong N Brawl
apps.short_description: Dive into a chaotic bullet hell where every second of survival feels amazing! Packed with game-changing upgrades, wildly creative boss fights, and pure arcade fun. Dodge by a hair's breadth, unleash broken builds, and just let loose!

apps.name: Bonobros
apps.short_description: A free strategy game where both sides play at the same time. Plan three actions in secret, then watch everything resolve at once: moves, spells, duels. Take on other players in 1v1, or play solo with lessons and puzzles, including ones made by the community.

apps.name: Boris & the Second Sun
apps.short_description: Your cat borrowed eight million, built a second sun in the bathroom, and named you guarantor. An absurd comedy visual novel with dubious contracts, a bathtub republic, a turn-based solar puzzle, and three ways to survive the evening.

apps.name: Born of the Moon
apps.short_description: Trapped in the von Adelstein mansion, one of you has already made a pact with the beast. Born of the Moon is a social horror for 3-6 players. Asymmetrical roles, sabotage, and insanity mechanics are deadlier than monsters. Will you survive until dawn if you can't even trust your own ears?

apps.name: Bot Colony _redux
apps.short_description:
Use your mic or type: SAY ANYTHING—the robots understand!
In this sci-fi adventure, talk to characters in your own words and command them to manipulate the world as you hunt a spy.
Explore a tropical island where machines have real personalities and emotions. 
Total conversational freedom.

apps.name: Bound to die
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy co-op action roguelike inspired by Dark Messiah, where the environment is your deadliest weapon. Master brutal melee combat, experiment with powerful builds and synergies, and use the environment to turn every run into chaos.

apps.name: Bounty Monster Trucks
apps.short_description: Bounty Monster Truck is the game true fans have been waiting for. Design your own Monster Trucks, Make your own tracks in Arenas or Stadiums, including racing and freestyle modes, and many different truck bodies to choose from!

apps.name: BoxParty!
apps.short_description: BoxParty brings multiple online party games together in one platform. Join friends or strangers, jump into quick matches, bluff, guess, trick your opponents, and discover reimagined game modes with events, jokers, and advanced rules.

apps.name: Brain Cell
apps.short_description:
Brain Cell is a co-operative multiplayer adventure game. Play up to 4 players co-op to explore dungeons, complete puzzles, with twisting gravity physics.

Explore huge worlds with friends. Work together to complete mind bending puzzles and defeat bosses.

apps.name: Breadwinner - The Loaf Life Simulator
apps.short_description: Become the Breadwinner in this colourful 3D action-adventure! Explore strange worlds, collect crumbs and mysterious artifacts, solve objectives, avoid deadly traps and face bizarre enemies as you uncover the secrets of the Crumbverse.

apps.name: Breeze Of Adventure
apps.short_description: Travel across islands, discover powerful weapons, collect armor, complete quests for the Dawn Guild — forge your own path.

apps.name: Bribe The Brave
apps.short_description: Rule a fantasy realm where heroes don't take orders - they take bribes. Build your settlement, place gold bounties on deadly monsters, and entice autonomous warriors, rogues, and mages to fight for your cause. Expand, defend, and let coin do the commanding in this indirect-control RTS.

apps.name: Brighter than Burning
apps.short_description: A fast-paced running-focused platformer inspired by classic side-scrollers.

apps.name: Broken & Loved
apps.short_description: Broken & Loved is an interactive visual novel which tells the story of  Evangeline and Rei, two university students entangling their lives in a love story fill with reflection, drama, sweetness and happiness.

apps.name: Broken Build Simulator
apps.short_description: Love roguelites? Well so do I! So I made a game that combines them all, with modes like 20 Minutes Till Lunch and Vampire Revivers. Blast away at ridiculous monsters in this highly detailed and accurate simulation of what playing a video game is like.

apps.name: Brownie's Adventure: The Final Resolution
apps.short_description: An incompetent wizard is tasked with stopping a recently awakened evil entity that just so happens to be trapped inside a (deeply suspiciously heavy) spoon. What follows is a sprawling, absurd 1990s-style point-and-click comedy adventure across bizarre fantasy realms and also North Derbyshire.

apps.name: Brush Rush
apps.short_description: Paint your own parkour path to escape in this new "Brush Rush" multiplayer, casual, tag game! Runners try to escape by painting 3D paths around a parkour map to hide from the chasers who get super human movement, a paint shotgun, and a pair of boxing gloves. Public matches and streaming is welcome!

apps.name: Brutal Magic
apps.short_description: Master devastating elemental magic in this fast-paced third-person fighting game. Chain explosive spells, outplay your opponent, and unleash spectacular magical combat in a visually stunning fantasy world. 1v1 duels where one hit ends the round.

apps.name: Bubble Hunters
apps.short_description: Pop bubbles, dodge danger and master 100 handcrafted levels in this colorful 2D arcade platformer. Play solo or team up with a friend in online co-op, then chase high scores in Survival and Marathon modes.

apps.name: Buffet Simulator
apps.short_description:
Build your buffet empire! Grow your restaurant from the ground up and expand to become the biggest buffet by yourself or in co-op with up to 4 players. 

Handle the cooking, cleaning, customers, and staffing as you create the most expansive menu possible!

apps.name: Bug Fix Billionaire
apps.short_description: Build the most successful video game store in town! Develop your own games, stock your shelves with the latest hits, and grow your small shop into the ultimate gaming empire with employees, an esports team, loot boxes, and much more.

apps.name: Bugs & Birdies
apps.short_description: A cozy survival sandbox with teeth – alone or in online co-op for up to four players. Explore a world of pixel islands, build your farmstead, raise an army of hens and hold the fences together when the beetles come at night.

apps.name: Buildot
apps.short_description: Help Buildot save the world of Godot from the tyranny of the Unreal Union! Solve clever puzzles using diodes, logic gates, and conveyor belts. Beware of slippery surfaces and ice, where a single move can change everything. Full version planned to include 100 levels plus extra challenges!

apps.name: Bull Run
apps.short_description: Trade stocks, short the market, and outsmart AI rivals. Play a match, a 13-scenario campaign, the Daily Challenge, or a Career from your mom's basement. Online with friends on Steam.

apps.name: Bullet Factory
apps.short_description: A factory that makes bullets, turrets that fire them, and a horde of living scrap that wants your metal. Design your ammo module by module, from junkyard tinkering to the far future, coached over the radio by Granny Odette.

apps.name: Bullet Glory
apps.short_description: A neon arena score-attack shooter. Clear bullet storms, unlock 12 ships with distinct specials, team up in local co-op, and study leaderboard replays to push your score higher.

apps.name: Bullet Hell Zombies
apps.short_description: Bullet Hell Zombies is a 1-4 player online co-op bullet hell roguelike! Survive waves of enemies round after round, earn cash with every landed shot, and spend wisely to open up the procedurally generated map!

apps.name: Bullets & Boletes
apps.short_description: Single-player tactical FPS extraction game where you loot materials and mission items that help you progress through a mysterious main story.

apps.name: BumpBall
apps.short_description: BumpBall is a turn-based multiplayer football game where you plan your moves, predict your opponents and launch your entire team at once. Master unique squads and abilities in fast, chaotic 4v4 matches.

apps.name: Bunny Hopper VR
apps.short_description: Bunny Hopper VR is a fast-paced VR platformer combining parkour, wall-running, precision jumps, and target shooting. Race through futuristic obstacle courses, master your movement, and hit targets on the go. Every second counts!

apps.name: Burger Shooter
apps.short_description: Your burger was stolen. Now everyone pays. Dash through fast-paced retro-inspired levels, chain kills to survive, unlock new weapons and upgrades, battle dangerous mafia enemies, and fight your way to the final boss in this adrenaline-fueled FPS.

apps.name: BURN THE WITCH
apps.short_description:
THEY TOLD ME TO MAKE THE BURN THE WITCH.  ROGUELIKE IN THE DARK FANTASY SETTING.
I'M NOT AGAINST IT

apps.name: Business is Blooming
apps.short_description: Grow and sell flowers with the help of magical books to make ends meet in this cozy strategic rouguelike. Create synergistic combos with multiple flowers, books and other items and mechanics at your disposal to survive the ever increasing economy.

apps.name: BUSINGO
apps.short_description: 1-4 player co-op survival game set entirely on a moving bus. Drive, repair, and defend your vehicle from a pursuing cartel while navigating an infinite, procedurally generated desert.

apps.name: But in briefs
apps.short_description: Reach the exit… until it runs away, everything collapses, and your pants catch fire. Six zones of chaos in a minimalist platformer.

apps.name: Campsite
apps.short_description: Warm nights in the evergreen forest, the peace and quiet, the gentle flicker of fire. Too quiet, almost unnatural. Something sinister lurks in the dark. It's faster than you, it's smarter than you, and it wants you out of it's forest. Your only hope to keep the flames from hollowing. Good luck.

apps.name: Campsite Architect
apps.short_description: Build and manage a seaside holiday park. From a simple campground with a bar to luxurious bungalows with a restaurant: you decide what your park looks like. You play as the owner and walk around the park yourself. Every guest and staff member has their own personality, needs and preferences.

apps.name: Can 'Em All
apps.short_description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

apps.name: Candy Factory
apps.short_description: Build a candy factory on a cake island floating in the clouds. Mould candies, flavour them, top them and send them by road to the Candy Carousel. Chain 59 works into ever sweeter recipes, spin the reward machine, weather gumball storms and sugar quakes, and finish the carousel in five ages.

apps.name: Canvas Attack!
apps.short_description: Step into the bohemian world of early 20th-century France in Canvas Attack! This roguelike deckbuilder transforms the act of painting into a tactical puzzle battle. Fill empty canvas cells before despair overwhelms you, and juggle your finances and sanity to survive.

apps.name: Capital Criminal
apps.short_description: Start in debt. Build an underworld empire in this retro economic strategy game. Buy low, trade across 12 cities and weigh police, gang and debt risks. Reinvest in longer campaigns and grow your fortune before the deadline: 30, 90 or 365 days.

apps.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
apps.short_description: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

apps.name: Caracol - Wars of Religion in the 17th Century
apps.short_description: Simultaneous turn-based strategy (WeGo) set in the age of the Wars of Religion and pike-and-shot warfare.

apps.name: Card Duel: Black Rite 卡牌决斗：黑暗仪式
apps.short_description: Card Duel: Black Rite is a lightweight card roguelike built around Texas Hold'em hand-ranking duels. Use a wide variety of magic cards to rewrite the hand, strengthen your deck, choose among different fates, and ultimately win this dark duel.

apps.name: Card Survival: The Slacker’s Life
apps.short_description: "Card Survival: The Slacker’s Life" is a card-stacking + urban survival simulation game.

apps.name: CardCraft Champions
apps.short_description: A unique roguelike deckbuilding auto battler with many strategic choices. Customize your cards and discover powerful combinations.

apps.name: Carnamole
apps.short_description: You are stuck in a hellish carnival where you are forced to play whack-a-mole to survive. Your captors seem to enjoy making you suffer. Will you survive in this hell hole?

apps.name: Carnival: Tidy Up!
apps.short_description: Carnival: Tidy Up! is a cozy fairground restoration sim. Recycle 75,928 pieces of junk, hunt down missing parts, and repair the attractions. Bring the amusement park back to its former glory, then sit back and enjoy the rides!

apps.name: Carry the Pack Rack
apps.short_description: One car, two drivers! Team up where one controls the steering wheel and the other handles the gas. Overcome obstacles through perfect coordination. Enjoy the chaos with local or online co-op. Can you reach the finish line without crashing?

apps.name: Carte Blanche
apps.short_description: Carte Blanche is an original adventure and card game in a fantastic world with the style of Japanese animes. Travel the world in search of the Cards. Collect them, develop them to participate in the Tournaments of the game. Discover the fabulous story of two children who love each other.

apps.name: Cartomancy
apps.short_description:
Turn-based RPG style experience with emphasis on RNG and hints of team building strategy. Uncover a metaphysical mystery from an unlikely inheritance. Cipher the code and face the powers that may be.

This isn't just a game, It's an initiation.

apps.name: CARVEGRAM
apps.short_description: Carvegram is a satisfying puzzle game where you carve cute miniature figurines out of blocks. Inspired by 3D nonograms: use the numbers on each line to work out what to break and what to paint in this meditative brain-buster with over 300 puzzles that's easy to learn but hard to put down.

apps.name: CarveLight
apps.short_description: CarveLight is a turn-based multiplayer artillery game fought on fully destructible terrain. Take turns piloting physics-driven cars, carve the battlefield apart with lasers, grenades, and force fields, and be the last one driving. Play solo, on the couch, or online.

apps.name: Castillon
apps.short_description: Castillon is an RTS + TD base-building strategy hybrid. Gather resources, explore and fortify your defenses during the day. Then survive waves of enemies attacks through the night. Level up, improve your stats, and master 4 schools of magic to become the ultimate wizard warrior.

apps.name: Castlefolk
apps.short_description: Build a medieval kingdom from a small settlement, gather resources, recruit an army, battle dangerous creatures, and expand your realm across a charming pixel-art world.

apps.name: Castronauts
apps.short_description: Castronauts is a 2D co-op extraction game about hauling alien fish out of dangerous worlds. Assemble a team of up to 6 players to fish together, explore procedurally generated areas, and survive encounters with hostile creatures before the planet collapses around you.

apps.name: Cat-Astrophy
apps.short_description: Cat-Astrophy is a fast-paced Action Roguelite that combines frantic combat, precision platforming and unique builds across procedurally generated planets. Every run offers new ways to play, death is permanent. Can you survive the cat-astrophe?

apps.name: Catalyst Core
apps.short_description: A grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where every move sets up your next reaction. Build your deck, collect Elemental Cores and chain powerful elemental combos to defeat your enemies.

apps.name: Cats Love Cakes
apps.short_description: Run a cozy bakery for cats! Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, serve your feline customers, and uncover six interconnected stories, each told from the perspective of a different cat.

apps.name: Caution Ahead: Part 3
apps.short_description: Descend into darkness as John, a search and rescue officer, reaches the final destination of his journey. Explore claustrophobic mines in this horror experience that blends atmospheric exploration with stealth-based survival.

apps.name: Celestial Routes
apps.short_description: A third-person space survival game where seamless planet landings meet debt, fuel costs, fines, taxes, base ownership, and rebellion.

apps.name: Cenk The Chopper
apps.short_description: Cenk The Chopper is a fast paced hack-and-slash game. Fight through hordes of mutants and robots in a world you've made go to hell. Chop 'em up everything you see till the end of it.

apps.name: Cereal Soup
apps.short_description: Cereal Soup is an MMO-style animal roleplaying game set in the dangerous and strange world of Primordial. Take the role of a completely unique character that grows as you do. Join a tribe, become skilled, make new friends, and change the world; together, for you are never alone.

apps.name: Ceto-7
apps.short_description: Ceto-7 is a single-player underwater survival horror. Play as a salvage diver navigating a flooded alien mining facility, hunted by an apex predator, and hired to destroy sensitive corporate data. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to ignore what you've been hired to bury.

apps.name: Chad Billionaire
apps.short_description: Start broke. Work terrible jobs. Put that cash to work in real estate, businesses, stocks, acquisitions, and crypto until working for money becomes somebody else's problem. The numbers are exaggerated. The financial logic underneath them isn't.

apps.name: Chaos Cinema
apps.short_description: Take over a run-down cinema and bring it back to life. Sell tickets, schedule movies, serve snacks and drinks, manage supplies, clean up the chaos and improve your cinema step by step.

apps.name: Chaos Company🔥
apps.short_description: Third-person 2.5D action roguelike where mercenaries fight undeads, monsters, and heretics for money. Take deadly contracts, survive brutal combat, collect loot, and grow stronger with every run.

apps.name: Chaos Protocol
apps.short_description: Chaos Protocol is a horror TPS game currently being developed by a solo developer. Players must destroy enemies and corrupted Cores to cleanse the area.

apps.name: Chaotic Dungeon
apps.short_description: Chaotic Dungeon is a pixel-style side-scrolling action Roguelite game. Players adventure through multiple dungeons with different styles and worldviews, using collected props and items to defeat enemies, solve puzzles, and defeat bosses!

apps.name: Charming Blood: Twelve days
apps.short_description: Embrace darkness as an unwitting vampire in this choice-driven romance. Navigate ancient powers, brewing conflicts, and passionate relationships with four captivating vampires who could become your greatest allies – or something more. When night falls, will you surrender to its dangers?

apps.name: Cheap Car Repair: Welcome to Nowhere
apps.short_description: Meet the local mechanic from the village of "Bumfuck Nowhere". Run your own car repair shop, hustle and cut corners however you can, but be careful! You probably don't want to get on the bad side of the local businessman, Christopher Kingman...

apps.name: Checkmage!
apps.short_description:
A chess-based strategy game with casual deckbuilding elements.
Build your deck by trading cards and battling lovable, hand-drawn characters.

apps.name: Chess Fantasy
apps.short_description: Chess Fantasy is a 3D chess game where you customize the world around you. Play classic chess or evolve the rules into your own game modes, online or with friends. Battle rivals and complete challenges to unlock new pieces, and build a place that truly feels like home.

apps.name: Chess of the Hidden Gates
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a Chinese chess move: the horse leaps, the cannon fires over a screen, the pawn crosses the river and never turns back. Every enemy strike marks its target square first. Step aside and it misses. Breach the Eight Gates. Play, or be taken.

apps.name: Chess Pit
apps.short_description: Two teams. One giant chessboard. Every kill earns your team a move, then you climb inside a hundred-foot chess piece and drive it across the arena, crushing anyone where it lands. Real-time chess with no turns, no waiting, and a whole lot of gunfire. Take the enemy king to win.

apps.name: ChessDeck
apps.short_description: A tense chess roguelike deckbuilder. Draw cards to deploy pieces and move them with real chess moves, break the enemy garrison, and hold your back row against attacks you can see coming. Every piece you lose comes back to haunt your deck.

apps.name: Chimpanik
apps.short_description: Chimpanik is a chaotic PvP party game where your voice is your only weapon! Play as an armless monkey, scream into your microphone to unleash shockwaves, and battle up to 8 other players in randomly generated arenas. Anything can happen!

apps.name: Chimpy Protects
apps.short_description: At night you feel something ominous, you must be courageous and brave to find Chimpy. Something is watching and spirits are haunting you but Chimpy will protect, the soothing light will guide you and he will finally help you sleep.

apps.name: Chinese Childhood
apps.short_description: School’s out. Play a round of marbles, stop for snacks, and head home when Mum calls. Be a boy or girl in a small Chinese town around 1998, with friends to meet, holidays to spend with family, and trips beyond the neighborhood.

apps.name: ChipWits Worlds
apps.short_description: Colony Sim. Assembly Required. Program real 1980s 65C02 microprocessors inside cute 8-bit robots to mine crystals, fortify your base, and survive a lethal alien planet where every clock cycle burns watts. Tweak starter code, write your own OS, or flash boot disks.

apps.name: Chrono Commander
apps.short_description: Chrono Commander is a real-time strategy wargame (RTS) with time travel in 3.5 dimensions.

apps.name: Cinderpeak
apps.short_description: Carry the last flame up a mountain that has gone dark. Cinderpeak is a hard, precise 2D platformer: jump, climb and dash through ten chapters, each with its own rule, with a flame on your head that is starting to remember who put it out.

apps.name: Cinema Deals
apps.short_description: Play as a cashier in a cinema theater! Take orders, print movie tickets, prepare popcorn, drinks and more! And don't forget today's deals!

apps.name: Cinema Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build and manage your own cinema empire in Cinema Tycoon. License movies, plan screenings, hire and train staff, run the food court, launch marketing campaigns, compete with rival cinemas, expand to new locations, and grow your reputation on the way to becoming the best cinema owner in the world.

apps.name: Cinnaboi Baked Brawl
apps.short_description: A flavorful 2D brawler starring Cinnaboi and his crew of food warriors. Fight through interactive kitchens and diners, master unique movesets, and take on friends or foes in PvP, co‑op, or online play. Animated story scenes reveal Cinnaboi’s origins in this chaotic culinary adventure.

apps.name: Circular Fever
apps.short_description: A Classic 4-Key Rhythm Game - Easy to Learn, Hard to Master

apps.name: CityGenesis
apps.short_description: CityGenesis is an authentic city-building simulation where you nurture a living economy. As the ruler of a small city-state, develop your city’s industries and lead your citizens to prosperity.

apps.name: Clanker Buster
apps.short_description: Build an armed truck, wire your weapons and command your crew in this action roguelike. Raid machine-controlled ruins for supplies and survivors, bring them back to humanity’s last settlement, and unlock permanent abilities for your next expedition.

apps.name: CLASHROIDS
apps.short_description: 50 players. One arena. Instant chaos. A fast-paced PvP twist on Asteroids: blast rocks for resources, claim territory hex by hex, defend it with laser turrets, and upgrade your ship mid-battle — while wormholes, comets and a black hole reshape every fight.

apps.name: Claw and Conjure
apps.short_description: Claw and Conjure is an async PvP auto-battler with fantasy RPG flair. Upgrade your town to synergize with your build, then race into battle against real players. Hire assassins, deploy traps, and resurrect exploding minions as you climb the global leaderboards.

apps.name: Clay Rumble
apps.short_description: Claymation wrestling with hand-sculpted clay fighters. Punch, bodyslam, dive off the top rope, grab the folding chair and settle it outside the ring. Couch brawls for two, six-fighter Clay Rumbles, tag team chaos and tournaments.

apps.name: Clayborn Idle
apps.short_description: Forge legendary gear, shape its stats, and chase the ideal build in Clayborn Idle – an incremental ARPG where semi-turn-based combat collides with a deep progression system. Build game-breaking combinations, grow your utility skills, and master a world shaped by both battle and craftsmanship.

apps.name: Cleanup Unit
apps.short_description: A first-person co-op horror-cleaning game where you explore procedurally generated museums, collect rubbish, scrub filthy floors and walls, manage your power, upgrade your cleaning gear, and survive the monsters stalking the exhibits.

apps.name: Clear the Snow
apps.short_description: Play with up to 4 friends and help clear the city of snow. Work together using shovels, snow blowers, and heavy machinery to complete jobs and upgrade your gear. Enjoy cozy winter vibes, and the freedom to play your own way!

apps.name: Click Flip
apps.short_description: Click Flip is a short incremental game about clicking tiles, earning points, buying upgrades, and causing crazy tile combos.

apps.name: Clogwork
apps.short_description: CLOGWORK is a factory automation game. Cut, glue and rotate pieces into the shapes you need. Build conveyor belts and logic circuits, prevent jams, and deliver finished shapes to the Core. Build in 2D, or switch to 3D at any time.

apps.name: Clone Clicker
apps.short_description: Build the clone empire of your dreams. Assign clones to do jobs, increasing your productivity and amassing even more riches with which you may create more clones. Reach for the stars and take the universe (and more) into your clutches.

apps.name: Clone. Optimize. Sacrifice.
apps.short_description: Build a city of science and magic, power up cloned heroes through automated dungeons, inherit their strength through cloning, and recycle the rest for science in this casual idle city-builder with deep RPG progression and competitive auto-battle leagues.

apps.name: Cloud Infusion
apps.short_description: Cloud Infusion is a casual social multiplayer game centered on free, rule-free play. With warm minimalist hand-drawn art and a unique “IV drip” recovery mechanic, it delivers a lighthearted, fun multiplayer experience that embodies gentle courage toward life, companionship, and overcoming hardship.

apps.name: CLOUD PATROL
apps.short_description: Fly across floating islands, hold off swarming drones, and face down three colossal bosses. Earn coins, unlock stronger firepower, and climb the endless Ascension ladder. This sky is yours to guard. Dive into a fast, exhilarating wave-based first-person aerial shooter.

apps.name: CluckFront
apps.short_description: CluckFront is a top-down PvP looter-shooter featuring mutant chickens as the main characters. Choose your combat elevation: hold your ground on a specific tier or storm the heights. Select from a variety of Makeshift weapons, and various maps, and three game modes—either on online or via LAN

apps.name: Coastal Cargo
apps.short_description: Coastal Cargo is a strategy simulation game about becoming the world's best Naval Logistician. Chart trade routes between ports in a sprawling archipelago. Drop boats, start transporting cargo, and earn your rewards. How long can your empire last in this ever more challenging environment?

apps.name: Cocaine Smuggler
apps.short_description: Smuggle illegal cargo across dangerous waters, evade the Coast Guard and DEA, upgrade your planes and boats, and make it home with the cash.

apps.name: COILBREAKER
apps.short_description: A survivor roguelite where you steer a scrap-metal snake through hordes of machines. Its weapons fire on their own, and where they sit on the head, body or tail changes how they fire.

apps.name: Cold Response
apps.short_description: Explore and survive a war torn Sweden through the eyes of an unknown soldier, alone or with friends.

apps.name: Computer Sillow: Jobcersize
apps.short_description: The Computerian-Workplace-Initative! Need a Job? Need some Excersize? You need some Jobcersize!

apps.name: Concrete Coffin
apps.short_description: The surface is gone. 11,581 survivors are crammed into an unfinished 10,000-capacity bunker. Balance 6 core resources, make critical choices on advisor reports, manage your workforce, and keep the shelter from collapsing.

apps.name: CONDEMNED: Nightfall
apps.short_description: Survival horror set in a dark 1950's NYC. In this social deduction tactical RPG, a curse has fractured a gathering of guests. Will you fight to survive the night as an *Innocent*, or embrace the shadows and hunt your peers as *The Cursed*? Uncover the truth to survive.

apps.name: Condotta
apps.short_description: Lead a fifteenth-century mercenary company in Condotta, a historical tactical roguelike. Hire fighters, command them in turn-based battles, and decide what trouble to take on as you travel. Fulfill your contract—and live to collect your pay.

apps.name: Console Repair Simulator
apps.short_description: Inherit your uncle's dusty console shop on a Tokyo back street. Sell new hardware, haggle for used consoles, then open them up on the repair mat: unscrew every screw, find the fault, swap the part, power on. Restore, grade, resell, and turn the top floor into a 90s Game Saloon.

apps.name: Containment Shift Company
apps.short_description: Run a supernatural factory alone or with up to 9 friends. Care for unpredictable creatures, turn their materials into goods, and meet rising company quotas. Haul cargo, monitor the facility, and survive blackouts and containment breaches together.

apps.name: CookTopia：料理乌托邦
apps.short_description: A cozy simulation game blending farming, animal care, and cooking. it invites you to a cheerful, colorful world where you shape your utopia through a simple yet dynamic economy. Enjoy quick, satisfying gameplay sessions as you grow crops, cook dishes, and build your dream community!

apps.name: Core Awakening
apps.short_description: A top-down retro rogue-like. Explore a world that is slowly being corrupted by an unknown entity. Play solo or up to 4-players. Pick a class and discover, collect and modify dozens of different guns, abilities and upgrades. Find the source of Corruption and stop it from spreading.

apps.name: Core Logistics
apps.short_description: Core Logistics is a management sim about growing a transport company from a single van into a network across the whole map. Choose which contracts to take, match the right trucks and licenses to each load, and chain jobs together to cut empty driving. When you need to think, hit pause.

apps.name: Corner Cutters
apps.short_description: Top-down racing with real racecraft. Brake late, look after your tyres, call your pit stop and hold off a field of twenty in the rain. Race open-wheelers, GT cars and one very small roadster on eleven circuits, run a championship of your own, or race friends online.

apps.name: Cosmic Clicker
apps.short_description: Build a cosmic energy empire in this colorful incremental sci-fi game. Click, automate production, unlock technologies, explore distant planets, collect artifacts, raise cosmic pets, and ascend to unlock permanent upgrades.

apps.name: Cosmic Dominion
apps.short_description: Fly your flagship in fast 2D dogfights, then win the galaxy world by world: settle ruins, buy neutral markets, breach and board enemy planets. A guided tutorial, a ten-level campaign, endless scenarios and 13 factions that each fight their own way.

apps.name: Couch Pirates
apps.short_description: Couch Pirates! is an easy to play local Wi-Fi party game that allows anyone to play using their phone or gamepad! Chose among four mini-games to battle it out on one desert island. The game is endless, and people may join and leave as they please throughout the evening.

apps.name: Council & Conflict
apps.short_description: Assume the role of a national leader in an original world of competing powers, and steer your country through diplomacy, trade, internal politics, and war as crises test your ability to hold the state together and shape the world order. How will you lead?

apps.name: Coup de Grass
apps.short_description: Start with a single sickle and a small field. Cut and sell grass, automate your workforce, optimize supply chains, and build a sprawling incremental empire.

apps.name: CourseCraze
apps.short_description: Hover at high speed through loops, halfpipes and wall rides. Chase gold medals, hunt your own ghost, build tracks, share them on the Workshop.

apps.name: Cover Up!
apps.short_description: Hide in plain sight. Cover Up! is an online 30-players hide-and-seek where you are the camouflage: paint your body to melt into the world, hold your nerve as seekers stalk past, and win by being invisible in full view.

apps.name: Cowgirl Milk Cafe
apps.short_description: You came to town to sell berries, but ended up managing a café with charming cow girls! Mix delicious cocktails, save the café from going under, and grow closer to your staff — and their attractive boss. Who knew a new job could change your life so much?

apps.name: Cozy Crest
apps.short_description: Awaken ancient elemental powers, shape your home, and help villagers bring their island back to life. Settle into this cozy open-world life sim, solo or with up to three friends.

apps.name: CrackBound
apps.short_description: CrackBound is a 3D tabletop companion game based around gem generation and automation. Produce ores, watch stones move on conveyor belts, earn money and develop your growing industrial facility.

apps.name: Crash Protocol: The Wrong Directive
apps.short_description: Outsmart malfunctioning robots in a turn-based grid strategy game. Lure them into collisions, use tactical bonuses and Safe Teleport, and master 50 fixed campaign levels, endless Survival waves and a separate ASCII Classic mode.

apps.name: Creature Lab 2
apps.short_description: Conquer the world in the name of science! Study DNA, create mutagens, and grow mutated limbs to design your own monsters. Send them on missions across the globe, spread panic, collect bodies, samples, and chemicals, then use them in your next experiments.

apps.name: Creej's Corruption
apps.short_description: Creej's Corruption is a Combat Based First-Person Action RPG set in a pre-apocalyptic suburban town. When reuniting with your family, an ominous building in the distance suddenly collapses causing a massive chain of events. Your brother has been taken. You're the only one who can save him.

apps.name: Creepy Meal
apps.short_description:
Creepy Meal is a co-op exploration, survival, and cooking game where absolutely nothing is safe.
Players must explore mysterious locations, collect  ingredients, drag them back, and cook them into high-value dishes and try not to become part of the menu.

apps.name: Crime Empire Idle
apps.short_description: Build your criminal dynasty in a deep idle/incremental game. Run crimes, launder dirty cash, upgrade your empire, use the black market, craft weapons & gear to fight criminal opponents while you balance heat and notoriety.

apps.name: Crimson Monarch
apps.short_description: A modern vampire political narrative where every choice reshapes the city. Rule the Crimson Council, navigate faction intrigue, and survive personal stories of hunger, secrecy, and power in a reactive, state‑driven world.

apps.name: CRIMVEIL
apps.short_description: CRIMVEIL is a 2D dark fantasy action-survival game. Fight monsters, unleash and upgrade skills, craft weapons, armor, and potions to protect the ancient ring from the black-armored invaders trying to destroy the barrier.

apps.name: Croakspire
apps.short_description: Dive into a fortress labyrinth crawling with monsters, defending yourself with your... tongue? As a frog, it's your best bet to traverse this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania title. Collect treasures to gain permanent upgrades, discovering new areas of the massive interconnected map with them!

apps.name: Crooklock
apps.short_description: You're in a stolen ship, your turret is stuck in one position, and you have the entire Galactic Federation breathing down your neck. An 80's styled shmup that has you shooting and running from the law across fifty nail-biting stages. Can you beat the odds... and your high score?

apps.name: Cropocalypse
apps.short_description: Plant. Grow. Harvest. Outplay. A farming party game for one to four farmers on one field. Spread your roots to wall off rivals, haul your harvest home, raid their stores and guard yours from foxes and bears. When the market bell rings, the farmer who sells the most wins.

apps.name: Crossroads: Forgotten Paths
apps.short_description:
A light-hearted adventure that whisks you around the micro-fantasy land of Bargvia, join The Mages Guild, meet The First Mage,
explore The Undercroft, engage with colourful locals and grind in enemy-filled Micro-Dungeons.

apps.name: Crown of Time
apps.short_description: Rebuild a forgotten kingdom in this dark-fantasy idle RPG. Gather and craft by hand, command Echoes to work while you’re away, and explore Past, Present, and Future. Fight the guardians by hand, gather the crown’s three fragments, and reach the one place that stands outside time.

apps.name: Crownmason
apps.short_description: Crownmason is a turn-based, castle-building autobattler: armies fight on their own, and only a dead king ends the match. Seven factions, a card draft, and matches against the AI, on LAN or online.

apps.name: Crownslayers
apps.short_description: Crownslayers is a roguelite turn-based roleplaying game, where you get to control two teams of heroes across separate timelines. Battle your way through a series of universes, bending time and space to affect multiple timelines, and future playthroughs!

apps.name: CRUD
apps.short_description: CRUD is an MMO survival horror RPG set in a world devastated by an epidemic. Explore abandoned cities, restore vehicles, build your crew, and raid other players' shelters for valuable resources and gear. There are no truly safe places here - only the people you've chosen to trust.

apps.name: Crumbeats
apps.short_description: Revive a silent speaker and rebuild the beat in this music-driven incremental arcade game. Shatter Crumbs, collect Echoes, unlock instruments, and stack upgrades into an evolving groove.

apps.name: Crystal Ascend
apps.short_description: A simple incremental game where you nurture crystal elementals by destroying floating crystals and harvesting aether. Upgrade the skill tree, unlock new abilities to gather resources faster, and build your ultimate crystal companions.

apps.name: CTRL Chaos
apps.short_description: 15 singleplayer minigames. Different rules. Total chaos. Blast hooligans with a water cannon, fight space swarms, solve cargo puzzles, build a tower, or grow a garden. Pick your next challenge or play a series.

apps.name: Cubalance
apps.short_description: In this physics-based puzzler, color matching is only half the battle. Balance scales or launch cubes across the screen with weight-shifting chain reactions. Do you think you’re a master of logic? Meet Gravity. Let’s see how you handle the pressure when the floor starts tipping.

apps.name: Cube Sweeper
apps.short_description: Cube Sweeper is a casual relaxing puzzle game. All you have to do is work out which cubes are red and which cubes are empty. Numbers show how many adjacent cubes are red and from that information you can solve all the levels in the game without guessing.

apps.name: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper
apps.short_description: Classic Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Orbit each board and read the numbers around corners and down through tunnels. Every board is guaranteed solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Dig for hidden gems and climb from your first click to Expert.

apps.name: CubeMate
apps.short_description: Chess meets the Rubik's Cube. Rotate a 3D cube until every face satisfies a chess challenge: check, checkmate, advantage, equality or a classic solve. 22-level campaign from 2×2 to 5×5, Free Play up to 7×7, a Daily puzzle and shareable seeds.

apps.name: Cubie
apps.short_description: CUBIE is a minimalist puzzle platformer where you control gravity. Each side of the cube offers unique physics based on how you enter it. The world remains the same – only your perspective changes. Can you solve spatial puzzles in a labyrinth where "up" is just a relative term?

apps.name: Cubito World
apps.short_description: Your base awaits! Play solo or with up to 4 players to craft, build, farm, and fly. Solve puzzles, hunt hot air balloons, raise animals, and so much more!

apps.name: Cubounce 弹射方块
apps.short_description: CUBOUNCE is a high-speed physics-based platformer. Launch and swing through challenging levels with precise controls and extreme momentum.

apps.name: Cult of Echoes
apps.short_description: Use echolocation to hunt your friends down in an asymmetrical horror game where sound is everything!

apps.name: Cult of the Red Heifer
apps.short_description: Horror RPG FPS set in a dystopian United States controlled by a fanatical cult determined to create the perfect Red Heifer. Play as the Firestarter, a normal person who has decided to resist the Cult against all odds

apps.name: Curiosmos
apps.short_description: Curiosmos is a whimsical space sim where you shape your own solar system by crafting planets, gravity, atmosphere, and life! Embark on an adventure to discover the secrets of the universe in this charming ode to outer space ✶

apps.name: Cursed Dungeon Raider
apps.short_description: Embark on an exploration adventure with spooky and horror elements, tasked with recovering real historical artifacts from excavation sites around the world. Beware of local traps and monsters inspired by the mythology of each region.

apps.name: Curvelicious 2
apps.short_description: The classic curve game, rebuilt in 3D as a party game for 2 to 4 on one screen or up to 8 online. Your Curve never stops and leaves a solid trail. Box your friends in, blast gaps through their trails and be the last one alive.

apps.name: Cyber Siege
apps.short_description: Take control of a combat mech in an old-school sci-fi shooter. Upgrade your machine and unlock powerful support drones. Face alien creatures and hostile machines alone or with up to 3 friends in local co-op.

apps.name: CYBERLIFE
apps.short_description: CYBERLIFE is an online hacking game played through a terminal, in one world shared by every player. Break into companies, bring your loot back to your localhost, and take the crossroads every other operator has to go through.

apps.name: Cyberpix '89
apps.short_description: Enter a retro-futuristic, music-reactive arcade shooter where every beat shapes the chaos. Adapt, survive, and sync with the rhythm as you fight your way through the underworld.

apps.name: Dajimo Arena: Team Showdown
apps.short_description:
“Your color is your shelter—until it isn’t.”
Color-swapping 4-team arena FPS where death makes you a drone with power—reshape the map, protect your body, and dive back into the fight. Free. Fast. Chaotic. Powered by GONet.

apps.name: Daluob
apps.short_description: Go solo or co-op to create unique builds. Nothing goes to waste: every successful build is preserved as a permanent "Bloodline." These Bloodlines scavenge gear while you're away and can be inherited by your next character to fast-track your setup and push power limits.

apps.name: Dandy Len's Toystore
apps.short_description: TOYSTORE is a survival horror game in which you must explore an underground shopping mall that was suddenly shut down for unknown reasons. The events take place in the early 90s, and you have been tasked with repairing the elevator that leads to the exit, in order to finalize the closure procedures.

apps.name: DANGER ZONE: PRIZE FIGHTER
apps.short_description: DANGER ZONE: PRIZE FIGHTER is a fast-paced 2D fighting game with 15 unique fighters, explosive one-on-one combat, cinematic attacks, local versus, training, and a story-driven Prize Fighter mode set in the dangerous world of Velmora.

apps.name: Dank Nooner
apps.short_description: A motorcycle game about doing every stupid thing you'd never try in real life. Pull 12 o'clock wheelies through traffic, flip off ramps, crash spectacularly, and race your friends online.

apps.name: Dark Ages Battle Simulator
apps.short_description: What happens when 20 skeletons face a dragon? Or an army of goblins challenges a colossal demon? Create your own dark-fantasy matchups, build your armies, and watch monsters, warriors and legendary beasts clash in a brutal cinematic battle simulator.

apps.name: Dark Eyes - Super Soldier 2
apps.short_description: Continue the fight in the Dark Eyes universe as the Super Soldier battles the Delma and the elite Alpha commander. Experience fast-paced combat, massive battles, stealth, upgrades, and powerful abilities in this chaotic sci-fi action shooter.

apps.name: DARKHAND
apps.short_description: Enter The Devil's casino, meet dozens of other charming gamblers, and fight your way out for a fortune. Will you ever be able to pay off your debt?

apps.name: DaSong
apps.short_description:
The Greatest Corrupt Official of the Great Song Dynasty
This is an alternate-history story. You play as Zhao Jiu, starting as a minor clerk. Rise to the throne, meet vivid characters and change the plot with your choices. Though known as a corrupt official, your goal is to save the Great Song.

apps.name: DATA_BREAK.exe
apps.short_description: A darkly humorous horror RPG about an office drone who discovers that there are even scarier things than a life of the 9-5 routine.

apps.name: DATE_SIMULATOR.EXE
apps.short_description:
Go on three exclusive dates with charming girls! Enjoy their company and the cozy moments you share.  
Lost media. This game is not suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed.

apps.name: DAWG - Digital Audio Workstation Game
apps.short_description: Swap endless scrolling for something fun and creative. Build beats, layer synths, and shape your sound with a full mixer and live FX. With support for MIDI, Steam Deck, and mobile devices, DAWG starts simple and grows with you as you learn across all platforms. Multi platform 4-player multiplayer!

apps.name: Dawnrazor
apps.short_description: Step into the decaying world of Kagenovia in Dawnrazor, a story-driven 8-bit action adventure! Take control of Zedekiah, a betrayed knight reborn through parasitic vampirism, as he fights through blood-soaked ruins and biomechanical horrors.

apps.name: Day 31
apps.short_description: You were bitten hours ago. The clock in your blood is already running — and it isn't a virus. Fight through the waves of the dead, trade your nerve to a demon who was here before the city, and hold onto yourself for one more wave. Turn, and it's over.

apps.name: Dead On Arrival
apps.short_description: Step into the shoes of a CSI in Dead On Arrival, the ultimate crime scene investigation game. Analyse scenes, collect evidence, and use real-life forensic tools to solve cases. Test your problem-solving skills and uncover the truth to catch the killer. Do you have what it takes to crack the case?

apps.name: DEAD or LUCKY: Game of Hearts
apps.short_description: Two guys will have to cheat, risk their lives, and somehow get along with each other so they don't lose their organs at the casino.

apps.name: Dead Ringer
apps.short_description: It begins with a phone plugged into a faulty socket and an electric malfunction, it ends with seven dead and one missing... Detective Maxwell Morgan must navigate the testimonies of both the living and the dead to find a murderer before it's too late.

apps.name: Dead Zone Revive
apps.short_description:
Fight, rebuild, and survive in a zombie apocalypse!
Lead your team in real-time missions, gather weapons, gear, and supplies, and defend your base with tactical RPG and strategy gameplay.

apps.name: Deadly Voyage
apps.short_description:
A chaotic murder party aboard 1930s ocean liners. As a passenger, you must find and kill your target. But be careful. Someone is also hunting you.  

Bonk your target with a champagne bottle, drop a chandelier on them, or slip them a wallet that goes bang. Just don't let security see.

apps.name: DeadShare
apps.short_description: Six seats. Six players. One game show that smiles while it watches you. Make your secret pick, read the room, and stay in your seat while the wheel turns on SIXFOLD, the 2010 TV show nobody was meant to see.

apps.name: Deadshift
apps.short_description: Spend your last cash on a gun, a perk or a way out. DEADSHIFT is a single-player, top-down zombie survival roguelike. Repair barricades, unlock rooms and evolve your weapons across six maps. Beat the wave-30 boss, then keep fighting in endless mode.

apps.name: Deal Flipper
apps.short_description: Buy low, sell high. Master the art of the deal. Deal Flipper is a first-person flipping sim where you scour an online marketplace, haggle with sellers in real-time chat, and resell for profit. Every trader plays differently. Read them, outdeal them, and build your empire.

apps.name: Dear Gravity
apps.short_description: Fold a little hope. Let it fly. Read the wind, refine your paper plane and feel the quiet triumph of a difficult delivery landing just right. From your first window launch to a letter at the lighthouse, go a little further with every throw.

apps.name: Dear President
apps.short_description: Ruling a country is easy; surviving is the hard part. Use your stamp to balance the state's four main powers, manage bizarre crises, and avoid assassinations. Every death is a new beginning. Upgrade your skills, sit back at the desk, and try not to get hit by a rock. Permission to panic: Granted.

apps.name: Death at Fleming Manor
apps.short_description:
"Your job is to write the death certificate."
Investigate a mysterious death in a British manor in 1959. Explore eerie scenes, analyze evidence, and complete death certificates and emergency reports. A forensic mystery with art inspired by 1960s European detective comics.

apps.name: Deblock
apps.short_description: A short, satisfying incremental game about breaking blocks. Dig deeper, unlock new tools and upgrades, and break even more blocks.

apps.name: Debt - This game's cost keeps climbing
apps.short_description: Debt is a climate-guessing game for which the cost only keeps increasing. Ever. Play with actual global warming data and compete to be the most accurate visionary. One thing is sure, now is the best time to buy the game, as its price will soon increase. All proceeds go to The Nature Conservancy.

apps.name: Debt Wish
apps.short_description: You start with $100 and a line of credit. Trade, borrow, bribe, and gamble your way up until you own everything. An incremental finance sim where the debt can be your best friend or worst enemy.

apps.name: Deck Breaker - A Roguelike Deckbuilder
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a focus on deep strategy, synergy and crazy combos. Build your deck as you adventure with over 200 cards and 35 heroes that each warp the rules — designed by a former Hearthstone set-design lead. Free demo out now!

apps.name: Deck Drop
apps.short_description:
Perfect your deck or watch it burn!

Deck Drop is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by Chinese Poker and Balatro.

Can you beat the Tipping Point?

apps.name: Decks of Valor: Fantasy Card Battles
apps.short_description: Choose from more than 70 ready-made decks and battle fantasy heroes in tactical card duels. Play offline against deck-aware AI, learn in a short interactive tutorial, or enter a 32-deck knockout tournament.

apps.name: Deep Breath
apps.short_description: Deep Breath is a third-person PvPvE extraction shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Team up or play solo, scavenge, fight, and escape in 25-minute missions filled with AI threats, tactical decisions, and fast-paced action.

apps.name: Deep Dive Dungeon
apps.short_description: A sword-and-sorcery dungeon built from location cards. Scavenge rare loot, build your deck on the fly to define your playstyle, and break out before it's too late. Play solo or team up with friends!

apps.name: DeepCore Breach
apps.short_description: Thousands of rift creatures. One base. Aim every turret's line of fire, then take the main cannon into your own hands. Take down five bosses across 15 maps, grow stronger between runs, and climb the global leaderboard in Endless. Build and share your own maps on the Workshop.

apps.name: Deeper Still
apps.short_description: A hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them. Co-op mode included.

apps.name: Defend the Sacred Well
apps.short_description: Defend the Sacred Well in a single-player action defense game. Choose from three heroes and three maps, combine skills and alliance bonuses, dodge boss attacks, and protect the well through twenty waves. Then take your build into Endless Mode.

apps.name: DEFY
apps.short_description: Two nations, each certain it is the hero, fight over a beautiful world running out of supply. Blow the bridges, burn the forests, bring the buildings down. Villagers hide in cellars or take up arms, and a downed aircraft falls on what lies beneath it. Real-time strategy for up to eight leaders.

apps.name: Dejinochi
apps.short_description: Dejinochi is a tiny virtual pet that lives right on your desktop. Feed it, care for it, watch it grow into different creatures, and eventually say goodbye as it heads out into the world. Old friends might even come back to visit.

apps.name: Delivery Time
apps.short_description:
Jump! Grind rails! Boost through the city and deliver packages as quickly as you can while also scoring some style points!
Get ready for frantic time trials, loaded with parcels to deliver to happy customers.

apps.name: Delve Survivors
apps.short_description:
A blend of classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawling with the intensity of modern survivors games. 
Set the pace with every step as you unlock multiple dungeons and blast through swarms of enemies! 
Gather loot, customize your build, and learn to survive.. the Delve!

apps.name: Demigod Islands: A Puzzle to Die For
apps.short_description: Vicious demigods demand sacrifices! Take control of captive creatures, explore mysterious islands and solve 50+ mind-bending puzzles in story mode or 20+ unique levels in two-player online co-op. The twist? To please the demigods and uncover their secrets, you must kill yourselves!

apps.name: Demiourgos
apps.short_description: A first-person horror. A man wakes up at 3 AM and the sea starts calling. Every person and every animal has a line of destiny. Can you change them before the great end?

apps.name: Demockracy
apps.short_description: Build a political party in a fictional country and play for one thing: win power and keep it. Recruit politicians, conquer regions, win elections. There are clean paths and dirty games. Everyone has a price. What's yours?

apps.name: Demon of the time
apps.short_description: Fight cultists armed with futuristic weapons in a world where ancient Japan collides with broken time. Battle hordes of enemies, collect sacred artifacts, and stop the Demon of Time before reality itself collapses.

apps.name: Dendron 64
apps.short_description: With the help of a custom emulator, a lost 90s puzzle platformer game has finally been restored. Explore the secrets of the dam, find out what happened to your friends, and save the valley from the monster lying in its depths.

apps.name: DEPOT
apps.short_description: DEPOT is a 1-6 player co-op horror game about working the worst warehouse shift imaginable. Find the items on your list, load your cart, pack the orders and ship them out, while trying not to attract the things roaming between the shelves.

apps.name: Descent Of Lunaris
apps.short_description: Assemble your squad and explore a lunar base where cosmic horrors warp your reality, challenge your strategy, and break your sanity. Descent of Lunaris is a grid-based dungeon crawling RPG inspired by Wizardry and Shin Megami Tensei.

apps.name: Desire and Consequence
apps.short_description: A mysterious romantasy adventure visual novel where your choices take you on different paths with over six romanceable characters. You must find the truth about your past, discover the secrets of each character, and navigate the lure of power, romance, and their consequences.

apps.name: Desktop Ball
apps.short_description: A little physics toy that lives on top of your desktop. Fidget, vent, and mess around with a bunch of weird balls. Fling them, bounce them, dunk them, explode them, or just slosh around in a tiny ocean.

apps.name: Desktop Bonsai Towns
apps.short_description: First world: Cyberpunk Town. A tiny voxel bonsai grows on your desktop for hours while a cyberpunk city builds itself along its trunk and branches. Watch residents live their lives as storms, meteors and giant invaders strike. Unlock pruning shears and collect a variety of bonsai styles.

apps.name: Desktop Bug Killer
apps.short_description:
This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves.
Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.

apps.name: Desktop Cozy Cat Tree
apps.short_description: Build a cat tree right on your desktop. Cats climb the post, leap from the top and bounce off the rides you place, earning gold with every hit. Arrange rides, meet a growing crew of cats and decorate your Cat House in a cozy idle game that plays quietly beside your work.

apps.name: Desktop Pet Engine
apps.short_description: Place your favorite characters on your desktop!A desktop idle game for work, study, and fun. Summon cute companions to keep you company, vent stress, or collect characters. Quickly access productivity tools like notepads, Pomodoro timers, and task lists—making your desktop lively and efficient!

apps.name: Desktop Wallet Heroes
apps.short_description:
An intense idle RPG that unfolds right on your desktop!
Desktop Wallet Heroes is an overlay idle RPG where characters endlessly hunt monsters at the bottom of your screen—without ever interrupting your work or web browsing. 
Continuously upgrade items to defeat enemies and rake in mountains of loot!

apps.name: DeskTrack
apps.short_description: A cozy desktop companion with toy cars and a focus timer. Let a little car cruise while you work or study, earn miles to collect cars and scenery, then build your own tracks or take the wheel for a break.

apps.name: Despiry
apps.short_description: Despiry is a top-down sci-fi roguelite for 1 to 4 players with ARPG-style loot and run-based builds. Explore a hostile alien world, fight swarms, stack relics and passives, and bring back materials for permanent upgrades. There's no end to reach, only how far you go before enemies outgrow you.

apps.name: Detective Defective
apps.short_description: You are not a detective. You forged your way into the agency to find out who killed your wife. Investigate crime scenes with nothing marking what matters, take your own notes, and file reports you have to stand behind. What you overlook today shapes what you can understand tomorrow.

apps.name: Devil Meat
apps.short_description: Feed demon flesh to the fanatical saint and guide her to ascension. 『Devil Meat』 is a multi-ending roguelite adventure that demands efficient hunting and growth strategies. What she will become—and whether you will survive—is entirely up to you.

apps.name: Diamond Giza
apps.short_description: Run through the pyramids and grab everything shiny! Explore the mazes and rob the pharoahs and your friends in massive couch co-op mayhem!

apps.name: Diamonds and Spades
apps.short_description: Create your own cards and share them with friends in this roguelite card game! Discover powerful combos, collect unique Tarot cards with special abilities, and push your luck to achieve absurdly high scores!

apps.name: Dicebloom
apps.short_description: Roll the die and wake a twilight garden. Every hit sets off a chain of blooming: plants grow their neighbours, bees fly, seeds sprout and multipliers climb. Build a garden engine that pays a rising debt every week in this cozy dice roguelite.

apps.name: Digging In The Desert
apps.short_description: You lost your hat in the middle of a vast desert and must keep digging to find it!

apps.name: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar
apps.short_description: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar is an action RPG-roguelike set in the mythic world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, where ancient gods, demons, and forgotten powers collide.

apps.name: Direlands: Extraction
apps.short_description: Direlands: Extraction blends looter shooter progression, extraction gameplay, and classic fantasy RPG adventure. Explore dangerous realms through ancient portals, gather powerful loot, and fight your way home—or lose everything you carry.

apps.name: Dirt Clicker
apps.short_description: Start with a spoon and a dream. Dig up treasures, unlock upgrades, hire adorable helpers and discover the secrets hidden beneath the dirt.

apps.name: DispatchControl
apps.short_description: Run a fire and ambulance dispatch center on real-world maps. Answer emergency calls, assess incidents and send the right crews while keeping units in reserve. Play Dispatch Control solo or in online co-op with up to six players, in free play or 16 campaign chapters.

apps.name: District Null
apps.short_description: District Null is a cyberpunk city simulation. Traffic, energy, fire services, police, schools and entertainment all run at the same time.

apps.name: DOCTRINEERS
apps.short_description: DOCTRINEERS is a turn-based strategy game where no two games are ever alike. Strategize and plan with your unique doctrinal units and adapt to new battlefields in a single-player campaign and online multiplayer.

apps.name: Dogfight Era: Origins
apps.short_description: Wake up, Pilot! The war has just begun, and the enemy rules the skies. It's time to take the fight to them! Choose from 32 aircraft from the World War I era and soar above famous battlefields. Do you have what it takes to turn the tide of war?

apps.name: DoJo Legacy of Zhen
apps.short_description: Dojo Legacy of Zhen, you don't just fight you change history. A emergent martial arts world where every broken bone and bruised ego creates a ripple effect. Defeat a rival, and his disciples will hunt you. Rebuild your school, master the Grudge Engine and forge a legacy in a world that never forgets

apps.name: Domino Party
apps.short_description: Stand up thousands of dominoes to build a picture, then watch it all topple in one glorious chain! Make domino art and up to 10,000-piece jigsaws from your own photos with friends, then party in the lodge and playland with 25 mini-games like curling and sled races.

apps.name: Don't Blow UP!
apps.short_description: Don't Blow UP! brings minesweeper into first person, solo or in co-op for up to 4 players. Dig up tiles, flag mines, and face seven rule-twisting modifiers. One wrong choice can blow everything up.

apps.name: Don't Drink
apps.short_description:
A strange night. A questionable decision. And a can you probably shouldn't have opened.

Don't Drink offers a small but charismatic world with RPG elements and 'interesting' foes.

apps.name: Don't Eat Me, Granny
apps.short_description: Don't Eat Me, Granny! is a dark fairytale stealth-horror set in Bonebog. As a kidnapped boy trapped by a mad old woman, you must escape before she completes an ancient ritual to crash the Moon into the world — with you as the final sacrifice.

apps.name: Don't Hang Up
apps.short_description: A short visual novel where you play as a payphone that is going through its last night before being shut down. How this night will go is up to you.

apps.name: Don't Pick Up
apps.short_description: Wanted: a reliable technician who follows the rules, handles sensitive information with discretion, and does not ask questions. Fix the phones. Don't look too closely.

apps.name: Don't Save the Princess
apps.short_description: An anti-runner in which you control the obstacles instead of the runner. Strike, combo, and upgrade to finally earn the princess some personal time!

apps.name: Doomy Downer
apps.short_description: A cute block hero, dragged down through a grim voxel dungeon. Souls-like combat: read the glint, then parry, clash or roll. At every stair, a gate of flowers or a gate of thorns: mow down a horde in the open, or duel champions in the dark. Your loot is your build. Death is permanent.

apps.name: Dot Dodge
apps.short_description: The name is self explanatory: you have to dodge the dots (and every other thing in the game). Dot Dodge is a minimalist music bullet hell where you move your mouse to avoid various hazards.

apps.name: DoubleShake
apps.short_description: Grab, shake, throw, and kick to save your islands from total chaos in this action-packed blast-to-the-past 2.5D Platformer inspired by some of our favorite 5th generation games!

apps.name: Doug's Playground
apps.short_description: Catch fish, ace the minigames to grade your haul, and turn it into playground parts. Stack them on the ship, send them off, and do it again. Draft charms, hire a crew, and when you sink, spend your prestige tokens and sail once more.

apps.name: Dr. Tod's Very Good Clinic
apps.short_description: A chaotic physics-based medical party game for 1–6 players. Carry patients, perform surgery, and try to save lives with your friends as everything goes horribly wrong. No medical license required. Safety first. Probably.
