apps.name: Dracula: The Disciple
apps.short_description: To cheat death, you must uncover the secrets hidden within Count Dracula’s castle. Only by mastering the occult arts and solving mystical puzzles can you save yourself. Eternal life comes at a price!

apps.name: DragHunter
apps.short_description: Link swords, cut down skulls, and build your way out of danger. DragHunter is a turn-based dungeon puzzle RPG where every chain feeds your next upgrade—and every turn gives the dungeon another chance.

apps.name: Dragon Khan
apps.short_description: Dragon Khan is a third-person action RPG set in Ithannar, a world ruled by dragons, where the player controls Botu, a unique green draconate born with wings and elemental power, drawn into a conflict triggered by the disappearance of a dragon Khan and the invasion of the forest domain.

apps.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
apps.short_description:
In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle.

Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

apps.name: Dragstrip Online
apps.short_description: Pixel art drag racing where the driver who understands the car wins. Pick from 1600+ cars or build one from a bare frame, swap engines, tune every part on the dyno, then prove it on the strip or in highway battles with the police on your tail. Career offline, PvP online.

apps.name: Draw & Stow
apps.short_description: Draw & Stow is a roguelike strategy game combining deckbuilding, inventory management, and item crafting. Make a fortune as a Traveling Merchant, defeat foes as a Villain Hunter, or cook as a Master Chef. Draft cards, manage inventory to trigger chain reactions. The choice is yours!

apps.name: Drawquarium
apps.short_description: Draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There's also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind.

apps.name: Dreadlines
apps.short_description: Live two of your wildest fantasies: Being employed AND talking to women!      Date your undead coworkers, survive corporate deadlines and try not to lose your soul in this satirical monster office dating sim.

apps.name: Dreadmiles
apps.short_description: Combine weapon modules, destroy obstacles and spread fire in this claymation rogue-lite horde survivor. Choose your route, take on missions and giant bosses, and head back to your truck before the Seep closes in.

apps.name: DREADROOM
apps.short_description: It was supposed to be just a funny escape room experience... until you realize the incredible truth. In this tense horror puzzle-adventure, solve complex mechanisms, navigate deadly corridors and evade terrifying entities lurking in the dark, while trying to find the true exit.

apps.name: Dreadwinter
apps.short_description: Take control of Dreadwinter, your very own magical coffee shop! Explore a vibrant, fantasy world, master your craft, and turn a small café into a legend in this spooky, cozy coffee shop sim!

apps.name: DRENCHED
apps.short_description: Drenched is a 3D exploration adventure where a burnt-out artist becomes a fish. Switch between the two characters, and traverse two mirrored worlds to uncover her story. Splash puddles on the surface and blow bubbles underwater to explore, solve puzzles, and reconnect her past and present.

apps.name: Driftfort: The Drowned World
apps.short_description: Four planks against the deep. Turn your raft into a floating fortress, secure food and water, and automate your supplies. Defend your home against night attacks and explore five sea regions on your journey to a safe coast.

apps.name: Driver Wars
apps.short_description: A chaotic and satirical late-stage capitalistic driving simulator. In this low-poly 3D world, live out the fantasies and nightmares of countless commuters gridlocked in traffic as you ram, blow up, set ablaze, toss donuts at, honk, grapple, and total hordes of terrible and aggressive NPC drivers.

apps.name: Drop Dead Lucky
apps.short_description: Every bounce is a gamble. Make yours count. Drop Dead Lucky is a Plinko roguelite where you aim your drops, nudge fate in your favor, and combine charms, runes, and spirits to build huge scores and survive eight escalating antes.

apps.name: Drop Point
apps.short_description: How long can you last in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies? Will you team up or go solo?

apps.name: Dry Meadow
apps.short_description: Fight, sneak and scavenge through lands left altered after an unknown catastrophe from the Soviet Union. Light fires to stay warm. Drink vodka to stay sane.

apps.name: Dual Fire:Walled City
apps.short_description: Dual Fire Walled City is a story-driven co-op game for two players. Featuring close friends who grew up together in the Kowloon Walled City, only to be pulled onto vastly different life paths by a twist of fate. Get ready to immerse yourself in a classic Hong Kong-style movie.

apps.name: Dubbed
apps.short_description: Pick a scene. Hand out the parts. Perform it together over your own microphones and get the clip back with your voices on it. Every line records separately, so you can retake the one that didn't land — then watch the finished dub with the whole room.

apps.name: Dungeon Miner
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op mining game: go down the mine, dig up ore, and carry it back to the ship. Small gear stays on your body, but giant crystals must be carried in your own two arms. Pull the Dungeon Core and the mine starts to collapse. You have three minutes to get the cart back to the ship.

apps.name: Dungeon Node
apps.short_description: Dungeon Node is a pixel-art action RPG where you battle relentless hordes, recruit mercenaries, and choose skill nodes to shape your growth. Journey from the forest to the depths of Hell, facing stronger enemies and new choices as you venture deeper.

apps.name: Dungeon Wanderers
apps.short_description: A 3D action RPG in a dungeon that changes each time you dive in. Read enemy attacks and answer with guards, parries, and dodges. Your playstyle shapes which skills awaken in you. Capture monsters and raise them as companions to fight by your side. Play solo or in up to 4-player online co-op.

apps.name: Dungeonbound
apps.short_description: Dungeonbound is a retro first-person auto-battler dungeon crawler. Send your Warrior, Mage or Rogue into monster-packed depths, watch battles play out turn by turn, and grow stronger every run. Death just sends you home with the loot. Merge gear, buy upgrades, descend again.

apps.name: Duoshift
apps.short_description: Defend The Wall on a tactical 11x7 grid using your pair of battle vehicles. Outmaneuver waves of scavenged war machines, unleash game-breaking hacks and chain synergies. Draft, fight, and survive in this endlessly replayable tactical roguelite.

apps.name: Duskblade: The Caged Sun
apps.short_description: A silhouette metroidvania. The Masked King raised his mask to the sky and caged the sun's heart; the world has lived at dusk ever since. As the last blade of a fallen Order, fight through 13 regions and 29 bosses with six evolving weapons, and decide what the morning is worth.

apps.name: Dust & Diesel: Deadland Delivery
apps.short_description: Survive in a desolate post-apocalyptic world as a trucker, building your delivery empire. Customize and upgrade your trucks, fight off bandits, and navigate dangerous terrains. Complete challenging missions and uncover the wasteland secrets. Are you ready to conquer the Deadlands?

apps.name: DUSTBLOOM
apps.short_description: Team up with friends in this 1-4 player co-op survival game. Build and defend your base, automate your production, haul ore with your truck, and terraform a dead red desert into a lush green world. Craft weapons to survive nightly skeleton attacks and uncover the dark mystery of the lost 14th team.

apps.name: Dustpine District
apps.short_description: Explore and restore a strange forest town while collecting lost items along the way. Check off tasks, fill your home with treasures, meet your new neighbors and uncover Dustpine District's cosmic past!

apps.name: Dwarven Shift 98
apps.short_description: Dwarven Shift 98 is an incremental mining game in short timed shifts. Break rock walls layer by layer, each richer than the last, and fill the screen with an explosion of ore and gems.

apps.name: Eat Everything in a Supermarket
apps.short_description: Eat your way through an entire supermarket! Start with snacks, earn money from everything you eat, and buy upgrades to eat faster and devour bigger things. Go from a bag of chips to entire shelves, fridges and even the checkouts. Can you eat the whole store?

apps.name: Echo Mates
apps.short_description: To see, you must speak. To speak is to be found. A co-op horror in near-total darkness where every sound sends out a wave that lights the level — and calls whatever lives in it. 1–4 players, real voice, microphone required.

apps.name: Echoes of Elpis
apps.short_description: Echoes of Elpis is a twin-stick shooter sci-fi roguelike. Upgrade weapons, discover new tech, and uncover a secret past as you battle through Elpis on an epic treasure hunt.

apps.name: Echoes of Eternity 2
apps.short_description: A difficult isometric bullet-hell continuing the story of Ott, a bot with a recycled consciousness.

apps.name: Echoes of Stella
apps.short_description: Echoes of Stella is a first-person horror adventure built around a unique echolocation device. Use it to navigate a distorted mirror world, revealing your surroundings in brief moments of clarity. Time your scans carefully, or risk exposing yourself.

apps.name: Echoes of the Forest
apps.short_description: Echoes of the Forest is a sensory Adventure-Puzzle where you play a blind musician. Journey through a cursed forest to reclaim your eyes, stolen by a mysterious cult. Navigate using the sound of your flute and the environment, and uncover ancient melodies to overcome the obstacles ahead.

apps.name: Edge of Memories
apps.short_description: The population of Avaris is ravaged by the Corrosion, a terrible affliction that mutates all it infects into grotesque abominations. Play as Eline, a young nomad, and lead fierce battles alongside your allies to save the world from extinction.

apps.name: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus
apps.short_description: Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

apps.name: Elastic Races
apps.short_description:
Realistic Multiplayer Car Racing Game with dozens of tracks, hundreds of vehicles and dozens of drivers.
Turn Based play mode and Simultanious play mode with 6 different play modes, multiple vehicle types, perfect for family and friends game night

apps.name: Elderwood
apps.short_description: Forge your path in Elderwood, an online fantasy RPG where skills grow through adventure. Master weapons, craft powerful gear, or support allies with bard songs. Conquer clan keeps, brave dangerous PvP regions, and face endgame raids in a world shaped by rivalry, risk, and discovery.

apps.name: Eldritch 2
apps.short_description: Minor Key Games' classic horror romp returns in this bigger and better sequel. Eldritch 2 is a first-person stealth action game inspired by immersive sims, roguelikes, and the works of H. P. Lovecraft.

apps.name: Elecade
apps.short_description:
Strike down rampaging machines with chain lightning.
Elecade is a 1-bit action game with incremental upgrades, where you power up and climb to the top of a space facility.

apps.name: Elements: Soul of Fire
apps.short_description: The light of the world fades. Evil hearts seek the Power of the Elements - the forces which bind the universe together - thus threatening all of existence. An homage to the 8-BIT era with a charming art style.

apps.name: Elf Shift
apps.short_description: Only 4 real time days left until Christmas. Flawlessly pack 10,000 toys, unlock new products, and improve your skills to speed up the production line. Deliver the boxes on time, don't get too curious about the weird things happening around you, and most importantly... do not anger Santa.

apps.name: Elsewhere Owl Post
apps.short_description: A cozy resource management game where you sort magical packages and assign them to the perfect owl for successful delivery. Care for your hardworking owls, grow your clientele, and uncover their stories along the way. Discover distant lands as your owls travel far and wide to complete each delivery.

apps.name: Elya
apps.short_description: Raise a desktop companion in a cozy single-player pet game. Chat, build your bond, collect memories, and customize her with characters, skins, animations, and Workshop creations.

apps.name: Ember and Blade
apps.short_description: Become the immortal hunter and stand against the archdemon Asmodeus. Cut through bullet-hell swarms, clash with Souls-like bosses, and harness celestial blessings that reshape your powers each run. The demons are rising—raise your sword.

apps.name: Emojis vs Zombies
apps.short_description: Emojis vs Zombies is an idle desktop zombie defense game! Open packs, collect emoji defenders, upgrade your squad and base, and survive endless waves, even while you're AFK or working!

apps.name: Empire in Decay
apps.short_description: Start a rebellion and fight chess inspired turn-based combats in this roguelike deckbuilder. Upgrade your units and cards wisely. You will need it to progress through the districts of Daandria, the city where the tyrant king awaits you. Save this Empire in Decay.

apps.name: Empire Water Works
apps.short_description: Empire Water Works is a steam engine simulator based in a water pumping station. Operate and maintain your pumping station day and night, maintain city water pressure and fulfill contracts. Interact with realistic steam, coal-firing, and audio simulation in a vintage setting.

apps.name: Enamelist: Tidy Up the Pin Collection
apps.short_description: Enamelist is a cozy tidy-up simulator where you organize over 2,000 unique enamel pins into themed sets on pin boards. Enjoy beautiful artwork as you place each pin back where it belongs.

apps.name: Enchanted Oceans Inc
apps.short_description: Take to the seas and help bring life back to a shattered ocean archipelago in this third person ocean adventure created by a marine biologist! Make use of your trusty vessel, deep sea diving skills, and a sprinkling of magic to achieve your goals and help the people of Rhu.

apps.name: End My Dry Spell
apps.short_description: Lorfeld is a small wine town on the Rhine gorge—and this summer, the river has dropped to a level nobody living has seen. Choose who you stand beside, what you’re willing to pay when you’re wrong, and who stays when the harbour finally starts moving again.

apps.name: End Quest
apps.short_description: An isometric co-op action RPG for three. Leo blocks, Arwen shoots, Keshi keeps everyone alive. Take quests into a rainforest where people vanish, up a mountain that has not seen spring in 200 years and into a kingdom that fell overnight. Nobody online? AI companions fill the empty seats.

apps.name: Enderal: Forgotten Stories (Special Edition)
apps.short_description: Enderal: Forgotten Stories (Special Edition) is a total conversion mod for Skyrim SE. It offers an immersive open world, new skill systems and gameplay with a dark, psychological storyline and believable characters. SE features a new rendering engine, improved lighting, performance and stability.

apps.name: Endless Reach
apps.short_description: Fly a smuggler's run into a swarm of thousands. Every orb you catch is XP and cargo. Stay and the heat brings turrets, then a boss. Call the jump, hold the zone while the drive charges, and bank it all. Die, and you keep a fraction. The music follows how well you fly.

apps.name: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches
apps.short_description: Olympiad Chess evolves classical chess into a true 4v4 team esport. Across a shared central Nexus, pieces invade neighboring boards to flank opponents and rescue allies in synchronized team volleys. It's the world's first true multi-board competitive team chess.

apps.name: Eonheart
apps.short_description: Explore Eonheart, an enigmatic machine complex in this classic-style 2D Puzzle Platformer where you can create platforms by yourself and manipulate them to traverse the complex, brave dangers, surpass challenges, solve mechanisms, and discover long-lost secrets!

apps.name: EpicSelectly
apps.short_description: EpicSelectly is a bullet hell shooter where you choose between the dense Red World and the fast Blue World. Repeated choices raise each world's rank and intensify its patterns. Dodge aimed and random bullets, customize Extra Mode's difficulty, and compete on Steam leaderboards.

apps.name: Eric's Farm
apps.short_description: Feed 'em... or get BONKED! Toss ridiculous snacks, dodge hangry animals and smash through ten chaotic days in a slapstick 3D farm game. Take on bosses, five minigames and Endless Mode, then unlock The Back Forty: grow crops, drive tractors and build your own farm.

apps.name: ErosNet: Glitch in Love
apps.short_description: ErosNet: Glitch in Love is an erotic visual novel and dating sim with an ironic cyberpunk storyline! Explore biomes, reveal avatars' fetishes, and unlock spicy scenes. Upgrade your PC to transform pixels into juicy 2D art!

apps.name: Eruin
apps.short_description: A town has forgotten itself, and so have you. Question its people in your own words: every villager listens, remembers, and answers as themselves. Piece together what was lost and break the spell before the kingdom vanishes with its past.

apps.name: ESCAPE FROM TOUHOU
apps.short_description: A single-player top-down extraction shooter where you command Reimu, Marisa, and Nitori-crash-landed in a war-torn desert-by switching between them in real time. Secure supplies to survive, and with the allied forces' help, restore the dimensional transporter and return to Gensokyo.

apps.name: Escape Path
apps.short_description: Navigate through complex non-linear mazes dotted with traps, enemies and unique mechanics to rebuild a protective crystal. Watch and think, because rushing in headfirst will lead you to death! Ready to take on the challenge and find the pieces before it's too late?

apps.name: Escape With Friends
apps.short_description: Investigate with your friends in this hilarious hand drawn game. Draw your own skin and go on a journey filled with minigames: darts, mini car races, electrical panels... From 2 to 8 players.

apps.name: Esport Manager: Last Pick
apps.short_description: Behind every win, a decision. Sign your players, train them, prepare your game plans. Then watch your five players carry them out their own way, because a creative player never plays like a cautious one.

apps.name: Estranged: Act I
apps.short_description: Estranged tells the story of a lone fisherman, whose ship is stranded on a mysterious island during a violent storm. Explore the rich environments and meet the curious inhabitants of the island as you find a way back to the mainland.

apps.name: Eternal Angler
apps.short_description: A surreal multiplayer fishing game where you catch strange creatures hidden across fragmented dimensions.

apps.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
apps.short_description: Sharpen your blades and step into the Eternal Palace Sakura, a dream labyrinth haunted by restless yokai. Battle through ever-shifting realms in this anime-inspired 3D action roguelite, mastering fluid combat and exploring endless floors of the palace!

apps.name: European Airfreight Tycoon
apps.short_description: European Air Freight Tycoon is an aviation management simulation. Build your cargo airline, coordinate flights across 26 major European airports, manage 18 aircraft, gather resources, construct assembly hangars, trade stocks, and lead your company to the top of Europe.

apps.name: EverArcane
apps.short_description: Build a 3×3 grid of spells and watch your young mage obliterate endless monster hordes. Combine six elements, chain reactions and adjacency buffs, defeat ten Guardians, and push through the horde of monsters.

apps.name: Everdeep Idle
apps.short_description: An ARPG-inspired Idle game where the fighting happens automatically, but the build is yours. Choose up to six classes, reshape skills with augments and build-changing loot, and set up triggers and loadouts that react for you. Let it run while you’re busy, or dig into the numbers to min-max.

apps.name: Everything In Its Place
apps.short_description: Sığınakta bir şeyler olmuş. Raflar boş, yerler dolu: ilaç kutuları, ampuller, yedek parçalar. 6.336 malzemeyi yerine koyacak tek kişi sensin. Savaş yukarıda devam ediyor. Burası artık senin sorumluluğunda. Acele yok, baskı yok. Kimse seni beklemiyor.

apps.name: Evilos
apps.short_description: Evilos is an action tower defense game where you play as an ancient evil sorcerer battling endless waves of do-gooders. Tear down the kingdom with a vast arsenal of evolvable magic weapons and spells, and bolster your defenses with elite minions across 10 acts. This time, you are the final boss!

apps.name: EVO RNG
apps.short_description: EVO RNG is slot-machine god-game - draft creatures, press spin and watch your ecosystem hunt, merge and evolve on its own. Collect, chase paylines, food chains and mythic creatures. Game does not contain any real money gambling elements.

apps.name: Evolution Survival
apps.short_description: Evolution Survival is a survival game where the universe evolves around you. The plants and animals you saw at the beginning will be different at the end, They may not even be there, the star may have gone supernova or shrunk into a white dwarf. Use the time you have to ensure your survival.

apps.name: Evoruption
apps.short_description: A dark roguelike deckbuilder where you build and evolve powerful decks, battle corrupted creatures, and master new mechanics across handcrafted story campaigns — or challenge other players in tactical 1v1 and 2v2 battles.

apps.name: EvoX
apps.short_description:
One island. A hundred ways to die.
Hunt, build, craft and fight your way from stone tools to gunpowder.
The island doesn't keep score. It just keeps going.

apps.name: EXCISA
apps.short_description: Sit down at a séance table in an abandoned house. Choose a tarot card. Roll the dice. Risk everything to summon the Angel who never lies. Every reach across the table might bring you closer to the truth—or seat something else opposite you. Five chairs. The dead have heard you, too.

apps.name: Excuse Me, King!
apps.short_description: Explain yourself! Improvise an excuse out loud for an embarrassing accusation, sneak in word cards like "butter" and "school lunch", and let your friends rate it from 1 to 5 stars. A party game for 2 to 8 players, on one PC or online with your own voice chat.

apps.name: Exhibition of the Heart
apps.short_description:
Alice is a lonely university student who never got over her first crush, the upright and studious Sylvia. Until one day, she discovers that Sylvia is actually a shameless exhibitionist! Can the timid Alice win her heart? 
Find out in this cute nsfw yuri visual novel!

apps.name: Exo7
apps.short_description: Build your interstellar empire in Exo7! Colonize new worlds, extract Metal, Silicium, Tridioxid, and Antimatter, build mighty fleets, and explore hyperspace. Choose your faction, conquer raids and bounty hunts, and dominate Sector 7!

apps.name: Exodrift
apps.short_description: Exodrift is a rhythm action roguelite where you are a space delivery driver on the run. Deliver packages, destroy enemies on the beat, and escape hazardous procedurally generated planets.

apps.name: Exodus Core
apps.short_description: Exodus Core is a hard turn-based tactical game with a dark sci-fi apocalyptic atmosphere. Take control of three massive mechs with the digitized personalities of soldiers and face a Swarm of thinking monsters from the dark. Can you win a hopeless battle?

apps.name: EXODUSER: HELL LORD
apps.short_description: Fight through hordes of demons in a dark fantasy action RPG. Parry color-coded bullet patterns, chain across the battlefield, fuse skills into devastating attacks, and build your own loadout as you climb through seven layers of hell.

apps.name: Extinction Cycle
apps.short_description: In this wave survival game, you incarnate a soldier testing a new kind of desensitising technology. You will not get out of the simulation until you become the perfect killing machine, welcome to the Extinction Cycle.

apps.name: Extravalence
apps.short_description: Lead a party of living chemical elements through a fractured world where every bond changes the battle. Switch between unique heroes, combine their abilities, manage volatile reactions and restore the stability.

apps.name: FailRooms
apps.short_description: Experience liminal horror like never before. Inspired by the Backrooms, FailRooms traps you in an endless world of absurd architecture, broken spaces, and things that should never have been built. Laugh while you can. Can you escape a place that was never designed to make sense?

apps.name: Fairy Tales Survivors
apps.short_description: Chaos has taken over the world of fairy tales. Lead a squad of storybook heroes through a dark world of all manner of creatures and challenges to save the fairy tales before it's too late.

apps.name: Fall of the Final Age
apps.short_description: Take command of the last Stronghold of humanity, fighting back against the advancing monsters. Decide where to prioritize the forces of your Heroes, as the number of turns before the invasion is limited. A turn-based tactical strategy with RPG and roguelike elements.

apps.name: Fallen Crowns
apps.short_description: Four Kings and a Wizard once sealed the Abyss. Then the Wizard betrayed them, and the Kings fell. Rise from nothing and claim their four crowns across a war-torn fortress, storm-wracked skies, a corrupted grove and endless shadow. Grow stronger every run, then face the Wizard King himself.

apps.name: Falling
apps.short_description: In Falling, guide your ball through obstacle courses in free fall. One touch is all it takes to start over. Easy to pick up, tough to master — and create your own levels.

apps.name: False Myth 2
apps.short_description: The true sequel to False Myth— a true classic JRPG × beautiful-heroine adventure! Rouge, the agile assassin, sets off with his companions to uncover the truth behind the mysterious girl Sylphina, weaving the most heartrending and fiery “Tale of Hearts.”

apps.name: Family Manners
apps.short_description: Light caresses every corner of the home, and the clock marks the first heartbeats of the morning. It’s just another typical day in the wonderful life of the Evans family… right?

apps.name: Fantasy Auction House
apps.short_description: Start with 10 gold and trade in 1100 items, from equipment and materials to pets and mounts. Find bargains, set your prices and collect the proceeds. In this single-player trading game, deal with the town's merchants, restock and expand your bags as your business grows.

apps.name: Fantasy Blacksmith Simulator
apps.short_description: Become a Master Blacksmith in this cozy fantasy simulator. Restore and upgrade your workshop, forge magical weapons and armor, craft jewelry, and enchant powerful gear. Meet magical creatures and mysterious figures as you enjoy a relaxing crafting experience, solo or with friends in co-op.

apps.name: Fantasy Camp Builder
apps.short_description: A cozy campsite building game where you create medieval-fantasy campsites with charming decorations, warm lighting, and a relaxing atmosphere.

apps.name: FARLINE
apps.short_description: Keep a train full of survivors alive as it crosses a wasteland ruled by machine beasts. Build rooms inside each car, care for 16 personality types and their stress, send scouts into the ruins, and see how far you can go before the line breaks.

apps.name: Farmed & Dangerous
apps.short_description: Not another farming game. Plant by night, then defend your crops from dawn to dusk in a first-person roguelite shooter, solo or in 3-player online co-op. Blast crop-hungry crows out of the sky with shotguns, turrets, air strikes and the occasional RPG. Miss the truck's order and the run is over.

apps.name: Farmstead Market Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and grow your own farm and roadside market. Grow crops, raise animals, craft valuable products, set prices, hire employees, stock your shelves, serve customers, and expand your small operation into a thriving business.

apps.name: Fast Detect
apps.short_description: The experimental graphic story Fast Detect takes place in the postapocalyptic Half-Life 2 universe and is shown from the artist's special point of view.

apps.name: Faulty Loops
apps.short_description: A set-and-play logic puzzle game driven by music. Place your units on the grid, press play and watch the playhead sweep across the board, firing each unit on the beat. Clear every enemy in a single loop to repair the corrupted tapes, one instrument at a time.

apps.name: Feed The Forest
apps.short_description: Use snail powers to grow a desert into a lush forest, and then profit-maximize it to insanity in this active incremental game. Optimize plant layouts to automate production of multiple resources. Hire minions, unlock immoral plants, get ungodly rich, and remember: Blood is a type of juice.

apps.name: Feeding Gooble
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about feeding the hungriest little guy. Push buttons, combine foods, and press your luck to keep him sated... or else.

apps.name: Feeding the Foxes
apps.short_description:
The darkest horror visual novel you'll ever play.
THEY. ARE. HUNGRY.
Will you feed them?

apps.name: FEEDSTOCK
apps.short_description: Your loot doesn't go in a backpack. It goes into Tally, and she grows. Four of you strip a house room by room and feed all of it to her. Feed her too little and she eats the crew; feed her too much and she won't fit back through the door.

apps.name: Femboy & Futa Maidmare
apps.short_description: A psychological horror visual novel set in a neon-lit motel. Work the night shift, build relationships with the unusual staff, make choices, and investigate increasingly strange events as the line between memory and reality begins to blur.

apps.name: Femboy Futa Monster Girls
apps.short_description: Femboy Futa Monster Girls is an adult fantasy visual novel driven by your choices. Build relationships with six distinct characters, uncover their secrets, and play minigames ranging from card duels to rhythm challenges as you explore branching routes and multiple endings.

apps.name: Fenestra: my focus, her future
apps.short_description: Fenestra awakens inside your PC knowing only her name. Work, study, and create with her in this Princess Maker-inspired raising-sim adventure with focus tools. Your focus time fuels her growth; the stats you raise and words you choose shape her personality, appearance, your bond, and her future.

apps.name: Feral Eyes
apps.short_description: A lone feline bounty hunter brings law and order to a frontier town in order to buy back a treasured heirloom.

apps.name: Feral Fantasy New Era
apps.short_description: Explore an open fantasy world in this adults-only sandbox featuring fictional feral characters. Customize your characters, interact with NPCs, build, and engage in magical combat while enjoying the experience at your own pace.

apps.name: Fernwick
apps.short_description: Some stories aren't told. They're left behind in the things we keep. In this hand-drawn point-and-click adventure, explore Grandma Junie's keepsake book, inspect the memories she left behind, and piece together the story of Fernwick.

apps.name: Fertile Crescent
apps.short_description: A real-time grand strategy game set in the Bronze Age. Lead one of 29 ancient civilizations from a single settler to an empire. Found cities, work the land, research new technologies, advance your culture, and wage war. Will your civilization outlive the age that made it?

apps.name: Feudmaker
apps.short_description: A free-to-play 5v5 MOBA on a fault line that changes as you fight. Fords open and close with day and night, and new paths tear open mid-match. Pick from 34 heroes, then build your own maps, modes and heroes in the same editor Feudmaker was made with.

apps.name: FFFF : Fatal Five Finger Fillet
apps.short_description:
Bet your fingers. A physically immersive horror roguelite.
Place your real fingers on the keyboard. Stab the knife between them.
Use rings and stab items to rack up a high score.
Can you keep your cool as the spinning blade closes in?

apps.name: Fifth Sun: New Fire
apps.short_description: Four suns have already died. Yours is next. A survival crafting adventure through Aztec myth: raise a half-buried temple, wake the legends that sleep at ancient altars, and walk the ruins of the dead suns, alone or with friends.

apps.name: Final Armada
apps.short_description: Build ships block by block, command your fleet in real-time space battles, and choose your path through a roguelike campaign. Upgrade your ships, watch them break apart in combat, and uncover what happened to the galaxy around you.

apps.name: FINAL COUNT
apps.short_description: Clock in for inventory week and scan every box before 6:00 AM. Explore a foggy shipping yard through a store-issued phone, manage its battery, follow radio instructions, and survive five increasingly impossible night shifts.

apps.name: FIND ALL 10: Greece
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 10: Greece. You will explore an ancient Greek city, the colorful streets of a historic town and the unique scenery of a modern Greek city. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

apps.name: Find The Needle
apps.short_description: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.

apps.name: Finding Buddies
apps.short_description: Finding Buddies is a romance visual novel where your dialogue choices shape Daniel’s story and relationships. Explore different scenes, meet new characters, and experience a narrative with interactive gameplay moments.

apps.name: Firearms Factory
apps.short_description: Firearms Factory is a WWII strategy game focused on weapon manufacturing and logistics. Starting in 1939, you manage a German war factory, expanding control over key regions by supplying battlefronts. Balance production, logistics, and territorial defense on the path to nuclear weapon development.

apps.name: FireBirds: Drone Simulator
apps.short_description: Control various types of military drones, from FPV and bombers to aircraft models and correction drones. Perform combat sorties, destroy tanks, artillery, and enemy drones in a realistic flight simulator.

apps.name: First Bag
apps.short_description:
You are an invisible robber who steals valuables from the map, while the others — the police — hunt you down to catch you.
But you're only invisible while standing still. Move, and you can be seen. Steal money and valuables, furnish your home and level up your skills.

apps.name: First-Person Jigsaw
apps.short_description: Play jigsaw puzzles from a first-person perspective! Sort, organize, and assemble huge piles of pieces at your own pace. Chill out solo or play online with up to 16 players. Import your own images to create custom puzzles, then play them yourself or share them online.

apps.name: Fish and Chill
apps.short_description: A cozy idle fishing game where your fisherman catches fish automatically while you relax. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and enjoy the calming sea in a transparent, borderless overlay that floats on any desktop.

apps.name: Fish Battle Champion
apps.short_description: Fishing roguelite autobattler where every catch could become your next champion. Catch strange fish, discover rare bonuses, collect items, upgrade your team of fishes and fight through increasingly challenging battles.

apps.name: Fish on the Floor
apps.short_description: The kids are coming, the tanks are empty, and the manager is furious! Scoop up scattered sea creatures, toss them into the right tanks, and grow your skills in this first-person aquarium scramble. Bring the exhibits to life before the children arrive.

apps.name: Fishing Town
apps.short_description: This is a desktop idle fishing game. Collect rare fish, upgrade your gear, and build your own pond and aquarium.

apps.name: Fishing Trawler
apps.short_description: Race up to 24 players online to the best fishing spots. Fill your livewell, then race back to bank your catch at the Tackle Hut before sunset. Launch off towering storm waves, craft a faster engine between rounds, and play with friends or rival trawlers. Most fish banked wins.

apps.name: Fishy Business
apps.short_description: A story-driven adventure where you captain a fishing boat. Explore a strange island, catch fish, trade and collect records of classical music.

apps.name: Five Signals
apps.short_description: Your wife is dead, but you can hear her voice on the phone. Follow the coordinates, explore abandoned locations, answer calls from the phone booth, and make your way deeper and deeper into the abyss. Every new call brings you closer to the truth... but you may not be ready to hear it.

apps.name: Fix it 18+
apps.short_description: Repair electronics in a city of superheroes, villains and everyday breakdowns. Take devices apart, replace parts, solder and run your workshop. Meet recurring clients, chat with Riley and Scarlett, and get to know them beyond the counter. An electronics repair sim with adult romance.

apps.name: Flak Simulator
apps.short_description: Crew a WWII anti aircraft gun with your friends. Spot incoming bombers, call out ranges, set fuses and load each round by hand. Flak Simulator is a firstperson coop simulation where getting a shot on target takes the whole crew.

apps.name: Flaming Fried Nutrition: Daydream
apps.short_description: A slow, strange pet-raising game with idle and horror elements, about a girl who loves hamburgers very, very much. Pet her beloved hamburger, feed it, dance for it, ride it. Adopt more hamburgers.

apps.name: Flashes of Chaos
apps.short_description: A fast-paced roguelike top-down shooter about building brutal guns. Collect ammunition cards, add modifiers, and load them into your weapon of choice to create your own unique experience of pure, adrenaline-fueled destruction.

apps.name: Flat Earth Runner
apps.short_description: Endless runner. Sentient Yowie. Antarctic ice wall. The New World Order really does not want you finishing the lap. A PS1-style comedy about the dumbest possible way to prove the earth is flat.

apps.name: Flesh Grinding
apps.short_description: Grind flesh. Gather blood. Upgrade. A first-person incremental horror game where you manage a macabre basement. Buy dark upgrades. boost your efficiency. and push your machinery to the limit while avoiding the terrifying entity that watches your every move.

apps.name: Floorball Manager
apps.short_description: Take charge of a floorball club in 8 nations. Scout talent, build your lines and watch every shift on an animated rink. Chase titles, the Continental Cup and national-team glory or rebuild the world your way with the full editor.

apps.name: Flopball
apps.short_description: Flopball is a football party game for up to 6 players online. Score goals, slide into tackles and send your rivals tumbling. Power-ups and wild arena events can turn any play upside down. Team up with friends or practise against bots offline.

apps.name: Fluffy Alchemist
apps.short_description: A cozy exploration game about a red panda alchemist. Explore five islands where night never falls, gather ingredients that each behave differently, brew potions and fill your Book of Brews. No timers, no enemies, nothing is ever lost when you fail.

apps.name: Fly&Goal
apps.short_description: A casual puzzle game where you play disc golf while navigating holes that showcase the changing seasons. Read the wind to choose your throw, dodge obstacles, and aim to clear all 12 courses, each with 9 holes.

apps.name: Folk-Tography
apps.short_description: Folk-Tography is a 4-player co-op cryptid photography extraction game. Photograph legendary creatures, investigate paranormal anomalies, manage scarce resources, and survive various dangers to escape with the evidence before the valley consumes you.

apps.name: Food Devils
apps.short_description: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Tactics-RPG Roguelite.

apps.name: Football Academy Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own football academy! Create personalized training programs, improve your players' skills, rent out equipment, keep your facilities clean, and manage your sports shop. Build a squad from your best trainees and take your academy to the top of the Fantasy League.

apps.name: FOOTBALL EXECUTIVE 27
apps.short_description: Football Executive 27 is a detailed football management simulation from the sporting director's perspective. Hire coaches and staff, build your squad, scout talent, negotiate transfers and contracts, and shape your club's long-term success.

apps.name: For Some Water
apps.short_description: There isn't enough water for everyone. As a water distribution officer in drought-stricken Barbunya, you decide who gets water and who goes without. Check documents, enforce government orders, bend the rules, and face the consequences. In Barbunya, every drop comes at a price.

apps.name: For We Are Many
apps.short_description: You are humanity's last line of defense. Build your towers, bring down devastating firepower, and fight on the front lines to protect the seals from the endless hordes of Hell. If they fall, so do Heaven and Earth. Alone or with up to three friends.

apps.name: Forest Mind
apps.short_description: Escape the noise of the city and seek refuge in your grandfather's forgotten cabin. But as night falls, the forest begins to reveal something far more terrifying than you expected.

apps.name: Forestless
apps.short_description: Forestless is an atmospheric psychological adventure that takes you on a journey through the world of fear, armed only with the magical arrow of hope. Explore the vastness of human nightmares, from the foggy lands of loneliness to the mountains of failure.

apps.name: Forge of the Fae
apps.short_description: Forge of the Fae is a story-rich pixel RPG inspired by Celtic folklore. Journey through a mysterious world, master the ARC Crystal System to unleash powerful magic, and face dangerous Fae in fast-paced, turn-based battles where your choices shape destiny.

apps.name: Forged Cards
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where YOU forge the cards. Slot casts into molds, temper their power, and etch combo inscriptions. Pick your path, battle, bargain, or brave the unknown, then outplay your enemy in simultaneous, position-based combat. Each run is different and each deck yours.

apps.name: Forged from Monsters
apps.short_description: Not every sword begins as steel. Forge weapons from monster parts with hands-on control over every step of the process. Discover surprising effective combinations of creature parts heroes bring to your smithy.

apps.name: Forgotten Tavern
apps.short_description: Run a tavern simulation set in a hidden Korean mountain village. Gather ingredients through unpredictable weather, discover traditional Korean recipes, and serve mystical Dokkaebi and villagers. Get to know your guests by discovering their favourite dishes and unique preferences.

apps.name: Forsaken Fleet
apps.short_description: A first-person pirate horror where a haunted fisherman is drawn into the legend of the Forsaken Fleet. Follow a mysterious compass. Sail through the fog. Explore forgotten places and survive the horrors that should have stayed buried at sea.

apps.name: FortFall
apps.short_description: Build your defenses. Choose your class. Hold the Core. FortFall is a third-person fantasy defense game for solo play or private online co-op with up to five players. Raise walls, repair the damage, and fight escalating waves with melee weapons, bows, spells, and sentries.

apps.name: Fractured Rift: Incremental
apps.short_description: An incremental RPG auto-battler where you build and customize a team of allies to conquer increasingly difficult floors.

apps.name: Fragmenta: Ancient Egypt
apps.short_description: Restore the lost treasures of Ancient Egypt in a relaxing 3D reconstruction puzzle experience. Every artifact is shattered into a unique arrangement of fragments, offering endless replayability across multiple difficulty levels, from casual sessions to expert challenges.

apps.name: FranticFarWest
apps.short_description: A saloon, cowboys, a sheriff, an outlaw, a table and revolvers. The perfect setting for a frantic debate, with just one question: who will shoot? Deductions, lies, surprises and laughter are all part of this online hidden-role game for 4 to 12 players.

apps.name: Fred's Idle Garden
apps.short_description: A cozy idle farming simulator that hangs out on your desktop while you work, study or just chill 🌻

apps.name: Frex: Ambivalence
apps.short_description: A high-speed action game blending fluid movement and stylish sword combat, as you push through intense stages and confront enemies shaped by a broken world.

apps.name: Friendly Fire Club
apps.short_description: Blast your friends off the map! A chaotic physics party shooter where every bullet does something ridiculous: flip controls, teleport, launch, blind. Online matches for 2–10 players, or play solo vs bots.

apps.name: Friends Park
apps.short_description: A co-op puzzle game for up to 2-6 friends where every level plays by its own rules.

apps.name: FROG IN THE HOLE!
apps.short_description: Breed frogs, throw them into the hole and get paid. In this incremental sandbox, you'll build physics-based factories, to scale from manual tossing to managing up to 100,000 physics frogs. Master the skill tree and chain combos. What happens to the frogs? BECOME WORTHY.

apps.name: From Ashes To Glory
apps.short_description: A dark, turn-based medieval arena RPG. You are a slave forced to fight. Master range, stamina, and timing-based dodges. Choose your weapon, build your skills, and face warriors from seven continents. Every fight is a puzzle. Every mistake costs blood.

apps.name: Frontier Tavern
apps.short_description: Run your own tavern in this first-person business simulator. Serve drinks, restock supplies and keep customers happy. Hire staff to automate daily tasks, unlock new drinks and reinvest your earnings to grow your business in the Old West.

apps.name: FRONTLINE ADVANCE: DARK FRONTIER
apps.short_description: FRONTLINE ADVANCE: DARK FRONTIER is a classic 2D real-time strategy game in the style of the golden age of RTS, but with its own unique identity: three factions, a dark science fiction conflict, and authentic base-building gameplay that players have been missing for years.

apps.name: Full Breach
apps.short_description: Full Breach is a single-player 2D tactical shooter with door breaching, physics-based combat, and bloody firefights that leave walls and floors covered in blood splatter. Clear buildings, use bullet time and recon vision, unlock weapons, and upgrade your operator.

apps.name: Full Metal Hell
apps.short_description: Full Metal Hell is a roguelite shooter combining physics-based collisions and active abilities. Choose from a wide variety of vehicles, weapons, and builds, and crush everything in your path through the mechanical hordes!

apps.name: Fungi Guards
apps.short_description: Defend a bioluminescent forest in Fungi Guards, a strategic tower defense game! Deploy and upgrade sentient fungi with unique elemental traits and tactical synergies to repel relentless waves of slimy Slug and Snail Men. Plan, adapt, and evolve your fungal defenders to save your home.

apps.name: Furry Snow Leopard
apps.short_description: Furry Snow Leopard is a seductive adult puzzle game featuring a charming snow leopard heroine. Uncover her boldest looks, unlock steamy illustrations, and step by step discover what lies behind her cold yet alluring gaze.

apps.name: FUTA gone WILD
apps.short_description: FUTA gone WILD - is a relaxing Arkanoid-style game where you destroy tiles to unlock hot animations with beautiful futanari.

apps.name: FUTAHAMMER
apps.short_description: In the grim darkness of the far future, the girls pack their own heavy artillery. A sci-fi parody arcade breaker where you smash heretical blocks to unlock explicit, uncensored futanari scenes. No diplomacy, no dialogue—just heavy metal physics and massive payloads.

apps.name: Futaland Love of the Dead
apps.short_description: Flirt with femboy and futanari characters in an 18+ NSFW visual novel mixing romance and zombie comedy. Build relationships through dialogue choices, unlock animated adult scenes, and tackle mini-games where you prepare pizza orders, mix cocktails, solve puzzles, and test your timing.

apps.name: Galactiball
apps.short_description:
The next great party game... until someone starts taking it seriously.
Kick your friends into the goal. Dive across the arena for a last-second save. Launch an opponent into an incoming boulder. Play locally with your friends or hit the ladder and show the world what you're made of!

apps.name: GALLANT
apps.short_description: GALLANT is a multiplayer platform shooter for 2-10 players. Throw vials, draw cards between rounds, and adapt your strategy as your powers evolve. When skill meets luck across the many arenas, only one can claim the title of Grand Alchemist of Fortune!

apps.name: GameJam 水群模拟器
apps.short_description: A story-driven game featuring Chinese-style group chat simulation + Game Jam Survival Guide. You will join an online group and experience the full 21-day game development competition: teaming up, arguing, teammates ghosting, and more. It truly captures the laughter and struggles of indie developers.

apps.name: Gangsters Way
apps.short_description: Gangsters Way is a dynamic, adrenaline-fueled third-person fighting game where you step into the shoes of street gangster John Brown. Challenge the mafia and earn respect and a place in the criminal underworld through fists and blood.

apps.name: Gardenkin
apps.short_description: Return life to a forgotten community garden. Clear the overgrowth, bring back the water, grow crops and flowers, and welcome seven neighbours back one by one, with a rabbit and a hedgehog lending a paw. A gentle, cozy garden restoration game.

apps.name: Gate B7
apps.short_description: Verify documents, stamp boarding passes, and uphold the regime's strict laws at a dystopian airport terminal. Every decision matters: take bribes to keep your family alive, or stay loyal to survive your 20-day shift. But be careful: Some anomalies aren't found on paper.

apps.name: GEARSMITH
apps.short_description: A pixel-art action roguelite. Fight through cellars, forests and a lava mine, beat the bosses, and take the gear you find to the forge. Each upgrade gets riskier, and pushing for +10 can break the item for good.

apps.name: GemCremental
apps.short_description:
Craft a variety of gems and become the greatest witch!
It's a cozy incremental crafting game.

apps.name: Gene Gone Wild
apps.short_description: Build your own beast from animal heads, limbs, and tails. GENE GONE WILD is a creature-building survivor roguelite: buy and merge body parts, combine traits and synergies, and grow your gene talent tree as your tiny creature evolves into a walking arsenal.

apps.name: General Staff Black Powder Wargaming System
apps.short_description: The General Staff: Black Powder Wargaming System is the ultimate in simulating 18th and 19th century battles. Built around the MATE AI it comes with dozens of battles (Waterloo, Gettysburg, Little Big Horn (with alternative scenarios including Gatling guns), Antietam, and more.

apps.name: Generic Fighter Maybe
apps.short_description: A classic arcade-style 2D Fighting Game, wrapped up in a goofy, full-of-energy, stylized presentation that mixes great animation and zany battle moves with simplistic doodles!

apps.name: Genome Warriors : Resistance to Invasion
apps.short_description: In this roguelike top-down shooter game, progress by defeating enemies in randomly generated levels. Upgrade your cell, gain advantages with temporary boosts, and try different strategies each time.

apps.name: Geo Bobs
apps.short_description: GeoBobs is a multiplayer geo location party game! Study a picture, explore a 3D map, and race your friends to find where it was taken. Lock in your guess, earn points based on accuracy, and prove you've got the best eye for detail.

apps.name: Geometry Rift: Apocalypse
apps.short_description: The ultimate arcade chaos unfolds in this explosive bullet hell roguelite. Survive thousands of geometric enemies on screen, combine weapons and powers to create absurdly overpowered builds, and blast your way through colossal bosses solo or with a friend.

apps.name: Germline
apps.short_description: Raise 60 species from a single cell to adulthood in a single-player idle game. Build connected organs, automate growth, hunt rare colour morphs and crossbreed your favourites. Expand into habitats and universes, then reset reality for lasting upgrades.

apps.name: Gestalt Journey
apps.short_description: An incremental game (a clicker) where everything keeps growing while you decide where to put your resources. And a history lesson: as you play, you learn the real story of Gestalt therapy — its people, theories, books and organisations.

apps.name: GET RAMMED
apps.short_description: GET RAMMED is a multiplayer party game with up to 8 players where you play as chaotic goats trying to RAM each other off the stage! Challenge each other with a playful mix of unique maps, power-ups and unexpected events!

apps.name: Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory
apps.short_description: Run a Christmas gift factory with unruly gnomes in this short management game! Wrap gifts yourself, set up production equipment, manage your gnomes, and assign tasks. Turn a chaotic workshop into a smoothly running factory before Christmas.

apps.name: Get-Out-Hoomanz
apps.short_description: A chaotic 2-4 player dungeon crawler! Sabotage your friends' dungeons with deadly traps, loot everything in sight, and escape the show alive. Can you survive your friends' hazards or just another human snack?

apps.name: Ghost in the Cloud
apps.short_description: Dive deep into the Net, build the ultimate deck, install busted plugins, and fight ever more powerful Bots and Avatars in fast-paced tactical combat that combines turn based and real time mechanics, all to realize your wish, or perish trying.

apps.name: Ghostly Late Night Show
apps.short_description: Step into the role of a mischievous ghost in VR or nonVR adventure show filled with slapstick humor and puzzles. Sneak into Billy’s home, manipulate objects, and set up ingenious traps. Join a supernatural late night show, dazzle your audience of specters, and uncover the touching story of Billy.

apps.name: Ghosts Don't Need Doors
apps.short_description: Even ghosts dream of freedom! Help a little ghost escape a haunted mansion, where everyday objects hide clues to secret passages. Observe, deduce, and slip through walls to reach the moonlight.

apps.name: GIG: Specimen Quota
apps.short_description: Explore abandoned facilities and meet the rescue quota. Form a squad of up to 4 players and save adorable specimens, each with a personality of its own. Careful! Not everything in there is adorable.

apps.name: Girlfailure Art Club
apps.short_description: Fall in love again with the cringey otaku girls who spent their school days drawing in the corner. Packed with 2010s otaku culture, memes, and second-hand embarrassment, this visual novel lets you relive a painfully cute youth with the oddballs of a Japanese art club!

apps.name: Glaciered
apps.short_description: Soar the seas at the end of time. 65 million years in the future, the world has frozen over, and the oceans have been sealed under a thick layer of ice. Become a Tuai—a species that evolved from birds—and protect the Everwinter in this futuristic underwater action game.

apps.name: Glass Tanks
apps.short_description: Top down 3D retro arcade shooter with sideways physics. Grab a friend for couch co-op against ten genuinely rude AI tanks across 30+ levels, or go it alone and skip the witnesses. Endless customization, class and arcade modes and more keep the game scratching that nostalgic itch for years.

apps.name: Glass Wing
apps.short_description: The adventure of a young, scared, but smart girl.

apps.name: glitch.exe
apps.short_description: glitch.exe is a free-to-play hacking horror game where you infiltrate corrupted systems, uncover hidden secrets and piece together a story that was never meant to be found. Explore a unsettling digital world full of mystery, tension and things that should not exist.

apps.name: Global Conflagration
apps.short_description: Global Conflagration is a real-time strategy game inspired by the classics featuring modern controls and streamlined mechanics. Build lots of tanks, infantry, helicopters and aircraft to destroy the enemy base.

apps.name: Glowpits: Farmers Arena
apps.short_description: Explore the world of GlowPits, collect valuable resources, defeat rival explorers, unlock unique characters, and upgrade powerful abilities in a fast-paced arena adventure filled with creatures, challenges, and endless progression.

apps.name: Glyphweaver
apps.short_description: Glyphweaver is a spellcasting roguelite where you draw every spell yourself! Explore procedurally generated dungeons, unlock new spells, and combine them with powerful modifiers to survive deadly enemies and bosses. No hotkeys. Draw, modify, cast, survive.

apps.name: GNAP GNAP
apps.short_description: GNAP GNAP is a horde roguelite shooter where you pop ominous balloons that keep multiplying. Unlock items, harpoons and grow stronger with each run. Equip your harpoon, max your stats and defeat all the entities keeping you against your will.

apps.name: Gnome Acres
apps.short_description: A cozy farming game where a village of gnomes does the work. Draw fields, pick what grows, and watch your gnomes plant, water, harvest and haul every crop through spring, summer, autumn and winter.

apps.name: Gnomed
apps.short_description: Gnomed is a roguelite clicker base defence game where your humble home is the last line of defense. Hold out against 20 chaotic waves of enemies, unlock new abilities, and grow stronger each run!

apps.name: GO DUB YOURSELF!
apps.short_description: Grab a mic and dub over your favourite clips with your friends. Turn any video into a clip pack, share it on the workshop, then battle it out on the couch or online for up to 12 players. Auto score or judge each other, the choice is yours!

apps.name: Go! Super Awesome Monkey!
apps.short_description: Play as SAM in Go! Super Awesome Monkey and save the world from AI Tech Overlords in this cute 3D Platformer!  Collect pizza slices, coins, & floppy discs by spinning, dashing, and slamming (and more!) in 100+ levels.  Play at your own pace: casually explore or speedrun to rise up the leaderboards!

apps.name: Golfcremental
apps.short_description:
BUILD! GOLF! EARN! BUY!
Turn $50 into your own golfing empire by building custom golf courses and then automating them to get hole in ones. Unlock unique golf course pieces and use them in unique ways to make more money.

apps.name: GOLUBI
apps.short_description: Embark on a surreal adventure that feels like a strange dream. Explore unusual places, meet their inhabitants, solve puzzles, and piece together the story.

apps.name: Goreagulation
apps.short_description: Deposited into a labyrinth of flesh and metal, you see things others won't believe, experience horrors beyond ordinary comprehension, and witness impossibilities that drive lesser men mad. Only one directive remains evident in your mind - Ascend the Spire. Destroy the Eye.

apps.name: GRAFT
apps.short_description: YOU ARE THE SHIP OF THESEUS. Who, or what, will you be when you escape the Arc? A story-driven survival horror RPG from the makers of the Shadowrun Trilogy.

apps.name: Grandpa's Garden
apps.short_description: Grow weed, roll joints and deliver to your customers in this top-down pixel crime game while the police patrol the streets. Hire dealers and gardeners, launder your money and turn a motel room into an empire. Play alone or with up to five friends.

apps.name: Grape by Grape
apps.short_description: A cozy vineyard idler where your cursor makes vines grow. Turn 14 grape varieties into aged wine, raisins, vinegar and pekmez; automate six connected estate stations and fill customer orders. No frantic clicking, no failure—just one more harvest, bottle and upgrade.

apps.name: Gravefever
apps.short_description: Punch, gun down, and freeze endless waves of monsters in this survivors-style roguelike. Grow your build from skill branches and capstones, topple mega-bosses to reach new arenas, and bank gold for permanent training. Every run ends in death — the clock is your score. How long can you last?

apps.name: Graveyard Cabin
apps.short_description: An FMV anomaly horror game. You are a night guard at a desolate graveyard. Monitor the cameras, spot the unnatural, and survive.

apps.name: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand
apps.short_description: A dark pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. You're the mortician the night the dead stop staying dead — turn every corpse into cards, forge them to Ascended rank, and survive 22 nights, three rule-breaking bosses, and one thing that was never meant to have a name.

apps.name: Gravity Defied Reincarnation
apps.short_description: An unofficial remake of the 2004 keypad phone classic. Lean the rider to keep the bike balanced, ride over hills and drops and reach the finish on 30 tracks. Original mode rebuilds the classic physics, Modern mode rides smoother. Four bikes, pixel art and 31 original songs.

apps.name: Greedspire
apps.short_description: Build powerful gear combos in a push-your-luck roguelike auto-battler. Enchant your gear to +20 or watch it shatter. Move to the next floor, or risk your entire run for richer loot in deadlier rooms. 100 floors. One life. How greedy will you get?

apps.name: Greedy Little Kingdoms
apps.short_description: A short-run roguelike city builder. Gather timber, craft lanterns and magic potions, fulfil demands from frogs, plague doctors, and swamp dragons. Explore the hex map, survive the King's moods, and find the artefacts that break your economy wide open. Repeat.

apps.name: Greek War
apps.short_description: Greek War is a 3D turn-based tactical strategy game that blends the reasoning of chess with the cunning of tic-tac-toe, all set in a battlefield inspired by the grandeur of Ancient Greece.

apps.name: Grim Guild
apps.short_description: You never go on the adventure. You only decide who does. Run the adventurers' guild your grandfather left you: find out what is out there, from dire wolves to a dragon in the old workings, write the contract, and wait at the door to count who comes back. Streaming? Name newcomers after your viewers.

apps.name: Grimli & Friends
apps.short_description: A fun, goofy bullet heaven for wonderful people. Play solo, team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op, or fight them in 4-player Horde War. Horde survival, tower defense, and roguelike advancement.

apps.name: Grimoire of Monsters
apps.short_description: Co-op bullet heaven for 1-5 players with a twist: one player controls the monsters. Survive the hordes together, or become the Grimoire Master, spawn the swarm, and turn the bosses on your friends. Which side are you on?

apps.name: GRINDWORM
apps.short_description: A short horror game where you pilot a grinddozer through a nightmare buried underground. Why are the walls twitching? Is that flesh? Yes. It is. This is no longer mining. This is surgery... DON'T. STOP. DIGGING.

apps.name: Groovekeeper
apps.short_description: A first-person record-sorting game: no customers, no economy, no time pressure. Shelve the records that come out of the crates by genre, put rare ones on the turntable and listen. As the shelves fill up, we guarantee relaxation.

apps.name: Gross Survivors
apps.short_description: Play as the grossest survivors in town in this fast-paced top-down roguelite! Armed with raw fart power and other foul abilities, blast through endless enemy swarms across 2 arenas. Collect coins, upgrade your powers, and turn your nastiest traits into ultimate weapons!

apps.name: Gumpy Brawl
apps.short_description: Welcome to Gumpy Brawl, the competitive multiplayer platformer where vintage cartoons meet chaotic action!

apps.name: GUNBOAT-8
apps.short_description: Command the ultimate vessel in this 1-4 player fast-paced naval bullet-heaven roguelike! Blast through enemy fleets, collect powerful upgrades, and combine devastating synergies to create wildly overpowered builds before the waves overwhelm you.

apps.name: Guns 'n Goblins
apps.short_description: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

apps.name: GymPup
apps.short_description: GymPup is a furry-themed romance narrative game that blends desktop idle gameplay with visual novel elements. Through their journey together, you watch the two protagonists grow and change—inside and out.

apps.name: Habet
apps.short_description: You were sold onto the sand and walked off it free. Now you own men who stand where you stood. Buy them, train them, send them out to bleed. Every one of them wants what you were given, and however long you last, the sand is waiting.

apps.name: HACHIKOMA: Underground Stadium No. 8
apps.short_description: Anime spinning-top battles in an endless underground passage. If something is wrong, turn back. If nothing is wrong, beat the blader who waits and walk on. Spot the anomalies, win the battles and reach the exit 8... if it exists.

apps.name: Hackagon: Cyber Card Battler
apps.short_description: HACKAGON is a fast 1v1 cyber card battler. Breach the network with the red team or defend it with the blue team. Cards are played face-down and revealed at the same time, so victory comes from reading your opponent, not moving first. Build your 12-card deck, claim the areas, and take the network.

apps.name: Hacker Cats
apps.short_description: Who needs human hackers when you have cats? Lead a crew of fluffy cybercriminals, hack servers, steal valuable data, research new technologies, and conquer the Internet one paw at a time.

apps.name: Half-Rats: Parasomnia
apps.short_description: A single-player total-conversion Horror modification for Half-Life 1, set in the late 1800's.

apps.name: Halmweit
apps.short_description: A cozy building game to play alone or with friends. You share one village, one storehouse and everyone who lives there. Chop trees, plant fields, lay a railway and get your village through the winter. There's no fighting, and you can't lose.

apps.name: Handshakes: Hands On
apps.short_description: Handshakes: Hands On is a wholesome puzzle game all about shaking hands. With puzzles designed to foster discovery and gently guide the player towards their own solution, you can play alone or with a friend and get your hands dirty in this simple and surprising puzzler.

apps.name: Happy Happy Little Shop
apps.short_description: Run a little shop that fixes people's moods. Serve customers, deal with six difficult siblings, and make choices that shape your shop, your family, and the whole town.

apps.name: Happy Little Farm
apps.short_description:
Happy Little Farm is a cozy incremental farming game where you grow a small, happy farm with cute animals. Plant crops, care for animals, and enjoy peaceful days.

However, after the sun goes down, it may be best not to check whether the animals are truly happy.

apps.name: Hardtrace
apps.short_description: Hardtrace is a couch‑vs‑couch party game for 12+ players on a single screen. Win by skillfully maneuvering through point‑packed zones or by letting a greedier player do the risky work for you. Use your personal portals to jump across the arena in a fraction of a second.

apps.name: Harvest Looper
apps.short_description: Harvest plants, unlock upgrades, and expand your farming loop through skill trees, perks, and powerful harvesters. Collect fragments, complete Hidden Book sets, and optimize your incremental growth.

apps.name: Haul Yeah!
apps.short_description: Load it, strap it, drive it. A colourful delivery-driving sandbox for one or two players. Stack real physics cargo, tighten the straps and haul it across a mountain county in split-screen co-op or solo. Build your business with better trucks, custom parts and bigger jobs.

apps.name: HAUNTED: Escape the Dollhouse
apps.short_description:
One player investigates a mysterious dollhouse while their friends are trapped inside it. 
A chaotic and highly replayable co-op paranormal investigation for 2–4 players. Share clues, solve occult puzzles, and try not to panic when your friends give terrible directions.

apps.name: Haymaker
apps.short_description: Brawl your way through enemies with brutal, fast-paced, physics-driven VR hand combat. Be prepared to sweat it out as you dole out velocity-based damage and use your back and shoulders to deliver kicks and knees. Meet the challenge however you see fit

apps.name: Hazard Suits
apps.short_description:
HAZARD SUITS is a 1-4 player co-op, arcade shooter. With acid rain, procedurally-generated maps, and endless waves of zombified robots. Explore abandoned facilities, acquire new loot, survive!
Did we mention it has split-screen!

apps.name: Heart of the Bunker
apps.short_description: The hero ends up in a sealed bunker with futuristic tech. Salvation turns into a trap: systems are silent, doors locked. Good news? There’s a cute girl here. Bad news? The only way out seems to be a suspicious portal that could lead anywhere… or nowhere.

apps.name: Heartreave
apps.short_description: A turn-based hack-and-slash where every fight is played with cards. Assemble a party, solo or in online co-op, and craft unique builds by combining cards, passives, talents, relics, creature hearts and island hearts to find the best synergies and push ever deeper.

apps.name: Heat: Pedal to the Metal
apps.short_description: Play your cards strategically and push your engine to the limit in Heat: Pedal to the Metal, the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Manage your speed, master every corner and race through the golden age of 1960s motorsport against friends, Legends and players worldwide.

apps.name: Heavensmith: Dungeon Unbound
apps.short_description: Explore dungeons in a single-player, turn-based RPG. Learn skills across classes, craft gear with your choice of materials, and lead a party of up to five against bosses. Develop your village and build bonds with your companions.

apps.name: Heavyweight Saint
apps.short_description: Control two bodies bound to one relentless soul in a dark, dystopian Manhattan. Infiltrate restricted zones using social disguises, vertical stealth, and tactical coordination in an atmospheric third-person stealth game.

apps.name: Hedenite
apps.short_description: Hedenite  is a hand-painted adventure through a city that has lost its memory. Befriend whimsical characters, unearth secrets of the past hidden in plain sight, and smuggle yourself uptown!

apps.name: HELENA : Cloud District
apps.short_description: HELENA: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.

apps.name: Helion Conflict
apps.short_description: Real-time strategy stripped to the decision. Every factory you hold builds without pause - you choose where those ships go, and can turn them in mid-flight. Commander mode adds the war economy: iron and gold networks, turrets, satellites, orbital strikes. Up to eight online.

apps.name: Hell Games
apps.short_description: Get ready for Hell Games: In this action packed player vs player arena brawler 4 fallen athletes, once cheaters and dopers, battle it out in the depths of hell. Knock out opponents with sports gear, power up, and strive to be the last one standing.

apps.name: Hell Rite
apps.short_description: A dark dungeon-crawling RPG about venturing into dangerous ruins, defeating enemies, and bringing back powerful loot. Explore procedurally generated dungeons and hand-crafted story locations, uncover mysterious treasures, and grow your character through powerful skills, abilities, and gear.

apps.name: Hello Triangle: Build a GPU
apps.short_description: Ever wonder how a GPU draws a triangle? In Hello Triangle, you build one yourself. Wire comparators, adders, and multipliers into graphics hardware, press Run, and watch your circuit draw the screen pixel by pixel—from a single triangle up to a rotating 3D cube.

apps.name: Hentai Age Mansion
apps.short_description: Embark on a timer-free, relaxing puzzle adventure where completing tranquil mosaics unlocks stunning artwork and beautiful portraits of maidens, offering the ultimate stress-free escape.

apps.name: Hentai Age Onsen
apps.short_description: Solve block-fitting puzzles and unlock sexy character scenes as your reward. Find the perfect fit and reveal what awaits beyond each completed board.

apps.name: Her Next Chapter
apps.short_description: A cozy sticker game about finding your place after graduation. Arrange little objects to build street corners, a rented room, and a dream garden full of cats. Follow a young woman's next chapter, one sticker and one small kindness at a time.

apps.name: Hero's Guild
apps.short_description: Your heroes are people. They form bonds, take grudges, fall in love, and die permanently. Run a guild of brilliant, emotionally unstable adventurers — and watch their story write itself.

apps.name: HeroesSagaZero
apps.short_description: A muscle wizard who beats foes with a staff, a meathead tank who won't protect allies, a healer who only casts offensive spells. Break every RPG rule! Mix gear, stats, and skills to dream up builds even when you're not playing. A strategic hack-and-slash roguelite RPG with 2.5D pixel-art battles.

apps.name: Hex & Hunters
apps.short_description: Hex & Hunters is a fast-paced action roguelite where you program your own dungeons and create complex projectiles to battle through rooms of various enemies, unlocking new biomes, items and foes.

apps.name: Hexa-Gone
apps.short_description: Pieces are falling, and you need to do something about it! Match like colors together to clear them, and if you make a shape, you’ll earn some points. Points are your score in Singleplayer modes, and are used as a currency in Multiplayer modes. Use them to buy Power-Ups and make a comeback!

apps.name: Hexdrive
apps.short_description: Hexdrive is a high-speed endurance racing game where every decision matters. Overtake rivals, manage energy, heat and damage, and build your machine through the HEX lattice to survive long, high-speed races.

apps.name: Higanbana
apps.short_description: A co-op souls-like, where a young Samurai and cursed Doll work together to traverse an abandoned land swarmed with Yokai. Together with a spear and magic, they must defeat the challenging foes and unforgiving bosses to restore the Dolls original body and save the Samurai’s village.

apps.name: High Noon Husk
apps.short_description: A cartoony Wild West shooter for you and your friends. Revolver, sniper, shotgun, crossbow, and melee. Earn killstreaks such as a bull stampede, flaming tumbleweed that bounces off walls, drop a piano or safe on a group of enemies. Five unique game modes, online with friends or solo against bots.

apps.name: High Voltage
apps.short_description: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game about building your power grid. Start with a pedal-powered generator, expand with wind and solar power and keep the city supplied with electricity. Upgrade, complete contracts and see how far you can grow your network.

apps.name: Highway-Formosa
apps.short_description: Hit the roads of Taiwan in a retro arcade racer. Dodge traffic, grab nitro boosts, and beat the clock in your red convertible. Choose branching routes across six vibrant settings, take on boss chases, and chase high scores to each setting's own soundtrack.

apps.name: His Umbrella Is Dry
apps.short_description: Hong Kong, 1999. The rain hasn't stopped. Your uncle has left you his paper offerings shop. Fold gold ingots, write names, paint faces on paper figures and serve the customers who come in from the rain. He left one rule: never write a name for a man whose umbrella is dry.

apps.name: Hit or Die
apps.short_description:
Four players, one table, the number 21. Draw, stand, or bluff. Whoever ends the round
furthest from the target gets the mallet, the anvil, or the revolver. Cheat with scissors,
dice and a syringe you keep in your own drawer. Chips are your health. Last one breathing
wins.

apps.name: Hive and Harvest
apps.short_description: Death is dying, and five hives are fighting over the rot that's left. A trading card game about insects you grow from parts, a card at a time. Plant a parasite in an enemy creature, seed it with spores until it changes sides, or just break it and race your opponent to the pieces.

apps.name: Hold Morale
apps.short_description: A turn-based tactics roguelite. Lead your campaign across a branching war map, fight grid battles on land, sea, and air, and combine retrofit kits into powerful synergies. Keep your army's morale alive, because if it breaks, the campaign is lost.

apps.name: Holdopolis
apps.short_description: One toilet. An entire city desperate to use it. Build districts, draw queues, deliver paper and haul away waste. Handle breakdowns, strikes and elections in a satirical city builder where one locked door can bring everything to a standstill.

apps.name: HollowCity:EscapeFromSeoul
apps.short_description: 'HollowCity' is a PvE top-down extraction shooter set in a ruined city. Solo or with up to 4 players, you must explore various zones and gather survival supplies. Hostile humans aren't the only threats to your life. Fight through monsters born from unknown causes and escape safely.

apps.name: Hollowed Oath
apps.short_description: Hollowed Oath is a fantasy MMORPG set in the beautiful yet fractured world of Orrathis.
