Thousands of people searched haystacks on their farms for needles—and apparently, not carefully enough. 
Now the needles they missed have entered the supply chain. Inspect the bales and stop them before they reach the customers.
Every needle must be removed. Except one very special needle…

apps.name: No One Gets Through
apps.short_description: Free demo available! A free-placement tower defense game with roguelite card upgrades. Redirect enemies, choose one of three upgrade cards, and buy upgrades and supplies at the Battlefield Shop. Shape your build and hold the line with overlapping fire.

apps.name: Noblefold: Kingdoms of Chance
apps.short_description: Your crown is on the line. Build your kingdom, place your bets, and cheat to keep it all. Put gold, harvests and entire settlements on the table against ruthless creditors in a blackjack roguelike deckbuilder where your kingdom is the ultimate stake.

apps.name: Nocturnal Hunt
apps.short_description:
Be a wolf in a forest full of cruel hunters and rescue your stolen cub. 
Sneak your way through the gloomy woods or rip your opponents apart. No matter how, find your way to Brasov - the village of the hunters and the core of the evil.
Hunt or you will be hunted!

apps.name: North Pole Workshop
apps.short_description: Explore the magical North Pole Workshop in this festive co-op toy-making game for 1-4 players. Team up with your merry elves and lightly strategize how to complete various toy recipes. Craft, wrap, and deliver toys to Santa's sleigh for all the good boys and girls!

apps.name: Northgrave County
apps.short_description: Northgrave County is a third-person multiplayer zombie survival game. Scavenge a 20 x 20 km county, craft from over 450 items, fortify a safehouse, farm, drive and fight for every day on persistent dedicated servers, alone or with friends.

apps.name: NOT Home Free
apps.short_description: A 4-player online co-op game set in a uniquely crafted liminal world. Pay your bills, fortify your home, and try to survive the uninvited “guests” waiting for you after dark.

apps.name: Number Bound
apps.short_description: Explore, battle, build, and collect in Number Bound, a family-friendly adventure where math and trivia unlock rewards. Play solo or with up to three friends, collect plushies, go fishing, build with nearly fully editable world objects. 3 Mini games including Fox Quest a game in a game!

apps.name: Obsidian Tower
apps.short_description: Defend the Obsidian Tower in a roguelike tower defense on procedurally generated hex paths. Build crossbows, flamethrowers, Tesla coils and mortars, combine fire, poison, ice and lightning, draft run cards between waves, and spend banked XP on permanent upgrades.

apps.name: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals
apps.short_description: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals is a cozy desktop companion that blends witchy aesthetics and real productivity tools. Plan your day, care for plants, read fortunes, pet magical familiars, customize your desk and avatar, and play minigames during your breaks.

apps.name: Occult Trap
apps.short_description:
Within the test chambers filled with horrific traps and unidentified creatures,
you must analyze the creatures’ behavior patterns and use the environment to escape their relentless pursuit.
Search the surroundings to gather items, disable or exploit traps, and forge your path forward.

apps.name: OddXI
apps.short_description: The football sticker roguelike. OddXI is a gloriously daft deckbuilder where you rip open packs of deeply odd footballers, stack their traits into ridiculous combos, and drag your XI through three nerve-shredding seasons against absurd bosses: vegan pirates, a goth band and ancient philosophers.

apps.name: ODEZIE
apps.short_description: Found your own rail company and run passenger services on Germany's real railway network: route trains over real tracks, build regular-interval timetables, plan train rotations and crew rosters – and watch every track-access fee hit your balance. Germany is playable at launch.

apps.name: Odysseus' 13th Ship
apps.short_description: Play as the forgotten 13th Ship of Odysseus. Cooperate with your friends to ascend the mountain of abstract geometric shapes. Do you have what it takes to reach Ithaca?

apps.name: Oh No, Meteor!
apps.short_description: Oh No, Meteor! is a short incremental game. Chop trees with your cursor, send lumberjacks, haulers, and miners to work, then spend wood, stone, and coins on a huge skill tree, talent cards, and artifacts before the meteor hits the town.

apps.name: Oink & Coin
apps.short_description: Smash a mountain of a million piggy banks with up to 3 friends. Pick locks, crack safes and drill bolts to open every piggy, haul them by wheelbarrow, build a piggy factory, then break your way down a seven-floor pit to the gold floor.

apps.name: OKeverything: Realm of Humanity
apps.short_description: Ethan, a community college history teacher, investigated the school's finances to fight for his daughter's custody. However, he was targeted by the Spade Society and the Veil Club, falling into a desperate situation of a humanity test, struggling to survive with his "sister" and "aunt".

apps.name: Old Man's Sushi
apps.short_description: No free handouts, earn your legacy! Grandpa wants to leave his sushi shop to you, but he doubts you're ready. Catch fresh fish, roll delicious sushi, collect antiques, and clear Grandpa's To-Do List to prove your worth!

apps.name: On Love, On Monsters
apps.short_description: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.

apps.name: One Hop Further
apps.short_description: Climb through five pixel-art worlds, switching lanes and dodging traps as the void rises beneath you. Unlock over 100 characters or draw your own, then chase a new high score with a keyboard, mouse, controller, or touch screen.

apps.name: One Must Fall 2197: Singularity
apps.short_description: A free 1v1 robot fighting game: the 1994 classic One Must Fall 2097, rebuilt in HD. 21 giant robots, 15 arenas, a Tournament career with a mech lab, Arcade, Training, and versus on one PC or online with Steam friends. Fight with supers and EX moves, or switch to the original rules.

apps.name: OnzeFoot
apps.short_description: Manager de futebol clássico: assuma um clube num mundo de 8 países e 640 clubes, dispute liga, copa e um Mundial de clubes, negocie no mercado e responda a uma diretoria que cobra resultado. Gratuito para jogar, em Acesso Antecipado.

apps.name: OPEN UP! IT'S ME
apps.short_description: You're ten years old and home alone. Guests are arriving, but not everyone can be trusted. Look through the peephole, ask questions, search for clues, and decide who to let in. Not every guest belongs at your holiday table.

apps.name: Operation: Horumus
apps.short_description: Combine eight modules into 120 defense builds in a deadpan political-satire tower defense. Survive a seven-day story campaign, master a 100-stage maze, and stop every tanker crossing the Strait of Horumus.

apps.name: OrbGuard
apps.short_description: Defend Earth against waves of deadly cosmic threats determined to destroy your civilization! In this Rogue-Lite Auto Shooter, you’ll place Celestial bodies and upgrade them to unleash chaos on your enemies. How long will you survive?

apps.name: Orbifold
apps.short_description: Fight through mind-bending spherical arenas on your own or with friends. Scavenge for weapons, loot and creative upgrades in the twisted remnants of a broken planet. A warped world of inverted mayhem awaits.

apps.name: OREBELT
apps.short_description:
Rocks roll in, you crack them open, coins pile up!
OREBELT is a cozy idle miner where your little mine slowly grows into a mega factory, from coal and iron to blood diamonds, jade and more.

apps.name: Oreloop
apps.short_description: Break blocks in a first-person mine for 15 seconds. When the time runs out, spend your ore on a huge skill tree and new pickaxes. Wake up to a fresh, bigger mine. Grow from one slow block at a time to lightning, black holes and drills that break hundreds of blocks.

apps.name: Oremus
apps.short_description: This text adventure, beautifully illustrated in pixel art, invites you to explore a medieval abbey filled with secrets. You take full control by entering commands directly on your keyboard through a flexible command parser, allowing for free and immersive interaction.

apps.name: Orestruck: Space Miner
apps.short_description: A fast-paced sci-fi First Person Shooter inspired by the classics of the genre. Shoot and kick your way out of the war-torn planet to survive the attack of the space undead. Zombie blood has never splashed so good!

apps.name: Organized Chaos
apps.short_description: Sort, order, and enjoy a cozy experience as you solve a variety of puzzles. Can you organize this chaos?

apps.name: Ormagi Press
apps.short_description: Ormagi Press is an unconventional horror adventure game that will have you adjust to ever so switching gameplay styles. After losing everything to a calamity that occurred ten years ago, Nathan seeks guidance from a voice beckoning from within the temple on the mountain summit...

apps.name: orrb
apps.short_description:
orrb is a tile based puzzle exploration game.
where you explore levels, discover rules, place tiles, and when ready, send the orrb on its way.

apps.name: OSAD
apps.short_description: Experience the end of the world in an alternate-history Poland. As a lone garbage collector, witness the final hours of reality as you know it. This is a short, dark science fiction thriller that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

apps.name: OTAKUS VS NINJAS CD 1
apps.short_description: Otakus to Japan! The Work Ninja Clan has seized power and banned leisure. Get ready to save Manga, Anime and Videogames! This game is a narrative, rock-driven beat-'em-up. Follow the story of Alex(Mexico), Michael (USA) and Cristina (Argentina), put your heardphones on and enjoy the travel :)

apps.name: Ourself
apps.short_description: Two players. One body. In this online co-op for 2, you steer one half of a ragdoll and your friend steers the other: one arm, one leg and one camera each. Walk in step, jump on the same beat, carry a box together and climb 400 m into the sky. One slips, you both fall. Voice chat built in.

apps.name: Outbreak Checkpoint
apps.short_description: Outbreak Checkpoint is a survival defense game where your inventory shapes your firepower. Arrange weapons, merge upgrades, and fit attachments into a limited grid. Combine four elements to unleash powerful reactions and hold the line against growing enemy hordes.

apps.name: Outer Flame
apps.short_description: Outer Flame is a JRPG featuring a rich storyline, extensive exploration, and strategic turn‑based battles. The game presents an authentic, classic role‑playing experience.

apps.name: Outergod Abduction
apps.short_description: You have been kidnapped by Chtuli, a cute alien yandere who loves you. Hug her, play with her pet Mimi, and find a way out before her love turns into something much worse in this horror survival game!

apps.name: Outliers: Incrementum
apps.short_description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

apps.name: OUTPERFORM
apps.short_description: Wall Street satire meets bullet heaven. Play as The Degen, Bagholder, MLM Hun and nine more meme traders, mow down swarms of red candles, and draft carefully: the upgrades you pass arm the Whale, Pump and Dump and the other bosses waiting for you.

apps.name: Outsail The Sun
apps.short_description: Conquer dark oceans as the captain of a vampirate crew. Feast on sailor blood for roguelite-style upgrades, fend off mighty sea creatures with your overpowered builds, go treasure hunting, and outsail the sun to achieve bullet-heaven under the night sky!

apps.name: OverDoze
apps.short_description: All Dasha wants is to get some sleep and finish watching her favorite dream. But in a crime‑ridden metropolis ruled by organized crime groups and corporations, that turns into an unattainable dream.

apps.name: Overinflated
apps.short_description: Run a restaurant as inflatable cooks! Chop, stir and serve before your balloon guests swell with rage and pop. Don't overinflate, dodge the knives, patch holes with tape, and build new rooms and machines. Co-op chaos for 1–4 players, online or on one screen.

apps.name: OVERPAINT
apps.short_description: Five minutes. Friendship over. Two to four players stand back to back and paint the same masterpiece. In Sabotage Time, walk over and throw paint at a friend's canvas. In the final Repair Time nobody can sabotage any more — just paint. When the sun goes down, it's over. Real masterpieces.

apps.name: Ovis Mollis
apps.short_description: A cozy pixel farm on your desktop — a whole village with fishing, a casino, and a stock exchange. Grass grows, sheep accumulate wool even while AFK. Shear, sell, pay your mortgage, collect skins from Mystery Box on Steam — and one day robots will do everything themselves.

apps.name: Owl Skips
apps.short_description: Jokes end when the owl with a skipping rope appears. A cozy one-button roguelite with ridiculous builds and rope-fueled chaos. Charge jumps, stack wild upgrades, chase high scores, and try again. Just one more run. Probably.

apps.name: PAC-SIDE
apps.short_description: PAC-SIDE is a fast-paced pacman-based horror game, where you can meet your old yellow friend! Wait.. It looks like something bad happened with him..

apps.name: Pachinko Realms: Tiki-Taka
apps.short_description: Master the pitch in this physics-based soccer pachinko game ! Launch your ball through traditional 3D Pachinko boards, chaining "Tiki-Taka" passes to reach the next stage ! Explore diverse stadium realms, collect tactical power-ups, and face goalkeepers in epic boss fights.

apps.name: PACKING SHIFT
apps.short_description: Packing Shift is a cozy warehouse online co-op for 1-4 players. Sort the day's deliveries, fill the orders, box them up, and ship them out. Everything is physics-driven, so mind the shelves, mind the rockets, and try not to bury your coworkers under either.

apps.name: Pact Warden
apps.short_description: As a Marchwarden, you travel the southern roads to protect pilgrims and travelers. You will fight multi-phased bosses, shape the storylines of characters, and explore an interconnected world.

apps.name: PactSworn
apps.short_description: Fight through hordes of eldritch monsters to purge the source of the corruption! Earn gold, buy weapons, and level up to create unique and powerful builds to cut through the chaos. Unlock different warlocks and weapon sets to explore all the different ways to play!

apps.name: Pale Static
apps.short_description: A cinematic first-person survival horror about a squad sent into a town on what looked like a routine rescue operation. By the time they arrive, the town is already in chaos.

apps.name: Pandemonium Line: Flipping on Borrowed Dime
apps.short_description: Your own paradise lost. You are now this trains conductor. Venture through a hellish train inspired by organic metal and fight your way to the front driver’s cabin in this Roguelike coin-flip Deckbuilder focusing on rhythmic evasion and precise positioning.

apps.name: PAPER STRIKE
apps.short_description: Draw runes with your mouse in a 3v3 online party arena. Mix spells with instant physical abilities and fight short objective rounds. But drawing means standing still. Finish that rune or move? Choose your moment and push Armageddon toward the enemy camp.

apps.name: Paradoxical
apps.short_description: Portals are physical objects. In this mind-bending puzzle game, portals can be carried, repositioned, and used to create impossible connections through space. Uncover the fate of a desert world that sought salvation through portal technology.

apps.name: Party Link
apps.short_description: Party Link is a collection of Russian party games for groups. Launch on a big screen, connect friends from their phones via QR, and pick a show — memes, drawing, bluffing, and guessing games. Original modes with Russian voice-over — ready in a minute, no installs on phones.

apps.name: Party Time Bowling
apps.short_description: Strike up the neon-soaked fun in this competitive party sports game for up to 8 players. Bowl, roll, and battle it out in Air Hockey, unlock 100+  ball skins and custom pins with Alley Bucks, and keep the good times rolling.

apps.name: PATIENCE IS A VIRTUE
apps.short_description: Something's hiding in the cassette. Rearrange the words of your enemies to investigate a small-town conspiracy in this mystery puzzle game.

apps.name: Pax Germanica
apps.short_description: inspired by the 1980s monster games, this strategic turn-based wargame will put you at the  head of a great power during the imperialism era. you will chase victory by colonising unclaimed territories trying to maximize profit while using diplomacy to avoid an all-out escalation to the great war.

apps.name: Pegs of Hell
apps.short_description: A physics roguelike where you build the pachinko board yourself. Place and upgrade pegs, arrange powerful Arcana, split balls, trigger elemental chains and create absurd scoring machines before Hell's rent catches up with you.

apps.name: Perfect Steel
apps.short_description: Perfect Steel is a turn based strategy RPG inspired by SNES and PSX era classics. It features grid based combat, class system, world map and a story to explore.

apps.name: PERI.CO
apps.short_description: 4-player co-op first-person action. Deploy to an ever-changing site, complete missions, take down giant bosses, and get back before time runs out. Spend your pay on gear for the next shift. Dual-arm weapon combos, Q-key skills, debuff contracts, SSD revive system, 9 languages.

apps.name: Pest Termina ~ Swarm Defense
apps.short_description: Build your base turn by turn on a hex world map, then drop into real-time battles against thousands of alien creatures. Command marines, robots and tanks, fortify the gates with turrets, and survive 50 days of an evolving swarm in this low-poly defense roguelike.

apps.name: Phoning It In
apps.short_description: Make good use of words and personas to conceal yourself amid the chaotic workplace, gain your leaders’ trust, steer clear of blame-shifting colleagues, keep learning and mastering skills, and ultimately create your own.

apps.name: Pickup Point Chaos
apps.short_description: Run your own pickup point! Receive, scan, sort, and shelve packages. Find customer pickups, then weigh and label outgoing shipments. Carry several boxes to save time, but customers may knock them down. Handle package rain, fragile items, and explosives—and don’t blow up the place!

apps.name: Pico Drift
apps.short_description: Explore the city as your ultimate racing arena. Dodge traffic, outsmart the cops, and challenge your friends. Experience official campaign tracks and game modes, or create your own playgrounds. This is your world - drive it your way

apps.name: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person game about restoring stained glass. Brush dusty shards, match their shapes and colours, and bring light back to a mountain chapel. Unlock magical upgrades and rebuild six windows at your own pace, with no deadlines or penalties.

apps.name: PIG IRON
apps.short_description:
PIGIRON is a fast-paced horde shooter with light mech-sim elements. 


Grind your way through hundreds of escaped Bio-engineered Meat Organisms with an arsenal of horrifying flesh-metal contraptions.

apps.name: Pigeonhole Principle
apps.short_description: Meet a pigeon who dreams of flying to the Galápagos. That flight needs one thing — the legendary golden sunflower seed. But right now that pigeon has fallen into a stranger's storage room, and is in real trouble. Cook the things around you, wear them, and climb a little higher.

apps.name: PIGFACE MASSACRE
apps.short_description: PIGFACE MASSACRE is a survival horror game can be played up-to 4 players. While trying to stay alive, uncover the serial killer PIGFACE's bloodcurdling mystery and find out the truth behind events.

apps.name: Pilgrimage of the Fallen
apps.short_description: Pilgrimage of the Fallen is an isometric 3D Zelda-like ARPG focused on dungeon exploration. Enter the shattered abyss: navigate multi-layered labyrinths, gather hidden relics to craft alchemical creations, and slay ancient tyrants in methodical, hard-hitting combat.

apps.name: Pillow Punk
apps.short_description: Pillow Punk is a fast-paced third-person action roguelite built around outrageous pillow combat. Fight escalating enemy waves with melee and ranged attacks, combine abilities with randomized upgrades, and challenge powerful bosses in a chaotic single-player adventure.

apps.name: Pimpin' Around
apps.short_description: Play as a pimp in the funky 1970s. Run the joint, slap the troublemakers and buy the place before the Pimp Boss buys you.

apps.name: PinUp Archery
apps.short_description: Stick rubber suction-cup arrows on pinup posters in this simple relaxing comedy archery game. Earn your cupid wings! Read the wind, land the hot spots, chain combos and unlock every Girl of the Month. Made with love by a solo developer.

apps.name: Pipfiend: The Demonic Domino Deckbuilder
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about battling demons with a specialized deck of dominoes! Build your deck from nearly 75,000 possible unique configurations of dominoes, and augment your run with powerful charms and discover diabolical synergies.

apps.name: Pizzarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Shop
apps.short_description: Pizzarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Shop is a relaxing single-player simulation where your task is to organize 4,000 scattered pizzas and place them neatly on the shelves. Sort, tidy up, and bring order to the arcane shop to achieve perfect organization.

apps.name: Please Handle Gently
apps.short_description: Please Handle Gently is a pixel-art autobattler card game. Late at night, sit down at the counter for a while — pick out a few figurines, give them a little magic back. A whole cabinet of jingling little things. They're old. Please handle gently.

apps.name: Pluck Em!
apps.short_description: Fight off annoying feathered pests in this addictive arcade shooter inspired by the classics of the 8- and 16-bit era. Explore strange biomes, discover bizarre bird species, earn medals, upgrade your gear and uncover secrets that are probably better left undiscovered.

apps.name: Pointless Climb
apps.short_description: Escape an impossible abyss as Ilia Movahed in a brutal, parkour climber. Execute precision vaults, wall climbs, and high stakes jumps to reach the summit. There are no checkpoints. one simple mistake will send you tumbling back to the start.

apps.name: Pokremental
apps.short_description: Pokremental is an incremental game where you flip poker cards to earn money. Buy cards and upgrades to earn more money, or hire helpers to automate the process. Gamble at the casino or on the skill tree to progress faster.

apps.name: POLIS
apps.short_description: Become mayor of a small Greek town and govern for 17 years. Citizens write you letters for years, the opposition never sleeps, and every promise is remembered. A satirical political city sim where the town never forgets.

apps.name: Poolrooms Museum
apps.short_description: Explore surreal poolrooms, museums, and endless liminal spaces.

apps.name: POOLİMİNAL
apps.short_description: POOLIMINAL is an atmospheric liminal space horror game set in endless, procedurally generated poolrooms. A Backrooms-inspired descent into thalassophobia, where the real terror lies in the dark water below.

apps.name: Portal: Lost in Aperture
apps.short_description: This is a mod for Portal 1. Includes new maps, storyline, a whole new Portal experience. After you play the game, every other mod will look simple, balanced and average. Lost in Aperture try to show, that the portal universe can be way bigger, and a lot more, then just solving puzzles.

apps.name: Postpartum | 산후조리원
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set over five days in a Korean postpartum care center. The nurse was replaced overnight, and the new one always seems to be holding your baby.

apps.name: Potions Galore
apps.short_description: A slow-paced, cozy sorting game, where you organize 2900+ potions in a fantasy alchemy shop. Read the book to learn about each new potion. Use narrative deduction to find the correct placement and tidy up the mess with no power-ups!

apps.name: POUND SAND
apps.short_description: Every pixel simulated, including the machines. Dig into alien planets, build a factory from real blocks, and carve it into any shape you want. Ore sinks and sand rises in the greatest competition in the galaxy. Move it, grind it, melt it, freeze it, sell it, and strip the planet to bedrock.

apps.name: PrankzPlz!
apps.short_description: Every great prank starts with a simple idea. Matt’s usually ends in complete chaos.

apps.name: Princess 8/10
apps.short_description: Once upon a time, there was a perfectly average princess — 8/10 at best. No singing animals, no magical destiny. Just an annoying father-king and a whole bunch of creepy barons trying to marry her off.

apps.name: Princess and Conquest - Queen Of Clubs
apps.short_description: Princess & Conquest: Queen of Clubs is a tavern manager/simulator, with multiple minigames, and many narrative elements! Animated 2D portraits and illustrated backgrounds, mixed to create a colorful world filled with cute and sexy characters, as always in the Princess & Conquest's Kingdom!

apps.name: Pro Endurance Series: Running Manager
apps.short_description: Pro Endurance Series Running manager: take your athlete from prospect to legend. Plan training, nutrition, gear and staff, pick your 5K, 10K, half-marathon and marathon races, and live every event in a real-time simulator where you set the pace and tactics.

apps.name: Pro Soccer Management 27
apps.short_description: Take full control of a football club. Shape tactics, transfers, youth development, staff, finances, facilities, and stadium growth—or risk everything in the underground. Create your own football universe with datapacks, mods, and Steam Workshop.

apps.name: PROCEDURE ZERO
apps.short_description: You uncovered a fraud, so they locked you up. Prisoners are quietly disappearing, and you're next. Sneak past the guards, trade cigarettes for information, fight when you have to, and take over the prison before they come for you.

apps.name: Project 14
apps.short_description: Project 14 is a short psychological puzzle game filled with bizarre tests, dark humour and unexpected twists. Explore strange environments, uncover hidden paths and decide whether to obey or defy a disturbingly polite system. Your actions shape the experience – and may lead to different outcomes.

apps.name: Project Athanor
apps.short_description: Build automated factories to produce and upgrade elemental cards, assemble a six-card deck, then enter survivor-style arenas, collect temporary power-ups, and push through escalating waves for as long as you can survive.

apps.name: Project Neko
apps.short_description: Pilot a cat-shaped ship through a neon rhythm tunnel. Hit, hold and trace notes to the beat, chase high scores, and take a loud, unruly cat band from rehearsal room to stage. Unlock partners and songs across four difficulties in this music-driven arcade adventure.

apps.name: Project NEUNLEBEN Alpha Defence Force
apps.short_description: An attack by an alien species, emerging from a dimensional rift, has begun! Shoot 'em up your way through 11 levels with the help of the "Alpha Defence Force", consisting of three cybernetically enhanced cats, and defeat screen-sized bosses in this retro 16-bit-inspired Shmup.

apps.name: Project Prison
apps.short_description:
Have you ever thought about the best place to start your criminal empire without any legal consequences?

Now you will finally be able to experience prison life in Project Prison. try to stay alive in a prison which contains’ s the world’s most ruthless inmates.

apps.name: Project Shadowglass
apps.short_description: A stealth-focused immersive sim set within a dark fantasy kingdom. Plan daring heists, infiltrate forbidden locales, and escape with priceless artifacts. Features revolutionary 3D pixel art graphics and lasting consequences where every action could leave a trail back to you.

apps.name: Project Slimechan
apps.short_description: Experience tentacle scenes directly in 3D on PC or in 6DOF VR.

apps.name: Project TITAN
apps.short_description: You start with a tiny mech factory, a pile of scrap, and one goal: make money. Manufacture parts, assemble mechs, and take on questionable contracts for clients who don't ask about ethics, just excellent margins. Grow your factory, upgrade your tech tree, and build the ultimate mech: TITAN.

apps.name: PROJECT_JUMP
apps.short_description: A precision first-person movement game. Air-strafe, bounce, and rocket-jump through hand-crafted jump maps with faithfully recreated 2000s-era physics, and chase records on leaderboards that track every route, category, and discipline.

apps.name: Prop Hazard
apps.short_description: In worlds where chairs, rocks, and trees hide lethal traps, master agile parkour—jumping and dashing through shifting death-mazes. Use pebbles to find hidden paths, glowsticks to see in the dark, and light to expose lies. The exit waits, but surviving to reach it won't be easy.

apps.name: Proppy
apps.short_description: Sent into the past to preserve video game history, an alien must hide beneath the appearance of a Proppy, survive among the Proppys, and recover consoles and games scattered across a world fractured by time and dimensions.

apps.name: Protocol Z
apps.short_description: A living zombie sandbox. Watch a whole town go about its day then unleash the outbreak. Play as anyone in first person, swim, fight and drive, spawn zombies, vehicles and buildings anywhere, and call down tsunamis and tornadoes while police and soldiers fight to hold the line in a city that can fall

apps.name: Proud Boss Turns Into Obedient Loyal Maid
apps.short_description: Ilya, a worker in New York, merged his consciousness with Liu Zihua due to an explosion and gained superpowers. He disguises himself as a low - level employee during the day and investigates the FX Group at night. He also has a complex entanglement with his proud boss, Natalie.

apps.name: Punch Rock
apps.short_description: A casual idle survival game in a small window beside your work. A lone climber wanders a mountain in real time. Give her the day: forage, chop, mine, climb, or camp. Then get back to whatever you were doing. You cannot lose, and the mountain keeps its own time while you're away.

apps.name: Puppet Mall: Chapter 1
apps.short_description: Explore the abandoned Puppet Mall, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of its dark past. As John, confront the mall's mysteries and discover what really happened there while investigating the story of Mike and Chris. But be careful... You are not alone.

apps.name: PUZFLO: Run the Line
apps.short_description: Build it. Run it. Fix it. PUZFLO: Run the Line is a 2D factory puzzle game where you design production lines, uncover bottlenecks, and optimize every detail. Combine conveyors, machines, and stoppers to hit your production target with limited space and cost—and keep the whole line running smoothly.

apps.name: Puzzle Scorpions
apps.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Puzzle Simulator
apps.short_description: The one-more-piece jigsaw game. Puzzle Simulator is a dangerously cozy puzzle adventure where you unlock shelf after shelf of boxes, satisfyingly sweep and sort pieces, collect rare charms, and puzzle your own photos.

apps.name: Quarantine Lab Sort
apps.short_description: Restore order to a lab left in complete chaos! Sort over 7,000 items, examine unknown samples in a centrifuge, catch escaped animals, and handle radioactive waste with care. Unlock skills and turn piles of clutter into neatly organized shelves.

apps.name: Quarterheart
apps.short_description: A cozy arcade roguelite. An old coin-op machine you find in the attic, and it still works. Aim true and time your hits in 2–4 minute runs. Every new monster you beat prints a sticker — where you stick it on the cabinet decides what it upgrades or unlocks. Insert coin to play?

apps.name: Queen's Pact
apps.short_description: Queen’s Pact is a dark roguelite deckbuilder with auto-battler combat: sacrifice, chain and scale your cards into loops that should not be allowed. Break the game until the Queen is impressed.

apps.name: Quest Dice
apps.short_description: A book, a d20, a candle. Quest Dice is a solo pen-and-paper in three stories — write your own books and share them on the Workshop.

apps.name: Quiz Bang!
apps.short_description: 《Quiz Bang! 》is a first-person party shooter for 2–6 players. On this not-so-safe TV show, answer questions or beat minigames to earn ammo. Take on another challenge, or turn around and shoot your friends? A friendly reminder: watch your back while answering.

apps.name: QUIZ BREAKER
apps.short_description: Five contestants, one hidden Breaker who knows the answers. Race through four-choice buzzer quizzes, discuss suspicious answers, and use your Trigger to expose a suspect. Play with friends or join online alone with bot fill. Japanese-language gameplay.

apps.name: Quota: Hit Your Number
apps.short_description: Climb the sales ladder from the basement to the corner office. Cold-call, close deals, build a team, run a region — and hit your number every single month. A pixel-art idle career sim about the one figure that decides everything.

apps.name: RABIDZ
apps.short_description: An open-world co-op zombie survival game where the infected mutate every night you survive. Gather, craft, build and fight to see another sunrise.

apps.name: RAEV
apps.short_description: From a humble campfire to a multi-city kingdom, lead with grace in RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores: a unique kingdom builder where every decision shapes the fate of your fox citizens and the legacy of your continent-spanning kingdom. With a freeform building system, no grids, no limits.

apps.name: Ragdoll Robotics
apps.short_description: Build ridiculous trap combinations, launch a helpless robot across the laboratory, and watch spectacular chain reactions unfold! Experiment with mines, spikes, turrets, and catapults to solve physics-based challenges and cause maximum chaos.

apps.name: Raining Lead
apps.short_description: Twin-stick shooter meets action roguelike in a quest to burn corporate stocks. Mega Giga Corp takes your city. Their stock keeps climbing but you're the correction they didn't hedge against - A constructor of machines ready to burst their bubble. Destroy, loot, upgrade, repeat and lead the revolt.

apps.name: Raise
apps.short_description: Rise from the grave in a compact third-person soulslike. Battle undead and bosses, level up your character and master timed arena challenges. Every hit taken costs time; every parry improves your score. Refine your runs and compete on Steam leaderboards.

apps.name: Raise a Graz
apps.short_description: Raise and grow your very own Graz! Make him burp, spend your Burpo on increasingly peculiarly snacks, and feed him until he's ready to Asscend. A crude, colorful clicker with goblins, Burpo Frenzies, leeching Giovannis and 2-player online or LAN co-op.

apps.name: Rakuworld
apps.short_description: Draw your own hero and play as it. Your drawings come alive to face hordes of enemies across 11 worlds made of paper and crayon. 36 heroes, 22 bosses, evolving weapons and 1-4 player co-op.

apps.name: Ramen Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Take control of your very own Ramen Shop! Transform a cozy, worn-out Japanese alley back into a vibrant hotspot. From scrubbing floors to cooking the perfect bowl of ramen. Decorate every corner, upgrade everything, and create your unique shop.

apps.name: Ranch Attack: Farmer on the Run
apps.short_description: The goats are back and they have hired a bull. Grab, hurl, and outrun the herd in this updated version of Ranch Attack Classic: a fast, funny  arcade runner with two farmers, a barn full of unlockables, and the original prototype as a bonus.

apps.name: Random Slot Adventurers : Matched Words... Now I'm the Strongest
apps.short_description: Build a 3x3 slot board in this word-combination strategy roguelike. Combine Subjects, Adverbs, and Verbs to attack, defend, and heal. Explore changing islands, collect words and relics, and shape a build around class traits and synergies.

apps.name: Randomly Jerk Simulator
apps.short_description: "Randomly Jerk Simulator" is a roguelite simulation game that uses a slot machine to simulate the parasitic behavior of a jerk who relies on his parents. This game does not contain any gambling behavior or cash transactions.

apps.name: Rasterfall
apps.short_description: An open-world survival crafting game where every pixel is physically simulated and chemically reactive. Explore the world using a wide variety of materials, synthesize new substances, and build automated production lines. Multiplayer supported.

apps.name: Ratiator
apps.short_description: Your master vanished the night the lamps went out. Now his gladiator dojo is yours. Raise rat fighters and write their tactics command by command. Arm them with spoons and bottle caps. Climb a ladder of over 2000 living fighters.

apps.name: Ration Me Tender
apps.short_description: An adult romance visual novel set at a coastal desalination plant during a supply crisis. Follow production director Nizar Sabhan through three distinct romance routes as work, marriage, and responsibility collide behind the fence at Ras Mishaal.

apps.name: Rayborne
apps.short_description: Rayborne is a puzzle game built around lasers, physics, and real-time light simulation. Solve handcrafted challenges by shaping light itself while uncovering the mystery behind a questionable AI research facility.

apps.name: Raze the Zombie Horde
apps.short_description: A single-player top-down zombie shooter across streets, fortresses, beaches and infected facilities. Adapt to two-sided run cards or build up to eight guns firing at once in Loot Arsenal. Develop four heroes and bring a tank, collie or robot dog on standard operations.

apps.name: Re:collect
apps.short_description: In a postwar world where even memories can be used as collateral, you become the owner of a small pawnshop. Speak with customers, judge the value of their memories and belongings, and over 30 days of running the shop, uncover forgotten truths and the story of the protagonist.

apps.name: Reapercussions
apps.short_description: Death is now your day job. Roll your bones, build poker hand variants and reap each Soul before your rolls run out. Stack cursed Relics and Hex Potions into absurd combos as you try and impress in your new role as a Reaper. It looks easy but looks are very deceiving.

apps.name: ReBlade: The Death Spiral
apps.short_description: You are a condemned Synthetic, marked for destruction and trapped in endless resets. In a cyberpunk world inspired by Chinese mythology, harness weapons, chips, and augments to cut through mechanical creatures. Each run brings you closer to breaking the cycle and unravelling the truth.

apps.name: Rebringer
apps.short_description: A multiplayer survival game set in a recovering post-apocalyptic world. Scavenge, craft gear, drive vehicles, and build your base between safe settlements and hostile bandits. Play online or host your own server with custom rules.

apps.name: REC:REWIND
apps.short_description:
Set in an American home, REC:REWIND follows a missing husband and the wife who refuses to stop searching for him.
Experience a “reverse loop” horror story, unraveling the truth through the eyes of both of them as you travel deeper and deeper into the past.

apps.name: Red Father
apps.short_description: RED FATHER is a PSX-style horror game set in Graham Labs, a mysterious computer research facility. The company's prized supercomputer has gone rogue, killing anyone who might shut it down. Uncover the mysteries Graham Labs tried to hide, and try to make it out alive.

apps.name: Red Moon Cafe
apps.short_description: Red Moon Cafe is a story-driven barista sim set in a rough Russian neighborhood. Survive on your paycheck, manage the protagonist's well-being, and save for the essentials. The authentic city and lifelike NPCs are so detailed that the atmosphere and daily grind feel almost like real life.

apps.name: Red Rain
apps.short_description: Survive a decimated yet beautiful post-apocalyptic landscape as Allie, a competent survivalist and mother raising her daughter against the backdrop of a broken world.

apps.name: Reef Break
apps.short_description: Reef Break is a realistic surfing simulation set in an untouched tropical paradise. Read the swell, paddle out through crystal water, and ride real-feeling waves across reef breaks teeming with life. No crowds, no scores, just you and the ocean.

apps.name: REELS of the DAMNED
apps.short_description: A slot machine deckbuilding roguelike dungeon crawl. Choose a class, grow your symbol deck, unlock spells and relics, and fight your way to the bottom of the Dungeon!

apps.name: Refluff: Carpet Cleaning ASMR
apps.short_description: Refluff is a carpet cleaning ASMR sim built on a real fluid simulation. Scrape off dried crust, soak the pile, foam it, brush it, squeegee the slurry out and dry the fibers until the rug is spotless. Hand it over, get paid, upgrade your kit, take the next one.

apps.name: Rehab Roulette
apps.short_description: You are Patient №10375. In this hospital, gambling addiction is treated with a slot machine. Spin the reels, choose upgrades, boost your multipliers, and watch your dopamine levels. Try to escape this strange place.

apps.name: Reino Visigodo: Conquista de Hispania
apps.short_description: Forge your kingdom in Visigothic Hispania. Build cities, raise armies, and conquer territories in a real-time strategy game featuring 3D battles, sieges, and decisions that shape your destiny. Three game modes where ambition meets history.

apps.name: Rejected Draft
apps.short_description: Climb out of the trash and fight your way back to the artist who rejected you. Defeat sketches, steal their strengths, and begin a months-long incremental journey through an ever-growing web of stats, upgrades, prestige layers, automation, and absurd numbers. Easy to start, hard to master.

apps.name: Relic Looter
apps.short_description:
Explore Ancient Ruins and Mysterious Temples!
Dodge Deadly Traps and Discover Legendary Treasures!
Grab the Loot. Escape Alive!

apps.name: Relocate Motorhome Simulator
apps.short_description: Drive 60 motorhomes across 12 handcrafted worlds and more than 300 km of road. Deliver RVs, start your own rental company, furnish your home on wheels, cook, adopt a pet and road-trip in cross-platform convoy with voice chat.

apps.name: Remain Seated
apps.short_description: you've fallen into an abandoned hospital and have become wheelchair-bound. With limited mobility You must use your resources to find yourself a way out while avoiding any dangers that may lurk within.

apps.name: RemparZ
apps.short_description: Medieval-fantasy tower defense: raise towers along the roads, upgrade them and hold through five Ages up to the dragons. Then send your army to storm forts held by the computer in the Conquest, defend a shared castle with a friend in Duo and grow your Bastion.

apps.name: Renegades
apps.short_description: Renegades is a party RPG with deckbuilding combat: lead five heroes, each with unique mechanics and their own deck, choose three for each fight, and survive a kingdom coming apart through tactical, story-driven battles. Deep character development in multiple tracks leads to high customization.

apps.name: REQUIRED SYNERGY WORKSHOP: Deja Damnation
apps.short_description: A participant disappears during a mandatory corporate workshop. The System restarts the session but keeps your answers, and the people around you remember how you treated them. A choice-driven psychological horror story about workplace rituals, surveillance, and a reality coming apart.

apps.name: Rerack
apps.short_description: Rerack is a pinball roguelike on planetary surfaces of rock and neon. Build your own table from bumpers, magnets and sensors, place them on the playfield and rotate them. Beat bosses, collect bonuses and go head to head with your friends.

apps.name: Resident Evil 2 "R.P.D. Demo"
apps.short_description:
A deadly virus engulfs the residents of Raccoon City in September of 1998, plunging the city into chaos as flesh eating zombies roam the streets for survivors.

An unparalleled adrenaline rush, gripping storyline, and unimaginable horrors await you.

Witness the return of Resident Evil 2.

apps.name: Resident Evil Veronica
apps.short_description:
Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica.

In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.

apps.name: Respublica
apps.short_description: Create a politician and start your legacy. Run in national and local elections. Create and vote on legislation. Respublica is an online roleplay game, where users can run for office and control the outcome of the world within the game.

apps.name: Retroneer
apps.short_description: You are the Retroneer. Craft circuits, optimise your designs and uncover the secrets at the heart of Amplitude. Combine game-changing Trinkets, powerful Modules, and your own problem-solving skills to generate explosive results in this approachable and deep roguelike resource management game.

apps.name: RETURN POLICY
apps.short_description: You work nights at a returns desk. Customers lie, haggle, guilt-trip you and throw punches, and you decide what gets accepted. Save up for a flat, feed the cat, don't go into the warehouse after three. The last guy on this shift went missing. Everyone in town tells it differently

apps.name: Reveria: Act 1
apps.short_description: Welcome, adventurer! Reveria is a turn-based old school fantasy RPG. Lead a party of up to four aspiring adventurers into the Reverian wilderness. Explore dark dungeons and defeat dangerous foes to complete quests and find treasure. Level up your characters to unlock new abilities. Grow your legend.

apps.name: Revery Effect
apps.short_description: Revery Effect is a 2D sandbox adventure! Explore an endlessly generated world, uncover ruins and histories, dig, build, fight, automate, and journey alone or with friends.

apps.name: Rex Summons a Meteor
apps.short_description: A short game about a large rock. You accidentally summoned a meteor. Oops. Now you have to save the island! Barter with stubborn dinosaurs who only talk in emoji, play absurd mini-games, and solve puzzles in this silly first-person puzzle adventure.

apps.name: Riddled Together
apps.short_description: A first-person online co-op puzzle game where communication is the only way to solve puzzles and escape.

apps.name: Rideshare "Stimulator"
apps.short_description: Build your rideshare business while navigating real-world traffic, managing your vehicle, and transporting a wide range of unique passengers. Master the streets, keep your car in shape, and deliver every ride, no matter how strange it gets.

apps.name: Rifted Worlds
apps.short_description: A fast-paced Action-RPG that takes place on the floating remnants of destroyed worlds. Discover fragments of your lost world, place them onto the map, and explore! It's time to uncover the truth behind your world's destruction...

apps.name: Rimfarers
apps.short_description: A classic turn-based space RPG. Trade between the worlds of five races, take on jobs, hunt pirates, rise in the fleet reserves and play dozens of text quests — while the Silence creeps in from the edge of the galaxy.

apps.name: Rin: Always By Your Side
apps.short_description: Rin lives on your desktop, right over your wallpaper. Talk to her by text or voice and she answers with her own voice and expressions. A local AI model is bundled, so you can chat for free and offline. On tiring days or for idle small talk, she's always by your side.

apps.name: RINGFALL
apps.short_description: The nations are cut into pieces by the meddling of the all-powerful tech syndicate known as The Ring. To survive in a world plagued by proxy wars and corporate espionage is to play along, and PLAY you will! RINGFALL is an upcoming PVP FPS focused on accessibility, fun, and classic FPS fundamentals.

apps.name: RippleLoop
apps.short_description: Skip stones as far as you can in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the ultimate stone skipper.

apps.name: Risk Trader
apps.short_description: Survive first. Compound second. Trade simulated markets, manage risk and grow a virtual account across five modes. Explore interactive lessons on risk and position sizing, review your trades, and practice with a local rules-based coach. Play entirely offline.

apps.name: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart
apps.short_description: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?

apps.name: RoboSquare: Recharged
apps.short_description: A 16-player online party game where hovering robots dash, jump and slam each other off the map across five chaotic minigames. Your friends are worse than you remember, and the platform is smaller than you think.

apps.name: Rocket Punt
apps.short_description: Blast your friends off floating arenas in Rocket Punt, a chaotic rocket party brawler for up to 10 players. Grab wild weapons, dodge incoming rockets, and fight solo or in teams across seven modes. Play online with friends or practise against bots.

apps.name: Rogue Femme
apps.short_description: Rogue Femme is an adult roguelike deckbuilder set in a corrupt land. Craft a unique deck, discover powerful relics, fight dozens of monstergirls, and hold back the corruption as you try not to be transformed into one of them.

apps.name: Roguebound Pirates
apps.short_description: Loot, upgrade & dominate! Your inventory IS your ship in this action roguelike. Customize weapons, create game-breaking synergies, and claim your place as the most overpowered pirate across the seas!

apps.name: Roof UP!
apps.short_description: Build a cozy floating hex island where every building grows as tall as it is happy. Cottages love trees, windmills love fields, lighthouses love the sea. Place each piece where its neighbors lift it up, and watch your skyline climb through the seasons.

apps.name: Rooklite
apps.short_description: A minimalist game about building your board and fighting for checkmate.

apps.name: Rotaliate
apps.short_description: A very simplistic fast paced puzzle game. Single player modes compete for most efficient or fastest time where multiplayer modes fight to be the first to clear their color from the board. Elo style ranking and more play modes coming eventually!

apps.name: Rubber Stamp Legend
apps.short_description:
An endless pile of paperwork is waiting for your approval stamp.
Reject shameless "business expenses," outwork your rivals, and from New Hire to Chairman, work until the day you die!

apps.name: Ruler of Empires
apps.short_description: Command a nation through the age of steel and empire. Ruler of Empires is a turn-based grand strategy game. Seize a nation, rewrite the century, and conquer province by province across lands. Save an empire doomed to fall, or bring the whole world under a single flag.

apps.name: RuneEra
apps.short_description: RuneEra is a fantasy colony-management RPG where you build a guild settlement, automate work and production, equip powerful runes and lead parties through a procedurally generated world of quests, factions, dangerous biomes and dungeons.

apps.name: Runehold
apps.short_description: Build up defenses, recruit helpers, gather items and defend the stronghold against an ever increasing number and difficulty of enemies who come at night.

apps.name: Rush Math
apps.short_description: RushMath is a single-player arithmetic arcade game against the clock. Solve random problems, build combos and beat your personal best. Correct answers restore time; mistakes take it away. Earn credits and purchase permanent upgrades.

apps.name: Russpuppy Play & Learn
apps.short_description: A fun collection of learning games for young children. Practice letters, phonics, counting, shapes, and colors with cheerful music, sound effects, and no game-over screens.

apps.name: Rustown
apps.short_description: Five years after the “idiot virus” pandemic, a letter arrives from the father you thought was dead. Rustown is a story-driven stealth adventure about finding him in a slum where the infected live. Evade watchful eyes, follow clues, and discover the stories of those caught up in the city's troubles.

apps.name: Rygrad
apps.short_description: Be Alive, Get Stronger, Dominate!

apps.name: Ryze
apps.short_description: Ryze is an unforgiving, quirky, 2D platformer. Throw yourself to the top, past challenging and diverse biomes. But beware one misstep and the loss may turn out to be high... or low depending on perspective.

apps.name: Sabado
apps.short_description: Reunite with your favorite classmate, but you can never really graduate from the past... Wander through a nostalgic, shifting maze of old high school memories with a cheerful friend named Chesa. But the exits are vanishing, the hallways are warping, and a silent observer is tracking your every step.

apps.name: Sacred: Last Pixel of Ancaria
apps.short_description: Sacred returns as a party-based RPG set in a ruptured and battle-worn post-war Ancaria. Featuring hybrid real-time and turn-based combat, handcrafted 16-bit pixel art, and an open world from the original creators of Sacred. Build your party! Loot everything! Laugh at the rest!

apps.name: Sacrifice Sanctuary: The Ritual Maiden's Life With Monsters
apps.short_description: Chosen by her village to help stabilize a potentially dangerous monster population, Yomi is sent as an offering of the depths of Hell. Can she discover all that Hell has to offer?

apps.name: Salem 1692
apps.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4 to 12 players. Join on your phone, accuse your neighbors, and root out the witches hiding in Salem before they turn the whole town against itself. One host screen, no downloads for players, pure social chaos.

apps.name: Sancta Forma
apps.short_description: A puzzle game about one shape on a small board. Every move absorbs what you step on. Take your own kind and you grow stronger. Take the wrong kind and you start to come apart. 90+ rites, three hunters, and a Forge for building puzzles of your own.

apps.name: SAND CRUISER
apps.short_description: Sand Cruiser is a colony sim in which the colony drives and fights. Your settlement is a land cruiser crossing a dead desert under a red giant sun. Rebuild it deck by deck, keep its crew alive and drill deep, while a blind swarm under the sand reacts to the noise and heat you make.

apps.name: Sandkeeper
apps.short_description: A cozy sand art game. Pour colored sand into glass bottles one grain at a time: lean the glass to slope the layers, tap it to settle, press in a shell. Pour a bottle for each of the 48 places in your grandfather's book and keep them in his seaside cottage. No score, nothing can fail.

apps.name: Satarichi: Heroes De Caelum
apps.short_description: Join the fight for Caelum in this cooperative action RPG for up to 4 players. Control legendary heroes in real-time combat as you explore an epic world based on Satarichi's original novel. Enjoy the adventure with friends locally or through Remote Play Together.

apps.name: Satelital
apps.short_description: A rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

apps.name: Save the Nuke!
apps.short_description: Save the nuke.....with a gun!

apps.name: Save To Kill
apps.short_description:
Save to Kill delivers a unique blend of bullet hell and resource management. 

Experience rewarding character progression with permanent upgrades, challenging Hardcore, Enhanced, and Endless Modes.  Featuring tons of unlockables.

apps.name: Savory Seasons: Brizmere
apps.short_description: Escape to Brizmere, a simple and cozy haven for the beginning of a new life. Expand your farm, master the harvest and decorate through the changing seasons. Get to know the new world and neighbors, share the fresh harvests and discover the stories that make Brizmere so special.

apps.name: SCALING LAW
apps.short_description: Build an AI company in a psychological-horror incremental game. Label data, train models, expand across a global map, and automate your staff. Read the emails and conversations left behind as success turns unsettling. Five acts. Multiple endings. You can still press the shutdown button.

apps.name: Scawy Game
apps.short_description: Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer, buys a cheap asset-store house to write his masterpiece. His only job: feed the cats. And keep Grandma on her pills. And survive 4 days and 4 nights. An absurd parody horror game.

apps.name: SCP Loop
apps.short_description: You are a SCP Foundation employee. One day, you find yourself going through corridor, which suddenly starts to repeat itself. Explore SCP 970 and maybe you can escape...

apps.name: SCP: Darkwater
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game inspired by SCP-1128. As a young woman trapped in a surreal loop, explore your bathroom and submerge yourself in the bathtub to enter a terrifying ocean dimension inhabited by a colossal entity lurking in the depths.

apps.name: SCP: Project Pneuma
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in the ruins of SCP Foundation Site-63. Sneak past anomalies you cannot fight, scavenge scarce supplies, and piece together what Project Echelon released - because whatever is hunting you knows exactly where you're going.

apps.name: Screen Stocks
apps.short_description: Screen Stocks is an online multiplayer trading game featuring a real-time simulated market. Buy, short, and sell stocks to gain unprecedented levels of wealth. Team up with other traders or outsmart them all. It's time to make some money!

apps.name: Screen Survivors
apps.short_description: An idle survivor-like that sits in the corner of your screen.

apps.name: Sea Train
apps.short_description: A calm first-person ride on a little two-car railcar across a shallow, glassy sea. Write today's to-dos, tune the radio, walk between the cars, and let the halts keep time: focus between stations, rest at each one. Rain or shine, there is nowhere you have to be.

apps.name: Seagulls - Crappy Situation
apps.short_description: Defend a barely-floating raft in a chaotic solo or local co-op action rogue-lite. Shoot deranged seagulls, scrub the deck, dive for scrap, patch the damage, and buy questionable upgrades before the next wave ruins everything.

apps.name: Second Dawn
apps.short_description: Sent ahead alone to make a dead world breathe, you print machines, raise heat and air and turn Hearth green. But your warmth wakes a swarm beneath the ruins. Hold the line with turrets, then take the fight to its hives in tanks, walkers and gunships. Survival terraforming for 1–4 players.

apps.name: Second Source
apps.short_description: Every report on your desk is intelligence or bait. Four artifacts — agency, timestamp, position, text — and a planted one contradicts itself in exactly one. Call it before the clock does, hold the line as DEFCON drops, and when they breach the building, run the extraction on foot.

apps.name: Secondary Life Missions
apps.short_description: A chaoooootic co-op where you and your friends are sentenced to community service in the woods. Grab, carry and break things, cross missions off your list, ragdoll through nature, and slap your buddies back to life. You might survive, but your friendship won't.

apps.name: Sector Zero: Freedom
apps.short_description: A sci-fi incremental simulation where you work as an Imperial slave, build your own business, survive inspections, join unions, and buy your freedom.

apps.name: Seedling
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person colony game. Land on a planet you bought on credit (yours, mostly), chop, fish and farm with your own hands, then grow a town of settlers with names, needs and quirks, from the first log to a space elevator. Alone or with up to 3 friends.

apps.name: Seferia Matrix
apps.short_description: A dice roguelike deckbuilder — Lock & Roll five dice to cast spells and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

apps.name: Sekigahara 1600: Must Attack
apps.short_description: Sekigahara, 1600 - and battlefields East and West, from ancient China to the American Civil War. Any unit left in an enemy zone of control must attack: no quiet flanks, nothing held back. Pushing the line is the game. A deep hex-and-counter wargame, yet most battles play in about 30 minutes.

apps.name: Sellsword Tales
apps.short_description: A young warrior leaves home on a journey filled with battles and new encounters. Your choices affect not only the outcome of fights but also the relationships you build. Will they stay friends, or will something more develop? The path is yours to decide…

apps.name: Sentinel Trials
apps.short_description: Classic round based zombie survival game inspired by old school gameplay. Complete Trials, unlock weapons and perks, then hold your ground against the undead.

apps.name: Serenity
apps.short_description: Defeat enemies and uncover secrets with the power of music in this Rhythm RPG! Explore a dying world with diverse environments, wrap your head around nightmares, travel through time, make friends, pet cats, and uncover truths lost not only to history, but maybe even the narrative itself.

apps.name: Seri & Yuka with my heart
apps.short_description:
A healing visual novel about quiet everyday moments by the seaside, in cafés, gardens, and other peaceful places. 
Enjoy delicate watercolor art and soothing music as you observe the characters, surroundings, and passing time, uncovering hidden clues and stories within the silence.

apps.name: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter
apps.short_description: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter picks up exactly where 'The Second Encounter' left off, bringing classic run-and-gun mayhem to bold new worlds. Bigger hordes. Bigger guns. One last score to settle with Mental.

apps.name: Serpent City
apps.short_description: Serpent City is a turn-based board game of influence, trade and conflict. Accessible rules reward deep strategy: build your economy, outsmart your rivals and turn chance into opportunity. Play against computer opponents, locally with friends or online.

apps.name: Sexy female neighbor and her wet cucumber
apps.short_description: The unemployed Louis Thompson accidentally catches a glimpse of the private moments of his neighbor, Holly Phillips, through the surveillance. The two then fall into a forbidden love, while mysterious nano-insects quietly set their sights on them.

apps.name: Shadow at Noon
apps.short_description: An interactive sound novel for honkaku mystery fans. No cutscenes, no spectacle: just text, art and sound, with every clue you need on the page. Amesaka, 2015. A rich family's eldest son lies dead at the foot of his stairs; by morning the housekeeper has confessed. Every confession hides one lie.

apps.name: Shadow of the Matrix
apps.short_description: Shadow of the Matrix is a fast-paced sci-fi third-person shooter set in a dark space environment. A mysterious enemy sabotages the systems of a colony ship. Fight back, restore control, and save the crew in this story-driven single-player action game.

apps.name: Shadow Realms RPG
apps.short_description: A free dark-fantasy idle ARPG in one persistent world: every player on the same ladder, with web and mobile cross-play on one account. Auto-battle for loot and affix builds, raid server-wide world bosses, climb the endless Eternal, war over clan castles. No energy walls. Power is never for sale.

apps.name: Shards Of Armor
apps.short_description: The stars are yours to explore. Master tactical space combat, trade across distant worlds, and forge your own path through a vast, unforgiving galaxy. Inspired by the spirit of legendary space classics.

apps.name: Shelf-Made Tycoon
apps.short_description: A cozy tycoon game about growing a tiny warehouse into a logistics empire. Land bigger deals until trucks, trains and ships bring work to your door. When money gets tight, a crime syndicate pays big for a few unmarked crates. Just hope the driver isn't an undercover cop.

apps.name: Ship Miner
apps.short_description:
Action mining game with retro aesthetics and roguelike elements.

Collect minerals from procedurally generated asteroids, improve your ship and survive The Anomaly, an unknown entity threatening The Galaxy.

Can a simple miner stop The Anomaly and save everyone?

apps.name: Shit Day : Dawn
apps.short_description:
SHIT DAY : DAWN is a first-person survival horror game set in Republic of Korea.
You will be required to survive the impossible at every moment.

This Shit day dawn.
You must survive.
But will you?
.. it might be impossible...

apps.name: Shopska Salad
apps.short_description: Defend your grandmother's salad from Bulgarian folk monsters in a first-person tower defense game. Set traps by day, then grab your shotgun to stop anything that gets through at night. Keep the salad fresh for seven nights, solo or with friends.

apps.name: Shorted
apps.short_description: Balatro-style scoring on a 9×9 grid. Your deck becomes the board: trace same-color Packets into scoring shapes, install Patches that hack the rules, and rebuild the deck that refills the grid. Six Firewalls stand between you and an overloaded high score.

apps.name: SHOTRUN
apps.short_description: One shot. One kill. SHOTRUN throws you into a brutal office nightmare where only the fastest survive. Blast your way through and reach The Manager at any cost.

apps.name: Shred Inc.
apps.short_description: Welcome to the NSA — the National Shredding Agency. Your job: destroy classified files, one sheet at a time. Feed the shredder, hit your quota, climb the ranks. And whatever you do, don't read the paperwork. Some files were just meant to be destroyed.

apps.name: Shrine Protectors
apps.short_description: Deckbuilder Tower Defense meets rogue-lite RTS strategy. Lead your army, crush waves of enemies, and unlock powerful upgrades and passive spells. Combine deckbuilding strategy with tactical army management in this relentless bullet heaven.

apps.name: Sidetrack — Tiny Trains for Your Desktop
apps.short_description: A cozy idle railway game that lives along the edge of your desktop while you work. Buy engines and wagons, deliver cargo, fill contracts and blow the whistle for coins as five districts grow along one long line: vans stop at shop doors, windows light up at dusk and boats drift down the river.

apps.name: Silent Abbey
apps.short_description: Brother Aurelijus, a priest, receives a letter warning that dark forces have taken over the abbey he once served. You set out on a journey toward the abbey, traveling through lands already corrupted by evil.

apps.name: Silk & Sorrow
apps.short_description: A hand-drawn, dark fantasy co-op adventure. Two orphans stumble into a hidden world where all the unwanted from humanity ends up. Together, they must explore a haunting landscape, survive its twisted horrors, and bring back light to the Chrysalis.

apps.name: Silver Service
apps.short_description: Silver Service is a cozy tidying game where you put 11,132 portions back where they belong aboard a cruise liner, solo or with up to 3 friends. Fill your tray, find the right display, unlock upgrades, and to unwind, grab your fishing rod and see what’s hiding under the water.

apps.name: Silver Valley Screams
apps.short_description: Silver Valley may be full of dark corners, but your stomach won't fill itself. The year is 1975, and your father's disappearance is just the latest in a long string. Arm yourself if you plan to venture forth, find your father, and uncover the truth.

apps.name: Sime Returns
apps.short_description:
Sime Returns is a quirky, darkly comedic action-adventure about a fisherman, his cats, and the island that decided it no longer likes him.
Rescue your cats from furious villagers, and unravel the mysteries lurking beneath the sunny shores of the Adriatic.

apps.name: Simple Football League Manager
apps.short_description: A football management game for people who love football but don't want to spend hours on every detail. Choose from 5,909 clubs, build your team, play in leagues and cups, and get insights from your assistant Rob. Includes 2 difficulty modes, local multiplayer and a customizable database.

apps.name: Sin And Serve
apps.short_description: A hellish shift-based cooking management sim. Review sinner profiles, craft sin-matched meals, and harvest body parts. Meet Satan's brutal quotas and rise through Hell's ranks, or secretly build trust to help souls escape to Heaven. In this kitchen, mercy is the most dangerous ingredient.

apps.name: Single Forever
apps.short_description:
"This is not a dating sim."

You play as Red, an intern Cupid on the verge of losing both your job and your life. Your mission? Help Lia, a 29-year-old romance rookie, find her first love. Can you survive this near-impossible challenge?

apps.name: Sir Loot-a-Lot
apps.short_description: Medieval turn-based loot RPG. Skills are cards dealt each turn—spend 4 AP in any order. Sword, spear, and bow swap as you fight; add poison, fire, or frost; chain duplicates into combos. Forked runs lead through elites, vaults, and merchants to unique bosses. Relics reshape play;

apps.name: Siren's Well 2
apps.short_description: "The Crowley blood stains the mansion's hallways, where voices whisper horrors that time tried to bury."

apps.name: Sirens
apps.short_description: Become a deadly Siren and hunt down the most dangerous sea creatures that have ever swim in the depths of the oceans! Experience a fascinating journey through the world as seen from the perspective of Sirens at various stages of their evolution.

apps.name: Sitra Achra
apps.short_description: SITRA ACHRA is last known game from Celia Stowe, a game designer that disappeared in 1985. Developer Salt + Pixel has salvaged as much of the original code as possible to preserve this once-lost Commodore 64 prototype.

apps.name: Sketchy Warfare
apps.short_description: A turn-based tactical war game where stick-figure armies from across history collide. Command 11 unique teams, master dozens of units and weapons, and fight through a campaign for every era—from cavemen and pirates to modern soldiers, fantasy warriors, and the armies of the future.

apps.name: Skewered Up!
apps.short_description: Stack absurd combos onto a skewer. Fill your inventory with unique ingredients and skewer them to discover deliciously broken synergies. Grill, cash out, upgrade your skewer, and serve customers with unique demands in this fast, physical roguelike deckbuilder. Easy to learn. Hard to Master.

apps.name: Skyrim Script Extender (SKSE)
apps.short_description: The Skyrim Script Extender (SKSE) is a tool used by many Skyrim mods that expands scripting capabilities and adds additional functionality to the game.

apps.name: SLAP
apps.short_description: A physics-driven co-op brawler for 1-4 players. Swing your weapon with your mouse, send monsters flying, survive waves and bosses, merge loot into stronger gear, and settle arguments with your friends in arena duels between waves.

apps.name: Slime Mine Survivor
apps.short_description: A roguelite action game blending 2D block mining with survivor-like combat. Dig deeper while dodging enemies and creeping poison gas, gather ores and treasure, then upgrade and evolve your pickaxe and weapons to build synergies and dominate enemies and the battlefield alike.

apps.name: Slime, Get out!
apps.short_description: Slime, Get out! is a fast-paced action roguelite where you battle waves of monsters, collect weapons and upgrades, and create powerful builds. Choose your hero, survive increasingly dangerous enemies, and defeat challenging bosses!

apps.name: SlimeTenPuzzle
apps.short_description: Create “10” for a quick, satisfying win in Slime Ten Puzzle, a relaxing brain-training game! Combine four number slimes using +, −, ×, and ÷ to make 10. Enjoy cute slimes while sharpening your mind, with adjustable rules for multiplication, division, negatives, and fractions.

apps.name: SLOTDOWN
apps.short_description: Grandpa left you an underground casino, a mountain of debt and a loan shark with a smile. Grow ten wild slot machines floor by floor, make allies or rivals, and outplay the Baron in a pop-art comic incremental. No real money. Ever.

apps.name: Slots & Skulls
apps.short_description: A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Stop the machine to attack, win fights for chests, and upgrade what drops at the forge (if you dare). Or invite a friend and fight them.

apps.name: Slumber Craft
apps.short_description: Slumber Craft is a narrative deckbuilder about insomnia, pressure, and self-repair. Plan activities by day; build poker-style hands by night, from high card to full house, chain scores into Sleepiness. 21 nights, branching endings, and an Endless Mode asking how long you can keep weaving the dream.

apps.name: SLUP
apps.short_description: Collect Gems, keep your combo alive, and outrun your own past. Every path you take returns as a moving Past, turning your previous choices into deadly obstacles in this strategic arcade score-attack game.

apps.name: Slurdle
apps.short_description: Slurdle is my first game, a collection of six word games for solo play and online multiplayer. Guess words, build them from tiles, search letter grids, spin through phrase puzzles, and add custom packs when you want something new.

apps.name: Smashboom
apps.short_description: "Smashboom" is a high-speed 3D competitive shooter where you deflect incoming projectiles and use feints to exploit your opponent's openings. Engage in tense mind games, unleash a surprise smash to catch your rival off guard, and take them down!

apps.name: Smawverse
apps.short_description: Cut down the risen dead in this dark fantasy bullet-heaven roguelike. You are Smaw, a stray cat reforged in iron to take back a kingdom unmade by its own keeper. Kneel at nine prophet shrines and stack their blessings into screen-clearing builds. How long can you last?

apps.name: Smiley Steel
apps.short_description: Enter Smiley Steel Factory, explore a hidden underground circus beneath Nexora, solve mysteries, and uncover the truth behind an experiment that should have never begun

apps.name: Snake: Gridbreaker
apps.short_description:
There is no tutorial.

And there won't be.

I believe in you. 

I couldn't escape the Grid. Maybe you can.

You are snake who eats apples. 

j/k

You want to escape the grid loop.

BUT the LOOP wants to keep You in.

apps.name: SNAPTIC
apps.short_description: SNAPTIC is a physics-based puzzle-platformer that takes place in an offline laptop, and it's up to you to remember the Wi-Fi password.

apps.name: SnatchDeck
apps.short_description:
Steal, Adapt, Survive!
SnatchDeck is a fast-paced and addicting card game that can be played both casually and strategically. Build a powerful deck on the fly by stealing cards from your opponents mid-round. You'll have to adapt your strategy round by round to avoid death.

apps.name: Snotty's Sewer Reflushed
apps.short_description: Enter the sewer one more time! Snotty's Sewer Reflushed is the remastered indie horror where survival is key, and buttons must be pressed.

apps.name: Snow Duckies
apps.short_description: Scoop snow, bring snow duckies to life, and build your own winter village. Upgrade your Duckie maker, grow your flock, and give your duckies jobs, from gathering snow and building to defending their snowy home.

apps.name: SoberUp
apps.short_description: Pass the bottle or pass out. Hot potato, except the potato is alcohol and your friends are cowards. Sprint, tag, betray, sober up at the well — just don't be the first one to hit 100%.

apps.name: Softfall
apps.short_description: A cozy winter MOBA on a snowy mountain. Two teams of five fight to chase the other team's eagle off the mountain. Quick matches, Easy to learn, and best with friends. The basics come down to: chopping down trees, fishing, and even hiding in the snow.

apps.name: Softwind
apps.short_description: Unwind with friends, take on trials, and compete in responsive real-time battles. Softwind is a cozy 2.5D top-down action game with playful community spaces, elemental equipment builds, solo and co-op trials, PvP, and arcade soccer.

apps.name: Sojourn Saga
apps.short_description: Sojourn Saga is a retro JRPG roguelite where every step through the dungeon is life or death. Build your party, raise evolving companions, master powerful gear and ornament combinations and descend 99 floors through a prison realm ruled by the woman who refused to stay dead

apps.name: Sol Survivor
apps.short_description: Build, host, and survive in a persistent multiplayer space sandbox set in the outer Sol system. Construct orbital habitats, manage fragile station systems, and keep your crew alive while expanding through zero-g, Saturn-ring danger, and player-built infrastructure.

apps.name: Solar Arena
apps.short_description: A 2D top-down versus shooter set in a wraparound space arena. Steer and boost your constantly moving craft, block attacks with a barrier, and fight in battles from 1-on-1 to 1-on-3. Customize your pilot’s appearance, with your chosen look reflected throughout the game.

apps.name: Sole Ruler
apps.short_description: Kill across the whole star

apps.name: Soleil & Suspense
apps.short_description: Dive into the heart of the southern french region of Provence, in a tiny hamlet where the only people left are seniors gradually growing apart. Shake up their routine to bring them back together at the local café, in a short experience where you're never too old to look towards the future.

apps.name: Sombie
apps.short_description: Sombie offers action packed PvP, and PvE in an always online MMO. loot, kill, die, repeat. Explore an endless randomly generated world with your friends. Offering a unique spin on the Zombie survival genre, built from the ground up.

apps.name: Some Things Stay Broken
