apps.short_description: When the Sun Dies is an open-world survival game set in a mysterious post-apocalyptic world, where players explore deadly biomes, survive radiation storms, and upgrade their weapons to face what lies beyond the fog.

apps.name: Where Are the Brakes?
apps.short_description: One shopping cart. Up to four players sharing the controls. Steer, jump and shoot through 10 hazardous stages and two boss battles in this co-op action game. Handle everything solo, or invite friends and find out whether your teamwork can survive without brakes.

apps.name: Where I am Not
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy visual novel about memory, choice, and hidden connections. Uncover secrets, meet unusual companions, and discover how much of the world around you can truly be trusted.

apps.name: WHERE IS MY MIND
apps.short_description: Uncover the truth behind a mysterious box left at your doorstep. But as the objects inside the house pull you away from reality and drag you into other worlds, prepare yourself for a psychological horror experience where the line between reality and hallucination slowly begins to disappear.

apps.name: Whispering Meadows
apps.short_description: Whispering Meadows is a cozy farming and life simulation game where you can farm, build, explore, and restore a world consumed by mysterious pollution. Play solo or with friends, grow your dream farm, and bring nature back to life in a charming, ever-changing world.

apps.name: Whiterock Bay
apps.short_description: Take on a big mystery in this first-person adventure inspired by old-time horrors. Explore the desolate town, face the anomalies, solve puzzles and search for traces of your missing sister in Whiterock Bay.

apps.name: Who Heckled?
apps.short_description: Heckle, hide & hope you don't get caught. Who Heckled? is a 2-8 player online social deduction party game set in a comedy club. Sit among the crowd, heckle whoever's performing on stage with iconic memes, then blend back in. Get spotted and you're out. Grab your friends and figure out Who Heckled?

apps.name: WiccAtriX
apps.short_description:
Wiccatrix is a story driven ARPG with a spellcrafting system that allows the player to create custom spells to use
in combat and to solve puzzles. Your goal is to explore the lands of Terra and help restore the elemental order back to harmony.

apps.name: Wild Cosmic
apps.short_description: Lead a ragtag group of travelers with unique abilities through challenging maps in outer space.

apps.name: Will It Launch?
apps.short_description: A co-op physics comedy for 1-8 players with proximity voice chat. Turn a bathtub, a sofa or a toilet cabin into a plane and fly cargo between three islands. Your friends help you build it. They also have angle grinders, the shared wallet and, eventually, a bomb.

apps.name: William 2
apps.short_description: Explore a connected world of villages, snowy mountains and underwater passages in William 2, a 2D action-platformer. Complete quests, battle enemies, collect treasures and unlock new paths as you face bosses inspired by the Seven Deadly Sins.

apps.name: Winter Whiskers
apps.short_description: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

apps.name: Withstand The Horde
apps.short_description: Withstand The Horde is a strategy and base-building game. Raise a walled city, recruit soldiers and hold off waves of enemies - up to 2,500 zombies at once, simulated on your GPU. Build, defend, expand, and withstand the horde.

apps.name: Wizard Magic
apps.short_description:
An autistic wizard and their ADHD familiar go on the adventure of a lifetime.

Make strange friends, battle wizards and monsters, and explore the magical city of Bizzaire in this bite-sized pixel-art RPG!

apps.name: Wizard X World
apps.short_description:
Wizard X World offers a great experience as one of the best action games for kids.
This game contains of special 3D graphics system helps with imagination.
Prepare yourself and embrace the fantasy world.

apps.name: Wizardry VI: Bane of the Cosmic Forge (SFC Version)
apps.short_description: The 1995 Super Famicom version of Wizardry VI: Bane of the Cosmic Forge, ported as-is. Form a party of six, explore a first-person 3D dungeon step by step, and fight turn-based battles. Draw your portraits, train skills, and uncover the castle's secrets. Save anytime.

apps.name: WN_RPG 1B
apps.short_description:
It's a JRPG.
A heartwarming world.
Turn-based battle. A simple Mini-games.

apps.name: WordCrack
apps.short_description: A challenging word game with CRT terminal aesthetics. Crack words of increasing length in Gauntlet mode. Compete on Steam leaderboards with seeded runs. Regular mode gives 3 lives; Cracked mode is sudden death.

apps.name: Work From Dungeon
apps.short_description: A tiny adventure moves into the corner of your desktop. Click the mage and her monsters fight and grow stronger while you work. Collect and breed 99 monsters, climb toward the last foe waiting at the very end — an idle RPG you never have to stop for.

apps.name: World of Stick
apps.short_description: Build your base. Raise your army. Crush your enemies!

apps.name: Worlds Smash Expedition
apps.short_description: Blast through 500 puzzle levels across ten illustrated worlds. Rescue astronauts, unleash ship powers and combine special pieces to overcome obstacles and planetary bosses in a colorful space puzzle adventure.

apps.name: Wove
apps.short_description: A cozy platforming adventure where you explore various worlds as a small doll-like traveler, solving puzzles and unlocking outfits. Play solo, or share the journey with others along the way.

apps.name: Write With Shion: Lo-Fi Focus
apps.short_description: A cozy lo-fi focus companion with a story. Hit play on the Pomodoro timer and Shion, a romance writer, types beside you on a video call. Read her script as it grows line by line, shape the story with your choices on breaks, and unlock new chapters as you focus.

apps.name: XEN
apps.short_description: XEN is a fantasy action game where speed is power.

apps.name: XENOFLEKT
apps.short_description:
XENOFLEKT is a roguelite space shooter where you will turn enemy bullets into your weapons: dash into enemy fire to parry and deflect shots, heal your ship, trigger devastating counter-attacks. 
Unlock parts, plug-in unique perks with satellites, and get ready to master hundreds of deadly synergies.

apps.name: Xenogarden
apps.short_description: Xenogarden is a dark sci-fi strategy game where you spread an alien swarm, build synapse nodes, defend your core, and overwhelm human defenders before they destroy your living network and cut the invasion apart.

apps.name: Yang
apps.short_description: A short point-and-click adventure following a mysterious invitation. Explore the road to the station, interact with your surroundings, and discover what awaits you at 11:00 PM.

apps.name: Yazuke: Destroy The Halloween
apps.short_description: Woke up in a filthy dungeon? Check. Accused of destroying a holiday? Check. In Yazuke: Destroy The Halloween, battle your way through a ridiculously powerful gang literally named "Halloween". Dismantle the spooky season boss by boss, destroy the candy and tricks, and slay the night!

apps.name: Yo soy páramo
apps.short_description: Lead a clan of survivors and manage humanity's last settlement as the world dies. How long can you hold out? Learn, manage scarce resources, make tough choices, recover powerful technology from the old world, and be the last one standing on Earth.

apps.name: Young Suns
apps.short_description: Build a home on your own spaceship and take it adventuring across a newly liberated Jupiter. A cozy 1-4 player narrative life sim where you explore, salvage, and repair to help a huge cast of lovable characters make society better.

apps.name: Zangyou: Overtime
apps.short_description: The workday is over. The building disagrees. Trapped on the 32nd floor of a Tokyo office tower, you must escape a hostile AI that seals exits, shifts corridors, and hunts you through the building.

apps.name: Zaria
apps.short_description:
A young family finds itself at the heart of an unprecedented family drama.
Manipulate the all-powerful white and black dices in this turn-based narrative roguelike, and help them get out of this mess.

apps.name: Zombie Car: Kaiju Killer
apps.short_description: Mow down relentless zombie hordes, turn carnage into cash, and upgrade your war rig into an unstoppable death machine! In this action-packed incremental roguelite, every run brings you closer to facing colossal Kaiju bosses. Gear up, smash through, and dominate!

apps.name: Zombie Crawlers
apps.short_description: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! ZOMBIE CRAWLERS is a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

apps.name: Zombie Panic!
apps.short_description: Zombie Panic! was an old prototype survival-horror cooperative Half-Life 1 modification, first released back on Oct 31, 2004 as a beta via ModDB and now re-released officially on Steam for free!

apps.name: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year
apps.short_description:
Ancient customs vs. Detective Zomby—what could possibly happen? 
Investigate a tragedy caught on a VTuber’s livestream in a village frozen in midsummer.
Dive into minds, connect testimony in your Journal, and crack the case in this comedy-mystery adventure.

apps.name: Zombie Warz
apps.short_description: Zombie Warz is a tower defense RTS game with rogue-lite gameplay elements. Play as the king of a kingdom under siege by zombies and survive to discover their origins.

apps.name: Zombies Hate to Die
apps.short_description: Precise character slashing, scavenge resources along the way, and upgrade absurd gear. In this Roguelite loop, every escape is a brand-new journey.

apps.name: Zotenhold
apps.short_description: Endless Survival. 24+ Classes. Hordes of enemies, unique skill trees. Thousands of items. 10 Player CO-OP. Can you Survive against the horde?

apps.name: Дорога Жизни
apps.short_description: In the winter of 1942, you drive a GAZ-AA truck across frozen Lake Ladoga, carrying supplies to besieged Leningrad. Blizzards hide the road, your engine can fail far from shore, and enemy aircraft patrol the sky. You’ll meet people who need your help, and it’s up to you whether to stop.

apps.name: Тоskа-74
apps.short_description: Toska-74 is a psychedelic, open-world survival-horror game set in a fictional 1974 Siberia. In a moment's notice the sky turned grey - and the chairs rose to the ceiling. The Yankees and Commies have settled. Something will be done, no matter the costs.

apps.name: しろを塗る Castle Paint
apps.short_description: Paint the floors your color and capture castles in this casual 3D arena battler. Explore an open plaza with island minigames and paint puzzles, or build your own stages with the level editor. Play solo against CPU, or jump into online PvP and co-op.

apps.name: ひとりあそび
apps.short_description: Cute and a little strange? "Hitori Asobi" is a deck-building roguelike x 3D board game. "This is a game where you ■■ the people you hate!" Surrounded by lots of wonderful things, Rinachi, a very happy girl, decides to play a special game devised by her dear friend Poco...

apps.name: みならい王子のみならい防衛
apps.short_description: You are the prince of a small kingdom. Defend its castles from monsters in this tower defense game!

apps.name: みんなでティア表!
apps.short_description: A party game that gets everyone excited with a tiered chart. Arrange five words based on a given theme, and have other players guess the order. It also includes a viewer-participation mode designed for streamers. With custom genres, the possibilities for themes are endless.

apps.name: クッキング赤ちゃん
apps.short_description: An adult story and minigame collection featuring Minori. Play eight challenges with clicking, sliding, rhythm, and timing controls. Build your stats, unlock new stages and scenes, and revisit the gallery. Includes difficulty options and repeat modes in supported games.

apps.name: プレア・チェスト
apps.short_description:
A group of young adventurers set out to dispel the darkness lurking within people’s hearts.
A nostalgic 3D fantasy RPG inspired by the atmosphere of early‑2000s games.

apps.name: ミステリ―アドベンチャー　犯人はメイド
apps.short_description: The culprit is—the maid. And the protagonist. your mission is to strike down six unsuspecting guests, one by one. But beware—you must never be suspected before your plan is complete. To escape suspicion, engage in heated debates and refute your opponents. Hide your true identity at all costs.

apps.name: レザリシアストーリーズ
apps.short_description: "Lezarishia Stories" is a classic command-based JRPG set in a 2.5D world that blends pixel art and 3D visuals. Pursue the stolen Holy Sword and set out on a grand retro-fantasy adventure with a cast of memorable companions!

apps.name: ワロタ、俺の家のとなり魔王城www
apps.short_description: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!

apps.name: 万象之环
apps.short_description: "OMNIRING" is an, multi-cycle, strategy role-playing game. Assemble a team of Samsarans, experience stories in vastly different worlds during continuous cycle adventures - battle, interact, make choices, resolve events... Train your team, step into the final battle, and become The detached.

apps.name: 三国·守关录：烽火镇魇
apps.short_description: Hold the passes of a nightmare-haunted Three Kingdoms. Build defenses, recruit legendary generals, trigger battlefield mechanisms and turn the tide with tactical spells in pausable real-time tower defense. 18 battlefields, 13 generals, 7 defense types.

apps.name: 三國撞撞樂
apps.short_description: A Three Kingdoms roguelite auto-battler. Recruit and upgrade generals, build powerful synergies with cards and equipment, and arrange your formation before your team clashes in automatic battles. Test your builds against other players' teams in asynchronous PvP.

apps.name: 中国棋牌博物馆
apps.short_description: Welcome to Chinese Board & Card Games Museum. Step back into 1980s–90s China and play Dou Di Zhu, Guandan, Sichuan Mahjong, Ka Wu Xing, and more in 3D hometown scenes lit by your own clock. Practice against AI and rewind any move. Buy once, no ads.

apps.name: 乒乓行
apps.short_description: A roguelite bullet-hell shooter where table tennis meets ancient mythology. Wield your paddle to strike enemies with bouncing balls, retrieve them to attack again, and craft powerful builds through strategic upgrades.

apps.name: 任意杂货铺
克苏鲁围棋教学
apps.short_description: Go has never been so accessible! With Lord Cthulhu to guide you, playing Go becomes much more enjoyable. Whether you want to get started with Go, improve your skills, or tackle Life and death problems, Lord Cthulhu will keep you company forever!

apps.name: 全有三国志
apps.short_description: Back To Three Kingdoms is a turn-based tactical wargame .You play as a food delivery man who travels back to the  the Three Kingdoms period. Assemble an army led by three powerful generals to take on a series of distinct levels . Unlock more unique generals and formidable equipment as you progress.

apps.name: 公衆電話
apps.short_description:
You are currently trapped inside a phone booth.
When you pick up the receiver, the number “99” appears on the display, and a countdown begins.
From among the vast number of flyers covering the walls on all four sides, find and peel off two flyers with exactly the same design that aren’t overlapping.

apps.name: 别想好好胡 Nope Jong
apps.short_description: Nope Jong is an online physics party game for up to 4 players. Get ready for a no-holds-barred round of action mahjong on a resort island: hauling tiles, building hands, smashing heads and grabbing Jade, all at the same time. Real mahjong rules. Friendships not included.

apps.name: 勇者喵傳說
apps.short_description:
《MEOWBOUND LEGENDS: Legend of the Brave Cats》 is an idle RPG starring cats.

A group of cats were transported to another world, where they built Meow Village.

apps.name: 動物繁殖研究所
apps.short_description: Run 43 hands-on experiments, get to know four companions, and build a place for research and everyday life. Choose your words, expand your facilities, cook and rest, and discover your own daily rhythm in this single-player simulation.

apps.name: 南北朝天下对弈
apps.short_description: Strategy card game set in China's Northern and Southern Dynasties. Command nine historical rulers and 120 general, minister and stratagem cards across four battle lines - infantry, cavalry, navy and strategy - each scored alone. Every card costs provisions, and your hand carries over between rounds.

apps.name: 卡牌大师
apps.short_description: Card Master is a turn-based deckbuilder built around playing cards. Build poker hands, manage your deck, and cross three nightmare layers. Combine 14 characters with 8 Soul Arts for 112 theoretical builds, then survive randomized battles, events, and escalating Cycles before facing Fate.

apps.name: 地牢里的圣女不干活
apps.short_description: In a world overrun by goblins and vampires, you play a knight leading your personal maid-knight order into a goblin dungeon to rescue a saintess in peril, and meet all kinds of adventurers at the tavern. A light, easy roguelike survival tower defense.

apps.name: 地狱回廊 Infernal Corridor
apps.short_description: An incremental roguelite with automatic, real-time card combat. Carry your flame through the corridors of hell, slay demons and claim your revenge.

apps.name: 塔尔塔罗斯之刑
apps.short_description: Side-scrolling 2.5D horror romance game integrated with environmental puzzle-solving mechanics. You wake up as an experiment subject stripped of all memories in an underground research prison, hunted relentlessly by vengeful modified test subjects — until you meet her...

apps.name: 塞莉娅传说
apps.short_description: A fantasy real-time turn-based dungeon RPG. Play as the Arcane Knight, lead 5 heroes with front/back row tactics & magitech. Explore procedural dungeons, collect billions of gear & rune attributes, make choices at Obelisk Stones, rebuild a lost civilization. Native KB&M, remastered for PC.
developers: 杭州太虚映画科技有限公司
publishers: 杭州太虚映画科技有限公司

apps.name: 墨卷奇路
apps.short_description: Mojuan is a single-player roguelike deckbuilder blending deck construction with Qishu board space management. Enter painted scrolls, plan around cards, relics, consumables, and the Nine Gates, and face forest spirits, strange formations, and eerie encounters.
developers: 杭州执棋者网络科技有限公司
publishers: 杭州执棋者网络科技有限公司

apps.name: 大侠请充值
apps.short_description: A painterly, top-down wuxia action RPG set in a martial world where even a hero has a price. Find your own way through a riverside town, where martial arts meet everyday life and deadpan absurdity.

apps.name: 威小鼠和猪大常：接龙
apps.short_description: In *Willy and Charlie: Solitaire*, players journey through evolving challenges, building powerful decks and using strategy with a touch of luck to defeat opponents. Each match is unique—narrow wins or perfect chains can swing outcomes dramatically.

apps.name: 子どもたちの庭
apps.short_description: Welcome to the Reincarnation Ethics Program "Children's Garden." This is a puzzle game where you seek eternal rest.

apps.name: 寻仙
apps.short_description: A single-player, MUD-inspired cultivation RPG with turn-based combat. Create a character, raise a family or join cloud sects. Grow herbs with the Green Bottle, refine treasures in the Basin, and explore with puppets and spirit beasts—from hidden realms to the Black Sea. Simplified Chinese only.

apps.name: 巴哈姆特3-龍神之子的墮落
apps.short_description: Bahamut 3: Fall of the Dragon God's Child is a dark fantasy JRPG where every choice shapes the hero’s fate. Fight tactical battles using positioning, attack ranges, and Action Points, recruit companions tied to the Seven Deadly Sins, and manage weapons, hunger, time, and resources.

apps.name: 帝国的第99次重生
apps.short_description: 1,800+ event cards, 164 troop cards and 151 epic figures anchor this civilization strategy roguelite. Weigh policy, construction and war; choose a starting technology, homeland and faith to shape each new run.

apps.name: 幸运闯魔城 Luck & Doom
apps.short_description: Your hero stands at the center. Turn the world around them and shape their fate! Build your piece pool, rearrange tiles, collect gear and develop your hero. Every turn costs time. Find your chance to win amid the chaos of fate before the demon lord arrives.

apps.name: 异世界火锅店模拟器
apps.short_description: Isekai Hotpot is a cozy hand-drawn restaurant sim. Plan the menu, haggle for ingredients, prep dishes and signature broths, then welcome fantasy guests through a lively dinner rush. Earn coins, read the night's results, and return tomorrow to turn your tiny shop into the village favorite.

apps.name: 怪異ジャッジ・ナイトメア
apps.short_description:
ポップで奇妙な怪異調査ADV短編集！
メカクレ青年ハマメが、悪夢のような不思議な世界へ！

apps.name: 我在汽车制造厂当老板
apps.short_description: You've inherited a rusty assembly line. From sourcing a single bolt to developing your own V8, from a "shady workshop" mocked on forums to a household brand name—every design decision is a stone thrown into water. The ripples across the entire media landscape are the real exam.

apps.name: 战争、冠冕与流血的动物
apps.short_description: "War, Crown and Bleeding Animals" is a story-driven RPG game from a female perspective. Players determine the fate of the kingdom through crucial decisions, power struggles and scene puzzles, experiencing moral dilemmas and multi-ending narratives in power struggles.

apps.name: 拯救餐厅
apps.short_description: A fast-paced roguelite restaurant management game! 30days.$1,000,000. Save the restaurant! Build your restaurant, upgrade recipes, hire staff, and create powerful combos. Every run brings new chefs, recipes, and items. Discover hidden synergies, master different strategies, unlock multiple endings!

apps.name: 拼好车
apps.short_description: Take your weathered old car and roam the boundless wilderness.Stumble upon abandoned shacks and unique structures along the way, scavenge supplies and resources to survive in this desolate land.

apps.name: 挂机魔王 II
apps.short_description: Idle Demon Lord II combines idle progression with dark fantasy loot hunting. Fight automatically and earn rewards offline. Choose from five classes, each with unique skills and mechanics. Hunt six tiers of gear, customize affixes, gems, runes, and Legendary Powers, and build your endgame character.

apps.name: 摆摊之王
apps.short_description: A cute cartoon leisure party game that can cure a single person and lie flat, and can evacuate four people online for gold! It's leisure and fun to stand and explode coins and get rich!

apps.name: 斯凯尔的乌鸦
apps.short_description: Scared Crow is a 5×5-grid roguelite deckbuilder. Add up to three ability stickers to each card, plan each week before the Boss arrives, and turn humble cards into build-defining powerhouses. Clear a run, challenge other players’ winning decks, and climb the leaderboard.

apps.name: 新説魔法少女+
apps.short_description: A long-form SRPG set in modern Japan. The strange and fateful story of girls who gained immense power. A simple yet challenging system where you fight by consuming MP to use skills. The individuality of the numerous characters fuses with the story and their roles as units.

apps.name: 无尽战斗：放置与构筑
apps.short_description:
Endless Battle：Idle & Build is an idle loot-farming game with 8 skills, 4 enhancements… Tons of build effects, and unique support companions
Defeat the enemies on every floor and keep climbing. Farm loot whilst the game runs in the background, until you reach—the Realm of the End!

apps.name: 无效化
apps.short_description: Winnia is the only child in the sanatorium, spending her days lost in adventurous fantasies. Dr. Kai is a cold, meticulous physician who treats patients and diagnoses difficult cases. Innocent imagination and clinical rationality travel different tracks, yet quietly shape each other.

apps.name: 星舰骰（Starship Dice）
apps.short_description: Fill your fleet with different weapons and equipment, and return to base with loot. The fleet will engage in automatic battles in three-dimensional space, and you will plan the star map route and action mode, but it is best to pray for permission from the God of Dice.

apps.name: 来吃！小兔面包房
apps.short_description: Start your desktop bakery! Begin with one cookie and a table. Decorate, cook, hire staff, and learn recipes. Serve lively bunny customers, meet quirky characters, and unlock their unique stories and dishes!

apps.name: 桌面-宜居星球
apps.short_description: A soothing little planet for your desktop—farm, fish, and enjoy a leisurely life with your   you often find yourself staring blankly at your computer while busy with work and want something that doesn't require mental effort...Welcome to your very own desktop "Livable Planet."

apps.name: 極上人妻在我身邊
apps.short_description: Just being invited is enough to enter. Legal access to homes and surveillance control──your privileges as "Veil" building's maintenance technician. Among residents, that gentle, lonely married woman is exactly your type, while other women here are showing interest in you too...

apps.name: 樸素少女的戀愛直播
apps.short_description: Return to the countryside and reunite with Shizuka, your shy, unassuming, yet surprisingly busty childhood friend! Run the general store, dress her up, take photos, manage her social media, and help her become a streamer in this steamy romance visual novel!

apps.name: 江湖客栈-单人闯江湖
apps.short_description: 嘿，说你呢！这可不是尔等丐帮能随便进来讨口子的地儿！没有十万银币，休要打这“江湖客栈”招牌的主意。什么？居然凑齐了！但我必须提醒你，鬼方域内弱肉强食，适者生存。一旦回不来，全身行囊、武具都将留在鬼方。汝辈当真要试试？ 单人模式群：879639005

apps.name: 海特兰世界
apps.short_description: Haitland World is a single-player idle RPG that simulates an MMO world. Rule-driven NPCs fight, trade, join guilds and become rivals. Enjoy gear progression, auto-battle and offline rewards. Core gameplay runs locally. Simulated top-ups involve no real money.

apps.name: 深渊破坏神
apps.short_description: Collect randomized loot and shape your build with skills, talents, and gear. Choose from four heroes and explore 75 stages across five continents in side-view battles.

apps.name: 滑动方块
apps.short_description:
This game is a simple casual puzzle game. In the game, you use the arrow keys to get all the yellow blocks to the green flag goal to win~
Weird creativity that leaves you wanting more, various traps that keep you on edge, and fascinating mysterious features are waiting for players to explore~

apps.name: 滚滚大画师
apps.short_description:
A simple color-sense game. Drag hamsters onto matching wheels to charge the art gate and color a famous painting. Clear all wheels to collect it and view it in your gallery.

Beat the final level—your color sense tops 98% of players!

apps.name: 火箭工厂 Rocket Factory
apps.short_description: Roctket Factory is an incremental game with factory building elements. Players will build machines, manage workers, build assembly lines, and expand their factories in the game until they build rockets and move towards the next destination.

apps.name: 灯下行
apps.short_description: Where Lanterns Lead is a single-player strategy RPG inspired by eerie Chinese folklore. Learn combat skills, combine tactics, manage your monthly growth, and shape your own fighting style through battles and choices.

apps.name: 热血挂机
apps.short_description: A retro pixel desktop idle RPG. Warrior, Mage, and Taoist. Auto-combat, offline gains, and it can hide on your desktop.

apps.name: 爪爪谋略
apps.short_description: Paw and Plot is a lighthearted, hex-based turn-based strategy game. Players follow Latte, a kitten separated from his family, who meets Cantheon—a fallen feline deity hunted by wild cats. By helping Cantheon regain his power, Latte embarks on an adventure to reunite with his family.

apps.name: 爱之巢
apps.short_description: 《爱之巢》是一场关于血肉、爱与救赎、恨与纠缠的冒险。密室逃脱也好、视觉小说也好、电子宠物也好……这些都只是这场冒险的冰山一角。唯一重要的只有……属于你的少女——『晴』，永远在你们的《爱之巢》，微笑着等着你。

apps.name: 獸化論
apps.short_description: 一款以劇情與系統設計並重的 HD-2D 回合制角色扮演遊戲，核心機制圍繞在碎片與RE 同步率之間風險交換型的戰鬥。 故事背景為人類於南極發現未知能源「碎片」並導入文明體系，大幅推動自動化與效率至上的社會結構，卻同時引發人類逐步獸化的副作用，大量因獸化而無法跟上時代步伐的人便成為被淘汰的一群人，在廢棄的車站建立自己的城市，就此將城市分為了上下層。 玩家扮演上層的研究人員，因摯友在黑市遭殺害而展開調查，並在過程中接觸下層的盜賊、獵人、警察與流浪科學家等派系。

apps.name: 王之萌国
apps.short_description:
The world's first simulation management single-player game with an alternate world theme!
The world's first city-building RPG game!Build a home with a catgirl, farm with a dragon maid, and embark on an otherworldly adventure you've never experienced before!
You absolutely cannot miss out on Curry!

apps.name: 琉隐：将魂千军
apps.short_description: The game is an ancient-style musou roguelike action game. Players will lead a powerful allied squad to charge into enemy lines and resist invasion. As players progress, more mysterious events and ultimate challenges will be unveiled.

apps.name: 碎物魔塔：开局一只桶
apps.short_description: “Relic Spire: The Barrel Reborn” is a Tower of the Sorcerer-like strategy game.You start out as just a barrel,explore a monster-infested magic tower.Collect relics,assemble the body.Choose the best route,and conquer the magic tower!No manual input during battles — strategy is everything!

apps.name: 群雄战歌：妖火纪元
apps.short_description: This retro Chinese pixel RPG is set in a fiend-infested world. Recruit heroes, use dual skill trees and team combos. Explore, battle foes, fight the demonfire plague, banish darkness and raise your battle hymn.

apps.name: 苟在魔门求长生
apps.short_description: A cultivation prodigy trapped in a demonic sect. Survive, scheme, and choose your path—restore the righteous way or become the supreme demon lord. Every choice shapes the story. Rewind, retry, and replay any chapter via the flowchart. No grinding, no combat—just an immersive interactive movie.

apps.name: 虎鲸娘的放置钓鱼物语
apps.short_description: Enjoy idle fishing with your orca girl companion. Grow crops, craft bait, and collect rare and exotic fish. Decorate your own pixel aquarium and build a cozy desktop island. Play solo or enjoy relaxing fishing trips with friends in multiplayer for up to 8 players.

apps.name: 让破落宗门再次伟大
apps.short_description: 《让破落宗门再次伟大》是一款融合自动战斗、Roguelite构筑与宗门放置养成的3D修仙游戏。穿越后接手破落宗门，亲自走位、闪避，搭配功法与装备，挑战山野中的精英与首领；回山修复设施、炼化战利品、突破境界，招收并培养各具资质的弟子。安排弟子自主修炼、留守生产或外出历练，下线后也能积累收益，再带上护法弟子出山迎战强敌。局内构筑不断变化，宗门与弟子的成长持续保留。从一盏残灯、一座破山门开始，让宗门再次伟大！

apps.name: 诗词防线
apps.short_description: Poetry Defense blends classical Chinese poetry with tower defense. Lead poets like Li Bai, Du Fu, and Su Shi against insect swarms, answer verse challenges to trigger skills, study ancient texts, unlock poems, and light up poet constellations in your own starry sky.

apps.name: 賴瑞的調酒研究室
apps.short_description: A single-player visual novel about bar owner Larry and the people he meets. Make choices across multiple character routes and endings, with 40 local save slots and an ending collection. Play in Traditional Chinese or English.

apps.name: 跑灯魔王 Lamp Demon
apps.short_description: Recruit monsters, configure your skill pools, and start the chasing lights with one click. Light effects illuminate the board as monsters attack in succession. Defend the Demon Heart against wave after wave of heroes.

apps.short_description: After storms and disease leave only nine people aboard a ship bound for the New World, food and water are running low, and illness has taken part of your memory.
